This hotel now takes the top spot as my absolute favorite hotel of all time!

Even though it was the rainy season, we were blessed with surprisingly wonderful weather. Getting a great rate combined with fewer tourists made every single experience and activity feel like an extra upgrade.

What impressed me most is that the activities and experiences here are so rich that anyone can find exactly what they’re looking for. You can come to indulge in delicious cuisine, play at a golf course ranked among Asia’s Top 100, enjoy yoga, water sports, and pickleball, or explore their incredible facilities: 4 swimming pools (including stunning infinity pools), a relaxing private beach, multiple spa options, a casino, and an entertainment hall.

Foodies will be amazed by over 20 restaurants featuring international cuisines from all around the world—our personal favorites are Blend and QNH! On top of all that, they provide convenient free shuttle services to and from the airport, as well as to the nearby Hoi An Ancient Town. You will easily find one reason to visit, and a million reasons never to leave.

First of all, a heartfelt thank you to the front desk team who welcomed our three parties. On top of walking us through all the hotel facilities and details, they also recommended plenty of fun activities and great local restaurants, allowing us to plan our itinerary seamlessly.

Special thanks as well to the QNH restaurant team—a gentleman with glasses and a lady who speaks Chinese. Both were incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home.

Finally, thank you to Nick and Chelsea (?) for assisting us with checkout. All of these made our stay truly unforgettable, and we will definitely be coming back again!

reviews.text:
Hoiana Beach Resort Hotel is one of three accommodation options on the same premises, which can make the layout and facilities a little confusing at first. However, it feels noticeably more luxurious than the other two hotels in the complex.

The lobby is clean and pleasant, with a nice fresh smell. This is a significant contrast to the casino-side lobby next door, which had a strong cigarette smell. The reception staff spoke good English and made the check-in process smooth.

The room was new, spacious, spotless, and close to perfect. Housekeeping did an amazing job throughout our stay. The pillows were on the softer side, so guests who prefer firmer support may find them less comfortable. The hallways outside the rooms were also somewhat warm and humid.

I liked the hotel’s location. It is a shorter ride to Hoi An, which was the main area we wanted to visit. The hotel operates a shuttle service to Hoi An, although the logistics and schedule were a little confusing, we still managed to catch the shuttle without too much trouble.

Breakfast was also excellent, with a good overall selection and quality, though I think the spread (should) can increase a bit if more guests are staying.

Overall, Hoiana Beach Resort Hotel offers a comfortable stay and convenient for visiting Hoi An without the chaotic in the older part of the old town. Recommend 👍🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for sharing such a detailed review and recommending our resort. We are delighted that you enjoyed the spacious and spotless room, the excellent housekeeping service, smooth check-in, and breakfast selection. It is also great to know that our location and shuttle service helped make your visits to Hoi An convenient.

We appreciate your constructive feedback regarding pillow firmness, hallway comfort, shuttle schedules, and breakfast variety during busier periods. Your comments will be shared with the relevant teams for further review and improvement.

Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for another relaxing and enjoyable visit.

Sincerely,
New World Hoiana Beach Resort

reviews.textTranslated:
A truly special Robinson Club – absolutely perfect! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I stayed at the Robinson Club Vietnam with my daughter, and we were both incredibly happy! The expansive grounds are beautifully maintained, the atmosphere is tranquil yet vibrant.

I'd especially like to highlight the fitness classes – the level is truly top-notch. The outdoor platform overlooking the sea is a dream and makes every workout an experience.

The rooms are spacious, the bathrooms roomy, and even the hairdryer works perfectly – which isn't always the case 😉. All the staff are incredibly friendly, service-oriented, and dedicated. The Vietnamese are such a warm and welcoming people – you can feel it in every interaction.

The food was delicious and varied, the evening shows were spectacular – the dancers really gave it their all! I've never experienced a club where the presence of the club director was so noticeable – you were greeted and seen off almost personally. It creates a truly special atmosphere.

The surrounding area is also beautiful – it's worth exploring the nearby towns. A little heads-up: the rainy season starts in mid-October. We had a few showers, but it stayed warm, and you experience nature in a truly impressive way.

My daughter made some wonderful friends, and the pools are perfect for playing and relaxing.

In short: a thoroughly enjoyable holiday that I can wholeheartedly recommend. I've stayed at many Robinson Clubs, but this one is truly something special.

P.S. I almost forgot about the beach! It's absolutely unique! I've never seen or experienced anything like it before!
reviews.text:
Ein ganz besonderer Robinson Club – rundum perfekt! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Ich war mit meiner Tochter im Robinson Club Vietnam und wir waren beide maximal zufrieden! Die weitläufige Anlage ist wunderschön gepflegt, die Atmosphäre ruhig und trotzdem voller Leben.

Besonders hervorheben möchte ich die Fitnesskurse – das Niveau ist wirklich auf höchstem Standard. Die Outdoor-Plattform mit Blick aufs Meer ist ein Traum und macht jedes Training zu einem Erlebnis.

Die Zimmer sind großzügig, die Bäder geräumig, und sogar der Föhn funktioniert einwandfrei – was man ja nicht überall hat 😉. Das gesamte Personal ist unglaublich freundlich, serviceorientiert und engagiert. Die Vietnamesen sind ohnehin ein so herzliches, liebevolles Volk – das spürt man in jeder Begegnung.

Das Essen war köstlich und abwechslungsreich, die Abendshows waren spektakulär – die Tänzerinnen und Tänzer haben wirklich alles gegeben! Ich habe noch nie einen Club erlebt, in dem die Präsenz des Clubdirektors so stark spürbar war – man wurde fast persönlich begrüßt und verabschiedet. Das schafft eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre.

Auch die Umgebung ist wunderschön – es lohnt sich, die Ortschaften in der Nähe zu erkunden. Ein kleiner Hinweis: Ab Mitte Oktober beginnt die Regenzeit. Wir hatten ein paar Schauer, aber es blieb warm, und man erlebt die Natur auf eine beeindruckende Weise.

Meine Tochter hat tolle Freundschaften geschlossen, die Pools sind perfekt zum Spielen und Entspannen.

Fazit: Ein rundum gelungener Urlaub, den ich uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen kann. Ich war schon in vielen Robinson Clubs, aber dieser ist wirklich etwas ganz Besonderes.

PS: Den Strandabschnitt hab ich ganz vergessen! EINMALIG!!! Hab ich so noch nie zuvor gesehen und erlebt!

reviews.text:
We booked this resort as daughter and son-in-law wanted to return again after their stay for their honeymoon 2 years ago.

We booked 3 rooms for a family of 5 for a week.

We loved the resort and the amenities but most of all the staff made our stay the most amazing experience.

We were always greeted with big smiles at breakfast and we soon realised that the salt coffees were a special feature and we were offered these as soon as we arrived each morning. I also mentioned how good the baked tomatoes were and the next day a plate was especially prepared for me.

Our daughter celebrated her birthday there and the staff planned a special surprise cake and sung happy birthday to her.

You can stay at any 5 star resort anywhere in the world and enjoy the amenities you would expect but Bliss Hoi An
staff have made long term memories of our Vietnamese holiday for years to come. We will return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

What a deeply touching and memorable review! Thank you so much for choosing Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness for your family vacation, and especially to your daughter and son-in-law for honoring us with a return visit after their honeymoon two years ago. 🌟

It brings us immense joy to know that your family of five had such an extraordinary week with us. Hearing how our team made your mornings special with salt coffees, prepared a dedicated plate of baked tomatoes, and helped celebrate your daughter’s birthday with a surprise cake and song fills our hearts with pride.

Your compliment—that while any 5-star resort offers luxury, our staff created lifelong memories for your family—is the highest honor we could ever receive. We will certainly share your heartwarming words with our entire team as inspiration.

Thank you for letting us be part of your family’s story. We eagerly await the day we can welcome you all back "home" to Bliss Hoi An for many more happy memories!

Warmest regards,

Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness team

reviews.textTranslated:
Disappointing pre-holiday experience.

First, there was discriminatory treatment at check-in. No one greeted us in the lobby; we had to go to the reception desk ourselves. It's unclear if the difference in service was due to the room type or something else, but the guests at the next table received welcome drinks first, had staff check them in at their table, and were even given a trolley to their room. I stared blankly for a while before the welcome drinks were finally served to my table.

Second, the soundproofing was poor. I booked a Tropical Deluxe room on the lower floor, and the children running around downstairs made a terrible racket that made it impossible to rest until late at night. I had to call reception twice to ask them to turn the noise down, and I'm not sure if they helped. One person was sick and wanted to rest, the other wanted a quiet space to work. Neither of us got what we wanted, and we were annoyed until almost midnight when the noise finally stopped.

And the customer service was poor. At check-out, the receptionist asked about the poor soundproofing in the room last night, but apologized and said they hoped for a better experience next time. With such a bad experience after just one night, who would dare stay a second time with you?!

Breakfast was quite basic, probably because I had high expectations for the resort. Its location is far from the city center; I thought it would be quiet, but the soundproofing was terrible. It's not worth going to this remote area and staying here for the purpose of relaxation.

I will not return and would not recommend staying here.
reviews.text:
Thất vọng cho kỳ nghỉ trước lễ.

Đầu tiên là lúc đến check in bị phân biệt đối xử, vào lobby không ai tiếp đón phải đến quầy lễ tân tự làm thủ tục. Không rõ do hạng phòng nên được phục vụ khác biệt hay gì, nhưng bàn bên cạnh khách đến sau lại có welcome drinks trước và được nhân viên đến check in tận bàn, rồi có xe điện đưa đi nhận phòng trước. Mình nhìn ngớ người 1 hồi thì welcome drink mới được đem ra phục vụ bàn mình.

Thứ hai là phòng cách âm kém. Mình đặt hạng phòng tropical deluxe, ở tầng dưới, tầng trên buổi tối con nít chạy nhảy là bên dưới nghe rầm rầm không thể nghỉ ngơi được mãi cho đến khuya, phải gọi lễ tân 2 lần nhờ nhắc nhở, mà không rõ có được nhắc nhở giúp không. 1 người thì ốm muốn nghỉ ngơi, 1 người thì muốn không gian yên tĩnh làm việc. Cả 2 đều không được như ý muốn đâm ra quạu mãi đến gần 12h khuya mới thôi nghe tiếng chạy nhảy dẫm chân.

Và dịch vụ chăm sóc khách hàng kém. Lúc check out lễ tân có hỏi han chuyện phòng cách âm kém khuya qua nhưng xin lỗi cho qua và nói hy vọng sẽ được tiếp đón lần tới tốt hơn. Ở 1 đêm mà trải nghiệm không tốt như vậy thì ai dám ở lần 2 cho các bạn tiếp đón nữa?!

Bữa sáng thì khá basic, chắc do mình đã kỳ vọng hơi nhiều vào resort. Vị trí xa trung tâm, nghĩ là vào đây sẽ được yên tĩnh ai dè phòng cách âm quá kém, không đáng để đi vào vùng hẻo lánh này và ở 1 chỗ với mục đích nghỉ ngơi.

Sẽ không quay lại và không recommend ở đây.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

The Management of Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness sincerely thanks you for taking the time to share details about your recent experience. We deeply regret and apologize that your stay did not meet your expectations.

Regarding the reception process at the lobby, we would like to affirm that Bliss Hoi An absolutely does not have any discriminatory policies or attitudes towards different room categories or customer groups. All guests at the resort are treated with respect and welcomed equally. In your case, the staff borrowed your identification at the counter for check-in, leading to a delay in serving drinks at your table and completing the check-in process, unintentionally causing an unnecessary misunderstanding.

Regarding early check-in, the order in which guests are escorted to their rooms depends on room availability at that time. However, we seriously acknowledge that the communication and coordination from the Front Desk were not entirely skillful, causing inconvenience and delay for you.

Immediately after receiving feedback, the Management Board held a meeting to rectify the reception process, retrain the Front Desk & Housekeeping staff in communication skills and handling nighttime noise to ensure that similar incidents do not recur.

We sincerely hope you will be understanding and forgive this inconvenience. We sincerely hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a thoughtful and high-quality resort service experience.

Sincerely,
Truc Van
Head of Front Desk

Honestly myself and my wife were very disappointed with our experience here. We love Vietnam and travel here often but this place unfortunately let our experience down this time round.

I can truly say that the staff at the front desk need a lot more training on customer service and how to deal with guests. Tam was the only person who I could say that treated us kindly and professionally.

The rooms have a nice design but are overpriced for what you get. The resorts restaurants and amenities really need an upgrade.
The pool is filled with rust and the pool bar really needs a complete redo. The beach is also very far from all the resort amenities. The spa is quite small and once again for the price that you pay, I think the service we got was disappointing comparing to other places we stayed in Vietnam.

Their upstairs bar is also outdated and needs to be looked at. The hanging lights have all rusted and look like they’ve been torn apart, the pool table has water marks and is damaged and the overall feel up there makes the resort feel like a boarding house rather than a “luxury” resort.

The only reason I gave a 2 star instead of a 1 star was because of the incredible staff at the restaurant! They were great and really made the stay better for us!

I can truly say that for the price that you pay for this place it is not worth it.

10/10 – Beautiful Resort, Amazing Experience & Great Value!

We had a super comfortable and relaxing stay at Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness and really enjoyed our experience from the moment we arrived.

The reception staff welcomed us warmly with welcome drinks, and the check-in process was very smooth. The gentleman who took us to our room by buggy was extremely helpful and communicated very well in English. He explained everything clearly and made us feel very welcome.

And wow, the room was absolutely beautiful! It was incredibly spacious, clean and comfortable. We especially loved the balcony, where we could enjoy the beautiful view of the coconut trees and tropical surroundings. It really gave us the relaxing resort experience we were looking for.

The pool area and poolside bar were awesome. We enjoyed a few cocktails while relaxing by the pool, which was definitely one of the highlights of our stay.

There is also a small football ground near the beach, which was a great addition. We also enjoyed riding the bicycles provided by the resort for free. It was a lovely way to explore and enjoy the surroundings.

Considering the price we paid, this resort offered excellent value for money. The beautiful facilities, spacious room, relaxing atmosphere and friendly service made our stay completely worthwhile.

If you are visiting Hoi An, I would definitely recommend experiencing this resort. It is a wonderful place to relax and enjoy your holiday.

We would happily stay here again. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.textTranslated:
MI CASA BEACHFRONT – A PEACEFUL SPACE IN TAM THANH
I visited Mi Casa Beachfront in Tam Thanh on a sunny day in early September, with a blue sea and gentle waves. It was a very pleasant place – unpretentious, quiet, intimate, and peaceful.
Located in the heart of Tam Thanh Mural Village, Mi Casa boasts a lush green space with many trees, bougainvillea, and numerous beautiful photo spots. Especially noteworthy is its beachfront location; just a few steps away is the wide, airy, and tranquil beach.
Our group had a wonderful time. Playing music on the second-floor lobby was fantastic, and we enjoyed strolling along the beach, watching the sunrise and sunset, and wandering through the Mural Village.

reviews.textTranslated:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ **A place well worth escaping from the hustle and bustle of city life**

Mi Casa Beachfront left me with a very pleasant feeling – not overly fancy, not noisy, but truly intimate and peaceful.

Located in the tranquil Tam Thanh Mural Village, Mi Casa Beachfront boasts a unique atmosphere: lush greenery, abundant trees, vibrant bougainvillea, and many "chill" corners. From the characteristic green walls, the art paintings in the rooms, the bougainvillea trellis in front of the house, to the courtyard overlooking the sea, and the BTNT road from Mrs. Mai's house to the seawall – every corner has its own charm, perfect for taking photos. 🌿🌸🌊

What I liked most was its prime beachfront location; just stepping out of the house allows you to enjoy a very private beach experience. The beach is wide, spacious, and quite peaceful. The feeling of being immersed in the water, watching the sunrise or sunset, is an unforgettable sense of tranquility.

Our group had a wonderful time: taking photos together, strolling along the beach, watching the sunset, and sitting together chatting and singing in a very peaceful atmosphere.

If you're looking for a private, quiet beachfront spot suitable for a group of friends/family, I think Mi Casa Beachfront is a very worthwhile option. It's a place that doesn't need too much activity; just being there makes you feel… a little slower and much more relaxed. 💙
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ **Một nơi rất đáng để “trốn” khỏi nhịp sống thành phố**

Mi Casa Beachfront để lại cho mình một cảm giác rất dễ chịu – không quá cầu kỳ, không ồn ào, mà gần gũi và bình yên đúng nghĩa.

Ở giữa làng Bích Họa Tam Thanh yên bình, không gian ở Mi Casa Beachfront mang một nét đặc trưng rất riêng: xanh mát, nhiều cây cối, hoa giấy rực rỡ và những góc nhỏ rất “chill”. Từ những mảng tường xanh đặc trưng, những bức tranh nghệ thuật trong phòng, giàn hoa giấy trước nhà cho đến khoảng sân nhìn ra biển, đường BTNT từ nhà Bà Mai đến Bờ kè biển – góc nào cũng có nét duyên riêng, rất đẹp để chụp hình. 🌿🌸🌊

Điều mình thích nhất là vị trí siêu sát biển, chỉ cần bước ra khỏi nhà là đã có thể tận hưởng không gian biển rất riêng. Bãi biển rộng, thoáng và khá yên tĩnh, cảm giác hòa mình trong làn nước ngắm bình mình hay hoàng hôn là 1 cảm giác yên bình rất khó quên.

Nhóm mình đã có một khoảng thời gian thật vui: cùng nhau chụp ảnh, đi dạo biển, ngắm hoàng hôn và cùng ngồi nói chuyện, ngân nga những câu hát với nhau trong một không gian rất bình yên.

Nếu bạn đang tìm một nơi sát biển, riêng tư, yên tĩnh và phù hợp cho nhóm bạn/gia đình, mình nghĩ Mi Casa Beachfront là một lựa chọn rất đáng cân nhắc. Một nơi không cần quá nhiều hoạt động, chỉ cần ở đó thôi cũng đã thấy… chậm lại một chút và dễ chịu hơn rất nhiều. 💙
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback on Mi Casa Beachfront, the surrounding environment of the house, and Tam Thanh beach. Your feedback and the satisfaction of your group motivate the Mi Casa team to continuously improve the quality of our services, alongside regular maintenance and upkeep of the house, so that whenever you want to find a place where you can "slow down a bit and feel much more relaxed," you will remember and return to Mi Casa Beachfront. Mi Casa - my home - your home.

Thank you very much.

reviews.textTranslated:
A very beautiful and charming homestay in a peaceful fishing village. The rooms are quite new, spacious, and extremely clean. The owner is very nice and helpful.
Suitable for families looking for a unique, relaxing, and uncrowded travel destination.
reviews.text:
Một chiếc homestay rất đẹp và dễ thương giữa 1 làng chài yên ả. Phòng khá mới, rộng rãi và cực sạch sẽ, chị chủ rất nice và hỗ trợ rất nhiệt tình.
Phù hợp cho gia đình muốn tìm 1 chỗ du lịch lạ, chill và không xô bồ
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for staying in the El Sol room, bathed in the golden light of dawn and offering stunning views of the sunset. Your satisfaction is a joy and an honor for the Mi Casa team. We look forward to welcoming you and your family again on your next vacation to Tam Thanh beach.

reviews.textTranslated: Micasa is amazing! Beautiful, luxurious homestay. The owner is enthusiastic and hospitable! Tam Thanh beach village is like something out of a fairy tale!
reviews.text: Micasa thật tuyệt vời! Homestay đẹp, sang trọng. Chị chủ nhiệt tình mến khách! Làng biển Tam Thanh đẹp như trong cổ tích!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Mi Casa Beachfront would like to thank you and your family for choosing, staying with, and being satisfied with our home.

Your comment after check-in: "Your villa is so beautiful. My husband wants to stay another night, do you still have any available?" truly made the Mi Casa team very happy. We are even happier that you expressed your wish to bring your whole family back to Mi Casa for a vacation next year.

Thank you so much, Yen and your family.
We wish your whole family good health, peace, and look forward to seeing you again!

reviews.textTranslated: The homestay has a beautiful sea view, is clean, and the rooms are decorated cutely. The owner is enthusiastic and recommends delicious restaurants and other services. It's definitely worth a relaxing getaway to recharge your energy.
reviews.text: Homestay view biển rất đẹp, sạch sẽ, trang trí phòng dễ thương. Chị chủ nhiệt tình, chỉ quán ăn ngon và các dịch vụ khác. Xứng đáng để có ngày nghỉ dưỡng lấy lại năng lượng.

reviews.textTranslated: You should simply go, everyone…
reviews.text: Chỉ đơn giản là nên đi nhé mọi người…

reviews.textTranslated: A beachfront villa with bedrooms overlooking a stunning beach. We stayed there for 2 days and 1 night. In the evening, we went to the market and cooked our own meals at the villa. The villa was super beautiful, clean, and fully equipped with a kitchen for families who wanted to cook their own meals. The owner and housekeeper were incredibly enthusiastic. We wish the villa always has full occupancy. We hope to visit again another time!
reviews.text: Một chiếc villas trực diện biển view phòng ngủ nhìn thẳng ra bãi tắm siêu xinh. Nhà mình lưu trú 2 ngày 1 đêm ở đây. Chiều đi chợ về vilas tự nấu ăn . Villas siêu xinh, sạch sẽ, đầy đủ bếp cho các gia đình nếu muốn tự nấu ăn. Chị chủ và bác quản gia siêu nhiệt tình . Chúc villas luôn full phòng . Hẹn 1 dịp khác nhà mình lại ghé qua ạ!

reviews.textTranslated:
A charming house with three facades, the front facing Thanh Nien Street, the back facing the coastal embankment.
The house is designed with three stylish bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom, a balcony with panoramic sea views, and a fully equipped kitchen where guests can buy seafood and cook to their liking. The common living area is a bit hot, but there are many fans, so it's not a big problem.
The owner, although living far away, is very enthusiastic and dedicated in advising guests.
The house has a local housekeeper available whenever needed.
The sea is clear blue with fine sand.
A place worth experiencing if you stay in Tam Thanh Mural Village.
reviews.text:
Một căn nhà 3 mặt tiền xinh xắn, mặt trước là đường Thanh Niên, mặt sau là đường kè bờ biển
Căn nhà đc thiết kế với 3 PN rất có gu, phòng vệ sinh khép kín, có ban công view biển toàn cảnh, bếp ăn đủ dụng cụ để khách tẹ mua đồ hải sản về chế biến theo sở thích. Khu vục sinh hoạt chung tuy hơi nóng nhưng đc được bố trí nhiều quạt nên cũng ko vấn đề gì lắm.
Chị chủ tuy ở xa nhưng tư vấn khách nhiệt tình và rất tâm huyết.
Căn nhà có quản gia địa phương hỗ trợ bất cứ khi nào cần.
Biển trong xanh với bãi cát mịn
Một nơi đáng trải nghiệm nếu lưu trú tại Làng bích hoạ Tam Thanh
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
"Thank you for two wonderful nights. If I come back, I will definitely choose Mi Casa again."
Your message after check-out made the Mi Casa team very happy, from the owner to the manager.
Making three generations of a family happy and satisfied during their stay here truly requires the effort, enthusiasm, and dedication of the entire team.
The common living area, the living room and kitchen, can be a bit hot on days with high temperatures in Central Vietnam, as Mi Casa doesn't have air conditioning in these two interconnected rooms. However, as you commented, we have installed both ceiling fans and two portable fans to mitigate this during the day. You can also open both large doors (the main door and the sea-facing door) of the living room for better ventilation. Thank you for your understanding :) Besides that, the Mi Casa team was also impressed by your family, especially you: cheerful, open-minded, knowledgeable, and you can truly feel that the English word for experience is "enjoy" every beautiful moment of each trip, and of life in general. We look forward to seeing you and your family again on the upcoming September 2nd holiday or whenever your family has the chance to visit Tam Thanh beach.

Thank you and wishing you good health and peace.

reviewContext.Nearby activities: Trải nghiệm chợ cá Tam Tiến lúc 5h sáng

reviews.textTranslated: This lovely homestay is located right by the beach. You can open the door to watch the sunrise and hear the waves crashing from inside the room. The hostess is gentle and refined, and the housekeeper is hospitable. The hostess also provided many good books and stories in the room. I love the simple life of this coastal fishing village with its kind and hospitable people. Overall, there's nothing to complain about.
reviews.text: Home xinh xắn nằm ngay sát bờ biển. Mở cửa là đón được bình minh, nằm trong phòng nghe được tiếng sóng vỗ. Bà chủ home nhẹ nhàng tinh tế, cô quản gia hiếu khách. Đặc biệt trong phòng chủ nhà còn chuẩn bị rất nhiều sách truyện hay nữa. Mình yêu cuộc sống giản dị của làng chài ven biển với những con người hồn hậu nơi đây. Nói chung không chê được điểm nào.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you to your family and Ms. Van Anh for staying at Mi Casa Beachfront. Thank you for your comments about the Mi Casa team and the wonderful and relaxing experiences you shared during your stay. "I love the beach here"; "The Quang noodles are the best I've ever had"; "The people here are so friendly"; "The seafood is incredibly cheap" (hehe) and so on. These basic things about your family's trip made the Mi Casa team extremely happy. When guests truly enjoy this place, that value is worth much more than the rental income we receive. We wish your family good health, peace, and happiness. We hope your two handsome sons will be strong pillars of support for their parents and become skilled drivers, replacing their father on future road trips across Vietnam. See you again soon! :)

Thank you and your family for your enjoyable holiday at Tam Thanh beach and for giving Mi Casa a good review. We wish you and your family peace, good fortune, and hope to see you again at Mi Casa and the Tam Thanh mural village someday.

reviews.textTranslated: A seaside village that lives up to its name, as beautiful as a painting, with charming houses on the romantic beach. The rooms are clean and beautifully decorated, and the bookshelves are filled with many interesting books. The owner is especially enthusiastic. See you at Mi Casa again soon.
reviews.text: Một làng biển đúng với tên đẹp như bức tranh, căn nhà xinh xắn bên bờ biển thơ mộng. Phòng ốc sạch sẽ bài trí đẹp mắt, kệ sách cũng nhiều cuốn hay. Đặc biệt chị chủ siêu siêu nhiệt tình. Hẹn Mi Casa một ngày không xa.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much to both families for choosing Mi Casa Beachfront as your accommodation in Tam Thanh Beach during your trip and for your satisfaction with the Mi Casa team's home. We wish both families good health, lots of luck, and always plenty of positive energy for many more enjoyable trips together. We look forward to welcoming you back to Mi Casa Beachfront again soon.

reviews.textTranslated: Mi Casa is a beachfront villa with 3 bedrooms for a total of 6 people. The two ground-floor rooms each have a double bed, private bathroom, and are very spacious. They are also provided with amenities such as umbrellas, storage baskets, yoga mats, hairdryers, etc. The sea view is incredibly beautiful, especially around 4:30-5:00 AM. Mi Casa's services include many convenient items such as a wide variety of spices and kitchen utensils. You only need to bring your clothes.
reviews.text: Mi Casa là 1 căn villa ven biển, gồm 3 phòng ngủ cho tổng 6 người. 2 căn tầng 1 có 1 giường đôi, WC riêng và phòng rất rộng, đồng thời được cung cấp một số thứ như ô, giỏ đựng đồ, thảm yoga, máy sấy, etc…. View biển cực kì đẹp vào khoảng lúc khoảng 4h30 5h sáng, đẹp kinh khủng. Dịch vụ của Mi Casa có nhiều đồ tiện lợi như gia vị đa dạng, dụng cụ bếp, …. Như chỉ cần mang mỗi quần áo đi là đủ.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello and thank you for your very detailed comments about the rooms and services at Mi Casa Beachfront. The comment: "The sea view is incredibly beautiful around 4:30-5:00 AM, unbelievably beautiful" - reading those three words, "unbelievably beautiful," made the Mi Casa team spontaneously smile because it was such a genuine and... relaxed comment (I don't know how to describe it properly) - but we liked those three words, hihi. Mi Casa is small in scale, so we can't serve food to guests as much as we'd like. The entrance to Mi Casa Beachfront is a Euro Window system with a unique lock. Mi Casa will remind the housekeeping staff to provide more detailed instructions next time. Mi Casa has access to the beach via either the main or secondary gate. The key for the secondary gate is changed weekly because the house is so close to the sea that it's prone to rust; guests can still access the beach through the larger main gate. Thankfully, security in Tam Thanh has always been very good. There's a border guard station right in the commune. At Mi Casa, outside the guest rooms, in the walkways, on the porches, and at the gate, there are security cameras installed in discreet locations.

Once again, thank you very much for your review and feedback, which helps Mi Casa to continuously improve. We hope to welcome you and your family again for a relaxing retreat at Tam Thanh Mural Village.

reviews.textTranslated: My family just had a wonderful experience here. The rooms were clean, the hosts were attentive and dedicated, the amenities were complete, and the scenery was incredibly beautiful. My whole family breathed in the fresh, salty sea air and spent the whole day in the clear blue water 😍😍😍. The seafood was both delicious and affordable 😄. This place is truly perfect for families who prefer peace and quiet. An ideal vacation spot and will be our family's next summer 😎.
reviews.text: Gia đình mình vừa có 1 trải nghiệm rất tuyệt vời ở đây. Phòng ốc sạch sẽ, gia chủ chu đáo tận tâm, dịch vụ đầy đủ tiện nghi và khung cảnh vô cùng đẹp. Cả nhà mình được hít căng lồng ngực cái không khí trong lành mặn mòi của biển, được thả mình vào làn nước trong xanh cả ngày 😍😍😍. Hải sản thì vừa ngon vừa rẻ 😄. Nơi đây thực sự rất hợp cho những gia đình ưa thích sự yên tĩnh. Một điểm nghỉ dưỡng lý tưởng và sẽ là điểm đến của gia đình mình trong các dịp hè đến 😎.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: A family from a coastal region in Northern Vietnam commented on the beaches of Central Vietnam :) . Thank you so much for your satisfaction during your 3-day stay at Mi Casa Beachfront. We will remember your two lovely children and look forward to welcoming your family again on future holidays at Tam Thanh beach.

reviews.textTranslated: Wishing Mi Casa even more customers in the future, and that everyone who comes is satisfied and loves it as much as you do. ❤️
reviews.text: Chúc Mi Casa ngày càng đông khách, ai đến cũng hài lòng và yêu mến như em vậy. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you to the family from Da Nang, one of the most beautiful and livable cities in Vietnam, and to the lovely ladies who stayed at Mi Casa Beachfront and were very satisfied with the villa and the quality of service provided by the Mi Casa team. Thank you also for recommending us to your friends, who stayed at Mi Casa last summer and now to our family. There's no more valuable marketing method than a real-life referral like this. We wish your family continued health, happiness, and peace, and we look forward to welcoming you again anytime at Mi Casa Tam Thanh Beachfront.

reviews.textTranslated: My family had a wonderful 3-day, 2-night vacation at Mi Casa Beachfront. Since we have 2 adults and 2 children, we chose a suite. The sea view every day was beautiful and peaceful. Opening the room door filled us with the fresh, salty sea air, dispelling all our worries 😊. The hosts were incredibly enthusiastic and hospitable 😍. This is an ideal destination for families who love nature and tranquility. My family will definitely return many more times.
reviews.text: Gia đình mình đã có chuyến nghỉ dưỡng 3 ngày 2 đêm tại Mi Casa Beachfront rất tuyệt vời. Nhà mình có 2NL và 2TE nên mình chọn phòng suite. Khung cảnh biển mỗi ngày thật đẹp và yên bình. Mở cửa phòng là tràn ngập khí biển, hít hà vị mặn mòi và trong lành làm xua tan hết mọi muộn phiền 😊. Gia chủ thì nhiệt tình và hiếu khách vô cùng 😍. Đây là điểm đến lý tưởng cho các gia đình yêu thiên nhiên và thích sự yên tĩnh. Gia đình mình chắc chắn sẽ còn quay lại nhiều lần nữa.

Thank you! Your two children are so lovely. You are very polite and well-mannered guests.
We look forward to welcoming your family on your next vacation.

Thank you for your stay at Mi Casa and for your satisfaction with our service.

Team Mi Casa remembers the fun time you had singing and playing music in our yard right by the sea. We wish you continued health and happiness, and we look forward to welcoming you again on another occasion.

reviews.textTranslated: The view is stunning. Waking up in the morning, taking a few steps to the beach for a swim, buying squid from the locals to make a bowl of instant noodles with squid is absolutely amazing. A wonderful experience with loved ones.
reviews.text: View quá đẹp, sáng dậy bước vài bước ra tới biển để tắm mua mực lưới của người dân lên làm tô mỳ tôm mực là tét nách luôn. 1 trải nghiệm tuyệt vời cùng người thân.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hearing your comment, "Eating a bowl of instant squid noodles is so delicious it'll make your armpits tingle," was so cute that it made us involuntarily laugh. Thank you and your family for being satisfied with your experience here. We hope to welcome your family back to Mi Casa Beachfront whenever you have the chance to visit Tam Thanh beach again.

ownerUpdates.text:
Awaken your Senses with the Floating Experience
[𝐸𝑛𝑔𝑙𝑖𝑠ℎ 𝐵𝑒𝑙𝑜𝑤]

Buổi sáng trong mơ tại ốc đảo Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang không bắt đầu bằng tiếng chuông báo thức, mà bằng ánh nắng chạm nhẹ lên làn nước và hương thơm quyến rũ của bữa sáng thượng hạng ngay tại villa của bạn.
_ _ _
A dreamlike morning at the oasis of Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang doesn't begin with an alarm clock, but with soft sunlight kissing the sparkling water and the tempting aroma of a gourmet breakfast, served right inside your private villa pool.

Romantic Dinner by the Ocean
[English below]

🍷 Khi hoàng hôn dần buông trên mặt biển, ánh nến dịu dàng và bầu trời đầy sao tạo nên khung cảnh hoàn hảo cho một bữa tối đầy rung động tại Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang.

Những phong vị ẩm thực được chế biến chỉn chu, hòa quyện cùng vị rượu vang đỏ nồng đượm và trong không gian lãng mạn ấy, chỉ có hai người khẽ trao nhau nụ cười, biến khoảnh khắc bên nhau thành một trải nghiệm đáng nhớ vô cùng.
_ _ _
🍷 As the sunset gently kisses the ocean horizon, the soft glow of candlelight and a canopy of stars craft the ultimate setting for a breathtaking dinner at Wyndham Royal Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang.

Savor meticulously crafted culinary flavors, beautifully paired with the rich warmth of red wine. Enveloped in this romantic sanctuary, as the two of you share soft, lingering smiles, every passing second transforms into a deeply cherished memory.

The Lounge - An Exclusive Sanctuary for the Connoisseur
[English below]

Với những tâm hồn yêu nghệ thuật pha chế, chắc chắn đã không còn xa lạ gì với The Lounge - nơi mở ra một không gian thưởng rượu cao cấp và chạm đến độ riêng tư tuyệt đối, là điểm hẹn lý tưởng để nhấp nháp những tuyệt tác đồ uống được nhào nặn bởi sự tài hoa của các nghệ nhân mixologist.
_ _ _
For those who hold a deep appreciation for the art of mixology, The Lounge needs no introduction. It is a sophisticated haven where the world of fine spirits unfolds in absolute privacy. Here, every evening becomes an ideal rendezvous to savor liquid masterpieces, meticulously crafted by the masterful hands of our artisan mixologists.

Where Summer Never Ends & Friendships Have No Borders
[English below]

🌞 Đổ bộ Wyndham Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang với nguồn năng lượng tràn trề, “khối nghỉ hè” từ khắp nơi trên thế giới chắc chắn đã có một chuyến nghỉ dưỡng khó quên. 

Không chỉ bởi không gian sống gần gũi với thiên nhiên hay bờ biển An Bàng tuyệt đẹp, mùa hè trở nên sống động hơn bao giờ hết nhờ hàng loạt hoạt động tại khu vui chơi ngoài trời, tất cả đã tạo nên một sân chơi sáng tạo, nơi không giới hạn sự bứt phá và kết nối tình bạn xuyên quốc gia của các bạn nhỏ!
_ _ _
🌞 A wave of vibrant energy has officially landed at Wyndham Beachfront Resort & Spa Hoi An Danang. Our young globetrotters have woven unforgettable memories into their summer retreat in a tropical paradise.

Beyond a luxury escape enveloped by nature and the breathtaking backdrop of An Bang Beach, summer here is defined by pure joy and laughter. From engaging outdoor games to hands-on cultural crafts, our seaside lawn has become a limitless playground of imagination. Here, young minds are free to break boundaries, explore new wonders, and foster beautiful international friendships that stay in their hearts long after the vacation ends.

AURA ROOFTOP BAR - A Dialogue between the Ocean & Twilight
[English below]

Bờ biển An Bàng dường như đã bước vào mùa hoàng hôn đẹp nhất - mùa mà mỗi khi mặt trời nhẹ buông xuống, Aura Rooftop Bar lại chứng kiến một bức họa đẹp đến nao lòng được vẽ nên từ thiên nhiên và những trải nghiệm cao cấp.

reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time visiting Tam Hai, a place still relatively undeveloped for tourism. The seafood here is fresh and delicious, and the experience felt like being a local. I was quite surprised to find a well-maintained homestay like Milk's House. The space is cleverly designed, clean, and comfortable. There's a large atrium downstairs for me to enjoy, a kitchen, and a long dining table for 10 people. The owner is especially young and friendly. I think if you stay here, you should ask the owner about places to eat and places for experiences like fishing or squid catching; it will make your trip even more enjoyable. I traveled along the coast from Da Nang to Tam Hai. This route has little traffic, is wide, and very charming. I crossed the river by ferry at the small "Tam Hai Commune Tourist Ferry Terminal" (2,000 VND per person), and you can bring your motorbike on the ferry. The ferry is open from morning until 6 pm. For those who appreciate cleanliness, I recommend Milk's House. Have a great trip!

questionsAndAnswers.question: Why is Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai one of the top Vietnam luxury resorts for villa stays?

answers.answer:
The only property in Vietnam to be awarded the prestigious Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Award for seven consecutive years, Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai redefines the art of villa living. Nestled along the pristine shores of Hà My Beach, the resort’s villas are thoughtfully designed in harmony with ancient Vietnamese architectural principles, each offering a private sanctuary surrounded by lush tropical gardens.

Balancing indoor and outdoor living, the villas feature elevated sleeping platforms, contemporary artworks, local antiques, and luxurious outdoor rain showers. Recent renovations to our One-Bedroom and Family Villas enhance both comfort and convenience, while preserving the resort’s rich cultural heritage — creating the perfect setting for a stay that is both timeless and unforgettable.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Are the resort’s villas suitable for families?

answers.answer: Absolutely. Our spacious multi-bedroom villas with private pools and tailored services make them ideal for families. Children can enjoy the complimentary Kids For All Seasons program, while parents unwind at our award-winning spa. The resort offers something for everyone, from weekly complimentary activities and cooking classes to racquet sports and watersports. Whether you're relaxing in your villa or exploring the resort, every member of the family will find something to love.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is included when booking a villa at the resort?

answers.answer:
Our renovated One-Bedroom Villas combine timeless Vietnamese heritage with contemporary comfort. Each features a private terrace and outdoor rain shower — the perfect setting to relax and reconnect — along with thoughtful details such as discreet lighting, Dyson hairdryers, Bang & Olufsen Bluetooth speakers, wireless chargers, yoga mats, and 55-inch smart TVs. Guests enjoy 24-hour in-villa dining, a complimentary shuttle to Hoi An, daily buffet breakfast, access to resort activities, and full use of the Health Club and recreational facilities.

For those seeking even more space and privacy, our Pool Villas offer the ultimate retreat for families or groups. These expansive sanctuaries feature heated private pools surrounded by tropical gardens, separate thatched-roof dining pavilions, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Exclusive benefits include a dedicated personal attendant, round-trip airport transfers, daily laundry service, and butler service throughout your stay. Each en-suite bedroom opens to a private terrace and outdoor shower, and guests also receive one complimentary bottle of Nam Hai Negroni per bedroom. All villa stays include access to the resort’s oceanfront pools, award-winning wellness facilities, signature dining, and enriching cultural experiences.

ownerUpdates.text: Thắp Nến, meaning “lighting the candle,” is a nightly ritual that celebrates the quiet power of light. Each flame is lit with gratitude for the day behind us, hope for the moments still to come, and the intention to welcome the evening with an open heart. As the warm glow of candlelight spreads throughout the resort, Thắp Nến becomes a shared moment of reflection - one that reminds us that even the smallest light can bring calm, clarity and connection.
Breakfasts worth waking up for - even if you don't usually do mornings.

The most meaningful journeys begin with the people who call a place home.
From crafting tofu in a family kitchen surrounded by rice fields to sharing coffee with local curators and discovering the centuries-old story of Vietnamese fish sauce, Four Seasons Signature Experience offers rare access to the makers, traditions, and flavours that continue to shape Central Vietnam.
An invitation to experience Hội An through the eyes - and hands - of those who know it best.
The first glimpse is often the one you remember most. Long before the ocean comes into view, serenity has already found you.
Sometimes the most luxurious thing on the table is time. Time to savour, to reconnect, and to linger long after the final course.

Where the garden ends, the beach begins. 
Hidden beneath a canopy of coconut palms, our Pool Villa Residence blurs the line between architecture and nature, inviting life to unfold at an unhurried pace - where mornings begin with birdsong, afternoons drift by beside your private pool, and the beach is only ever a few barefoot steps away.
There are places that feel as though they've been lifted from a dream.
The toughest critics travel with the smallest suitcases. Judging by the smiles, we’d say we passed.

Join us in celebrating a decade of memories at Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai, Hoi An, Vietnam. To thank you for being part of our story, our anniversary offer includes your choice of two experiences that have defined our Resort for the past 10 years, each inspired by one of our signature pillars: culture, well-being, design and cuisine.

At Heart of the Earth Spa, well-being begins by listening – to the body, the mind and the natural rhythms around us. Designed for two, this wellness retreat combines a personalized Wellness Screening with deeply restorative experiences, including Yoga Nidra and our signature Deep Peace Bodywork. Together, these practices encourage rest, clarity and a renewed sense of balance in the tranquil surroundings of The Nam Hai.

reviews.text: 10/10 can not
Best stay ever!

My family and I are staying just two nights at the beachfront villas. The resort is grand, carefully designed, and well kept; the gardeners and cleaners deserve credit for maintaining such high standards.

My villa includes a butler, and I want to commend Thuỷ, who made this brief visit pleasant and restful. She anticipated and prepared every request. The space is generous, with a separate living area and a bedroom in another structure. The bed is comfortable and the pillows are soft. Amenities are top quality. The mini-bar is not inclusive in cost of stay like other luxury resorts, but it provides a tasty pre-mixed negroni bottle each day. Housekeeping is excellent at keeping the room clean. The in-villa pool is small but enjoyable, while the public pool is huge.

I appreciate that bicycles are available for every villa. Cycling to breakfast or the spa feels quicker and simpler.

The spa is serene and attractive, with high-quality products. Still, my treatment did not meet expectations. My masseur tried to adjust to my requests, yet her skill did not match the cost.

Breakfast offers many options but feels chaotic. The restaurant staff seem to need more training; they focus more on foreign tables than local ones. For two days in a row, our orders were forgotten or mixed up. While we sat outside, cushions were not provided until I asked.

In short, my stay was enjoyable because of Thuỷ’s efforts. Thank you again, Thuỷ.

An Exceptional Stay — One of the Best Family Experiences We’ve Had

We spent three wonderful nights at Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai, and what truly sets this hotel apart is its exceptional level of service and genuine attention to detail.

From the moment we arrived, we felt incredibly welcomed and cared for. The staff have a remarkable ability to notice and remember individual preferences, anticipate needs, and make every guest feel genuinely special. It is not simply excellent service — it is thoughtful, personal hospitality that makes the entire experience feel effortless.

Travelling with two young children, aged one and five, I was particularly impressed by how beautifully the resort caters to families. Our villa was prepared with so many thoughtful little touches: adorable children’s bathrobes and slippers in the right sizes, books, toys, and lovely little surprises and treats for the girls.

What impressed me even more were the practical details. Even something as simple as a small step stool in the bathroom, allowing a child to reach the sink independently, shows just how carefully the resort has considered the needs of its youngest guests. These may seem like minor things, but as a parent, they make an enormous difference. You can tell that welcoming children here is not an afterthought — it is genuinely part of the resort’s philosophy.

A very special mention goes to the Kids Club, which is easily one of the best we have experienced.

Although the indoor space is relatively compact, it is beautifully designed, with huge windows, an abundance of natural light, and a wonderful variety of activities. Rather than feeling like an enclosed playroom, it feels bright, welcoming, and connected to the outdoors.

What I appreciated most was the flexibility and personal attention. There is a daily activity schedule, but the staff are wonderfully accommodating to each child’s interests. If your child doesn’t feel like making bracelets, they can make lanterns instead. If lanterns aren’t appealing either, there is always another creative activity to explore. Nothing feels rigid or forced.

The layout is absolutely brilliant for families. Right beside the indoor Kids Club is a shallow children’s pool, filled with pool toys, floats, water guns, and everything little ones could wish for. Just next to it is a large, shaded sandpit where children can build sandcastles and play comfortably out of the direct sun.

Children can move effortlessly between swimming, sand play, and indoor activities, all within the same dedicated area. With a toddler and a five-year-old, I found this setup almost perfect. Both children had plenty to enjoy, and the entire experience was wonderfully relaxed.

The beach deserves a special mention as well. It is absolutely beautiful — vast, immaculately clean, and incredibly peaceful. Whether taking a long walk along the shore, dipping your feet into the water, or simply enjoying the surroundings, it is a pleasure to be there. Despite the resort welcoming other guests, there is an extraordinary sense of space and privacy. You rarely feel surrounded by people.

What stays with me most, however, is the kindness and attentiveness of the people working here. It is the combination of genuine warmth, impeccable service, and countless thoughtful details that makes this resort so special.

A very memorable vacation at Tam Thanh Beach Resort

My family just had a wonderful vacation at Tam Thanh Beach Resort. The resort has a beautiful location, close to the beach, with a spacious and quiet atmosphere, perfect for families looking for a place to rest and relax.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-equipped. I especially liked the close connection with nature and the fresh air. The beach is beautiful and quite peaceful; morning and afternoon walks or enjoying the sea view were very relaxing.

The staff were friendly, enthusiastic, and very helpful. The services were generally good and suitable for a family vacation.

Another thing I liked was that the resort offered a very private and relaxing atmosphere, not too noisy or crowded.

Overall, my family had a great experience and will definitely return to Tam Thanh Beach Resort if we have the chance. It's definitely a great choice for a vacation in Tam Ky! ❤️🌴🌊

Một kỳ nghỉ rất đáng nhớ tại Tam Thanh Beach Resort

Gia đình mình vừa có một chuyến nghỉ dưỡng khá tuyệt vời tại Tam Thanh Beach Resort. Resort có vị trí rất đẹp, gần biển, không gian thoáng mát và yên tĩnh, rất phù hợp cho gia đình muốn tìm một nơi để nghỉ ngơi và thư giãn.

Phòng ốc sạch sẽ, rộng rãi, đầy đủ tiện nghi. Mình đặc biệt thích không gian gần gũi với thiên nhiên và không khí trong lành ở đây. Bãi biển đẹp, khá yên bình, buổi sáng và chiều đi dạo hoặc ngắm biển rất chill.

Nhân viên thân thiện, nhiệt tình và hỗ trợ khách khá chu đáo. Các dịch vụ nhìn chung đều ổn và phù hợp với một chuyến nghỉ dưỡng gia đình.

Một điểm mình thích nữa là resort mang lại cảm giác khá riêng tư và thư giãn, không quá ồn ào hay đông đúc.

Nhìn chung, gia đình mình đã có một trải nghiệm rất tốt và chắc chắn sẽ quay lại Tam Thanh Beach Resort nếu có dịp. Rất đáng để lựa chọn cho một chuyến nghỉ dưỡng ở Tam Kỳ! ❤️🌴🌊

Set along Cua Dai Beach, this laid-back resort is 6 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics and 7 km from Hoi An Ancient Town.

Body lotion was provided by MalinandGoetz.

They give you 50 USD (only for playing at tables, not slot machines). For casual gambling, you need 20 USD for the slot machines.

There aren't many games available; the tables are mostly baccarat, roulette, and blackjack.

Besides slot machines, there are swiping machines.

Thanks for the 5 USD I won back! 🤣 That's enough for taking a bus in the US.

For shuttle bus information, please refer to the last two images.

reviews.textTranslated:
I had a pretty good experience at New World Hoiana. The hotel has a beautiful, modern, and quiet atmosphere. The rooms are spacious, clean, with new furnishings and a beautiful sea view.

The staff are friendly, helpful, and the service is generally good. The breakfast buffet has a wide selection, the food is quite delicious, and it's regularly replenished. I also liked the pool and beach area because it's quite large and relaxing.

It gets quite crowded on weekends, but the resort's atmosphere remains relatively pleasant. Overall, this is a good choice for a relaxing getaway in Hoiana, especially suitable for a short trip.

Mình có một trải nghiệm khá tốt tại New World Hoiana. Khách sạn có không gian đẹp, hiện đại và khá yên tĩnh. Phòng rộng, sạch sẽ, nội thất mới và view nhìn ra biển khá đẹp.

Nhân viên thân thiện, hỗ trợ nhanh và dịch vụ nhìn chung ổn. Buffet sáng có nhiều lựa chọn, món ăn khá ngon và được bổ sung thường xuyên. Mình cũng thích khu vực hồ bơi và bãi biển vì khá rộng và thoải mái.

Vào cuối tuần khách khá đông nhưng không gian resort vẫn tương đối dễ chịu. Nhìn chung, đây là một lựa chọn tốt nếu muốn nghỉ dưỡng ở Hoiana, đặc biệt phù hợp cho một chuyến đi ngắn ngày.

reviews.textTranslated:
A wonderful place to relax!

The hotel left only positive impressions. I'll start with the most important thing: the staff really goes out of their way to serve the guests. There were some minor issues, but they did a great job, quickly resolving them and smoothing them out. The rooms are clean and cleaned every day, which is a great plus. The grounds are well-maintained and beautiful—a real treat. The pool is huge and clean, with plenty of space for everyone. The breakfasts are varied and the selection is excellent. And the complimentary shuttle bus to the city is simply superb! Very convenient. Thank you to the hotel, we'll be happy to return!
reviews.text:
Прекрасное место для отдыха!

Отель оставил только положительные впечатления. Начну с самого главного — персонал здесь действительно старается для гостей. Были мелкие нюансы, но ребята молодцы, всё быстро решили и сгладили. Номера чистые, убирают каждый день, что очень радует. Территория ухоженная и красивая — глаз отдыхает. Бассейн огромный, чистый, места хватает всем. Завтраки разнообразные, выбор отличный. А бонус в виде автобуса до города — просто супер! Очень удобно. Спасибо отелю, вернёмся с удовольствием!

The villa has 4 bedrooms, good for 8 people. It was a luxurious stay, with excellent buffet breakfast included. On one of the days we even had Rahmaan Philip play the violin for us. We also enjoyed the facilities: swimming pool, games room, sauna/steam room/jacuzzi; all the equipment were well-maintained. We made use of the free shuttle van to the old town several times. Service is impeccable and it was truly a memorable experience for all of us.
The views the beach the food the resort all beautiful but the best part is the staff wonderful wonderful kind helpful knowledgeable staff highly recommend thank you to everyone!

reviews.textTranslated:
My experience during this stay:

The hotel is located in a slightly out-of-the-way corner, but it's convenient to call a taxi, so it didn't affect my trip to Hoi An Ancient Town.

As a hotel member, I had the opportunity to upgrade to a one-bedroom apartment. The room's decor was a bit dated; the refrigerator wasn't cold, and the toilet wasn't very hygienic. I'm not sure if this was just a problem with that particular room.

The food was quite good for the mid-range price. The service staff were very friendly, and there were some hotel promotions that I could participate in for free or included in the hotel's packages. Overall, I was satisfied. 👍🏻

An Exceptional Luxury Experience at Renaissance Hoi An Resort & Spa ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Our stay at the Renaissance Hoi An Resort & Spa was truly exceptional and, without a doubt, one of the highlights of our time in Vietnam.

We had the pleasure of staying in Villa 8203, and from the moment we arrived, everything about the experience felt effortless, luxurious and beautifully considered. The resort is simply breathtaking. The architecture, lush surroundings, tranquillity and attention to detail create an atmosphere that photographs genuinely cannot do justice — it is something you need to experience in person.

What elevated our stay even further was the exceptional hospitality. A special thank you to Jeanie, Heip, Hannah, our wonderful porter, and the entire team. Every interaction was warm, gracious and professional. They consistently went above and beyond to ensure that we were comfortable and well taken care of. It is clear that genuine hospitality is at the heart of this property.

Our villa was beautiful, private and incredibly comfortable, providing the perfect setting to unwind. The culinary experience was outstanding, and the spa was absolutely divine — the perfect balance of indulgence, relaxation and rejuvenation.

There is something truly special about a hotel where the setting is spectacular, but the people make the experience unforgettable. The team at Renaissance Hoi An achieved exactly that.

We left feeling completely refreshed, spoiled and incredibly grateful for the experience. The photographs may capture the beauty, but they simply cannot capture the feeling of being there.

A truly memorable stay, exceptional service and a destination we would wholeheartedly recommend. Renaissance Hoi An, thank you for making our stay so special. We cannot wait to return. 🤍✨

reviews.text:
Still giving 5 🌟 despite ranking location as 3 🌟 as a 4.5 🌟 aggregate isn't available as an option and the atmosphere and service more than offset the need to Scooter or Grab like 25KM to get anywhere of use other than Old Town. Speaking of, while the 1st Shuttle is at 12:15 (?) the free shuttle to and from OT is a very nice perk.

I am Titanium Elite and Lifetime Silver at the conclusion of this stay. So YMMV in terms of perks and upgrades. We got upgraded to a seafront facing Jr Suite which was just massive and likely a hair larger than our 2 Bedder in Saigon. Room was totally on point and up to Bonvoy standards, but there were some small quirks with the Housekeeping. Nothing worth detailing, just odd based on my experiences across over 30 Bonvoy properties in at least 5 countries.

Speaking of that knowledge / experience base, thr Brekkie here is decidedly the best I have ever seen at a Bonvoy. Just MASSIVE selection. Sushi, Sirloin tips, Banh Mi station, Vietnamese Coffee station abive the usual machine made Lattes, real Bacon 🥓 (I'm looking at you Renaissance Dhaka and Chennai), Brie and meats for making better than butter toast, and of course a proper made to order Ommelete. Seafront view with the only downside being some heavy sunlight if you come late and have to eat a non-shade table to secure the view.

Large tub in the room. Just a MASSIVE bed (see pic of the Fiancé for size reference...if you can even find her in the pic like a game of "Where's Waldo?"). Nice little **** couch and a large patio area for some relaxing Cuban smoke while listening to the Surf break. Especially at sunrise.

The Game Room with the Street Fighter arcade game and 8' Billiards table are a really cool touch, especially given the Fiancé's and my proclivity for that past time. The Hammocks are a really nice little perk, especially after one drink from Petit Kang in OT puts her straight on her 47KG butt for the rest of the afternoon.

Would definitely stay again. Massive value for the cash outlay or the points burned.

All staff treat you like Royalty, but again, at ~400 nights on my dossier with Bonvoy, YMMV.

We also appreciate your helpful comments regarding the small areas for improvement. Your feedback is valuable to us and will be shared with the relevant teams.

Thank you again for your generous support and recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you and your fiancée back again in the future!

reviews.text:
We had an excellent stay at Moire Hoi An and were very impressed by the overall quality of the experience.

The hotel itself is elegant, peaceful and beautifully maintained, but what stood out most was the service. Every member of staff we encountered was consistently warm, attentive and professional. The team showed a genuine willingness to help, and their attention to detail made us feel very well looked after throughout our stay.

Dining was another highlight. We enjoyed the beef pho from room service so much that we ordered it twice. It was exceptionally flavorful and easily one of the best dishes we had during our trip. Our dinner at the hotel was equally impressive, with every course beautifully presented, carefully prepared and of a very high standard.

We were also particularly grateful for the assistance we received after accidentally leaving an item behind in our room. The hotel team responded promptly and handled the situation with great care and efficiency. Their support was reassuring and reflected the professionalism and genuine hospitality we experienced throughout our stay.

Overall, Moire Hoi An delivered an excellent combination of atmosphere, dining and service. The staff deserve particular recognition for their warmth, professionalism and thoughtful hospitality.

We enjoyed our stay so much that we have already booked another stay at Moire Hoi An for next year, and we are genuinely looking forward to returning.

It is a hotel we would confidently recommend to others.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Warm greetings from Moire Hoi An, Vignette Collection by IHG.

Thank you for sharing such thoughtful and generous feedback following your stay with us. We are truly delighted to know that the elegance and peaceful atmosphere of the hotel, together with the attentive care of our team, created such a positive and memorable experience.

Your recognition of our colleagues is especially meaningful. It is rewarding to hear that their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail made you feel genuinely well looked after throughout your visit. We are also pleased that our team was able to assist promptly and carefully when you contacted us regarding the item left behind.

We greatly appreciate your kind comments about the dining experience as well. Knowing that the beef pho became a favourite and that your dinner impressed through both presentation and quality will be wonderful encouragement for our culinary and service teams.

Most of all, we are honoured to know that you have already chosen to return next year. Your confidence in recommending Moire Hoi An is one of the most valued compliments we could receive, and we very much look forward to welcoming you back for another distinctive and memorable stay.

Sincerely,
Guest Relations Team

reviews.text:
The best decision of our trip—absolutely exceptional stay!

We were back and forth between staying in Da Nang or Hoi An, and choosing Moire Hoi An was the best decision we made! The location right on the river, just steps from the Ancient Town, is unbeatable. Watching the glowing lantern boats glide down the water in the evening from the property was pure magic.

The resort itself is stunning—modern, elegant, and spotless, with extremely comfortable rooms and a gorgeous riverfront pool setup.

Breakfast at Bistro Julienne was another huge highlight! The spread is impressive, featuring everything from hot international favorites to live stations serving local specialties like authentic Cao Lầu and Phở.

An absolute 5-star experience from start to finish. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text:
Positioned just across the bridge from Hoi An’s Old Town, Moire offers convenient access to major sights while remaining removed from the immediate noise.

Rooms are modern and comfortable, while breakfast provides well-portioned dishes served on warmed plates. Driver Michael provided a great transfer in a luxury Mercedes SUV, and Mimy at the Yellow Bicycle restaurant was exceptionally warm and welcoming, they were truly the only two staff members we genuinely liked and appreciated during our stay.

Regrettably, the hotel struggled with basic housekeeping, communication, service anticipation, and hospitality grace.

Although modern, our room was noticeably dirty in several spots (see attached picture), and throughout our two-night stay, dirty dishes were left uncollected in the hallway corridor for the entire duration of our visit.

Upon landing in Danang, being exhausted, we inadvertently forgot about our booked transfer and arranged a Grab; however, for a 5-star luxury hotel that had our flight number and WhatsApp contact, we expected a proactive call or heads-up upon landing rather than a message two hours later while we were already en route. Although we profusely apologized via chat and willingly paid for the transfer anyway, the lobby and check-in staff repeatedly brought up and dwelled on how long the driver had been waiting, making us feel unnecessarily guilty throughout the check-in process.

Furthermore, during a sudden rainstorm at the pool, staff ran for shelter holding umbrellas over themselves without offering assistance or umbrellas to guests trying to cover their belongings (see attached picture).

Lastly, the breakfast setup requires guests to walk to a booth just to order eggs that are later delivered to the table, and takeaway coffee is strictly prohibited, which felt unnecessarily restrictive for a boutique property.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Moire Hoi An for one night in a garden-view room, and it ended up being one of the best hotel experiences of our Vietnam trip.

From check-in, the staff made us feel very welcome. The welcome drink was delicious, and although the main lobby was under renovation, the hotel arranged a golf cart to take us to the check-in area, which made everything very smooth.

Our room was exceptionally clean, modern and beautifully designed. The fresh flowers on the table were such a nice touch and immediately made the room feel more special. The minibar was well stocked, the bathtub was large, and we also loved the hotel’s yellow colonial-style architecture.

What really made this stay memorable, though, was the staff. Harry was incredibly warm and helpful. He shared many recommendations about Hoi An, local food, Vietnamese coffee and Vietnamese culture, and talking with him added so much to our trip.

We also joined the hotel’s lantern boat activity in the evening. The bartender working on September 15 was wonderful. He made excellent cocktails, helped us take many beautiful photos, and spent time chatting with us during the boat ride. Since no other guests joined that evening, it almost felt like we had a private boat experience, and it became one of our favorite memories from Hoi An.

We also joined the complimentary Vietnamese coffee experience, which was both fun and interesting. It was a nice way to learn more about Vietnamese coffee culture and made the stay feel even more special. A big thank you as well to the staff member who led the activity on September 15 — we really enjoyed the experience and appreciated the warm and engaging introduction.

Breakfast by the river was also excellent. The view and atmosphere were beautiful, the food was delicious, and we especially enjoyed the freshly made salt coffee. The hotel also provides complimentary bicycles, and riding through the streets of Hoi An was a great experience.

The only downside was that construction noise outside our room was quite noticeable.

It would also be great if the hotel could offer more transportation options in the future, such as shuttle services to places like the coconut village or the beach.

Overall, the staff at Moire made our stay feel genuinely special. Their kindness, professionalism and willingness to share local culture made our Vietnam trip even better. We would absolutely stay here again.

Summary – (5/5) Excellent 4-night stay at the Moire Hoi An, a hotel that feels intimate but manages to maintain the professional feel of a true 5* property.

Group – 1 Family, 4 Adults, 1 x 2 yr old & 1 x 10-month-old, divided into 1 pool villa and 1 premium room.

Pre Arrival – (5/5)
This was a last-minute booking while escaping from another hotel, we had requested early check-in as front desk got in touch via whatsapp before arrival.

Check In - (5/5)
Early check-in was granted on the Premium room with the Villa being ready shortly after, both rooms were available before standard 3pm time which was much appreciated with 2 small children.

Villa - (5/5)
Spotless, modern, well maintained and looked after. Very good use of space for storage to keep the living spaces uncluttered. All amenities feel as a 5* should. The private pool & garden create a very nice contrast to the hustle and bustle of Hoi An old town and a place to relax and watch the lantern boats go by at night.

Service – (5/5)
With 2 small children we did quite a lot of in room dining, everything was delivered and cleared very promptly. Front desk would answer whatsapp questions or help with external bookings very efficiently. Everyone was genuinely helpful and conducted their duties with care and professionalism.

Food – (4.5/5)
The Vietnamese food was very good on par if not better than most restaurants we tried in the old town. The French food from Julienne restaurant was unfortunately not as good, not bad, but it did not live up to the same sort of expectations as the rest of the services in the hotel did. I suspect this is lack of regular use and chef experience; most people don’t come to Hoi An to eat French food.

Further Notes
• The prices of food, services and amenities are very competitive, my family dinners at the Vietnamese restaurant were comparable in price to higher tier local restaurants in town. Extra services such as airport transfer were also decently priced.
• Hotel grounds are exceptionally maintained.
• Free of charge bicycles also with child seat are a very nice touch.

reviews.text:
Being our first visit to Hoi an, we wanted somewhere conveniently located and Hoi An Moon Premium Boutique Hotel & Spa’s location is excellent, conveniently close to the Old Town yet in a peaceful area. Walkable to old town but lazy me prefer the comfort of the electric buggy.

The room was spacious, clean, and so comfortable, beautiful bathroom with a bathtub, super nice smelling toiletries. We also loved the lovely spa-like scent throughout the hotel.

As we stayed during the low season, breakfast on weekdays was ala carte but we were offered a complimentary lunch. Weekends buffet had live noodles/eggs section and a good range both local and western dishes.

What truly made our stay special was the incredible hospitality of every staff member, especially Bee. Everyone was so warm, friendly, and attentive, always greeting us with a smile and making sure we were comfortable. We genuinely felt at home, as if we were staying among family.

Thank you for making our stay so memorable. We would absolutely love to return and highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Hoi An!

hotelDescription:
A 12-minute walk from Chùa Cầu Nhật Bản (a 16th-century bridge built by Japanese residents), this upmarket hotel in a bright building is 5 km from the sandy shores of An Bang Beach.
 Polished rooms feature minibars, satellite TV and Wi-Fi, plus tea and coffeemakers; some add balconies and/or sleeping lofts. Upgraded rooms have open-air whirlpool tubs. Room service is available.
 Breakfast is offered. There's also an airy restaurant, as well as a trendy cafe/bar with terrace dining. An outdoor pool is designed on 2 levels with an adjacent bar. Other amenities include a spa, a gym, a beauty salon and kids' activities.

reviews.text:
I loved our stay at Almanity, truly a wellness resort with complete amenities (and kangen water!!!) and it’s a short walk to the old town.

Our driver Vu who made us feel so welcome when we landed, had a smooth and comfy ride to and from the airport. My bf arranged everything, so upon checking I was delighted to find birthday greetings everywhere - the bed, the cake, and the thoughtful handwritten note from Huyen. We got a nice big room with a lovely jacuzzi in the balcony.

Since we left our itinerary quite open, My was the one who helped us plan activities and arranged for a bike tour with Viet to the vegetable village. We did a bit of farming and learned a bit of cooking - with a foot bath and a quick massage in between! This was the kind of immersive experience we love .

The pool is relaxing and refreshing especially since we had hot days. Danh sorted us out with our much needed poolside iced coffees! This area is also where they hold a few minutes of tai chi in the mornings and afternoons, which I highly recommend to join. The ones who led the session were the receptionists of their massive spa, My Chi , which has a steam bath and sauna that i could live in!

Super thanks to Vu, Huyen, My, Viet, Danh, Dung, Lien and everyone here who made this trip memorable. Will definitely be back here when we visit Hoi An again!

Paradisical hotel! Beautiful pool, spa, gym, all with classy wellness vibe and free bike hire. Rooms are five star. Breakfast buffet the best I've ever had. Well-trained, super helpful and friendly staff, like Mini. Located between the beach and lattern-lit centre. Top marks. A must.
