reviews.text:
I am a resident of Hoi An and a regular guest who frequently enjoys the dining and other experiences at Almanity Hoi An. Because of this, I have always had a positive impression of the hotel and highly appreciated the quality of its services and hospitality.

However, I was genuinely disappointed by an incident that occurred yesterday at Four Plates Restaurant.

Yesterday, while I happened to be passing by the hotel and was in a hurry to attend to some urgent work, I suddenly needed to use the restroom. As I was in a rush, I entered the Four Plates Restaurant area and politely asked a staff member where the restroom was and whether I could use it. The staff member directed me to the restroom, and I followed the instructions accordingly.

However, after I finished using the restroom and was just walking out, the same staff member stopped me and informed me that, because I was not using any services at the restaurant, I was not allowed to use the restroom.

What surprised me even more was that I later realized this person was actually the restaurant manager.

I completely understand that the restaurant may have its own policies regarding the use of its facilities. However, if there is a policy stating that guests who are not dining at the restaurant are not permitted to use the restroom, I believe this could have been communicated to me from the beginning, before I used it. Having the staff direct me to the restroom and then stop me afterward to explain the policy made me feel very uncomfortable.

What disappointed me most was the way the manager communicated with me. I was even “instructed” on how I should speak or ask for permission if I wanted to enter the restaurant in the future. I genuinely do not understand why such a simple situation needed to be handled in a way that made me feel as though I had done something wrong.

I never intended to use any of the restaurant’s services without permission. From the very beginning, I specifically asked the staff member for permission before using the restroom. I also fully respect the rules and policies of both the hotel and the restaurant.

Therefore, what disappointed me was not simply whether I was allowed to use the restroom, but the way I was treated afterward. Being stopped by a restaurant manager and spoken to in a manner that made me feel as though I had done something inappropriate is something I genuinely did not expect from a five-star hotel.

I am not a tourist who simply happened to walk into Almanity. I live in Hoi An and am a regular guest who frequently uses the dining and other services at the hotel. Having had many positive experiences at Almanity, I find it even more disappointing that such a minor situation, which could easily have been handled with a simple and courteous explanation, instead left me feeling disrespected.

I sincerely hope that the Management Team will review this incident, particularly the way the situation was communicated and handled by the restaurant manager. I hope similar situations in the future can be handled in a more professional, thoughtful, and respectful manner, in line with the service standards that Almanity Hoi An aims to uphold.

I am sharing this feedback not because of a minor issue regarding the use of a restroom, but because I genuinely value my relationship with Almanity and care about the experience I receive as a regular guest. I hope that all guests, especially returning guests who regularly support the hotel, can always feel respected and treated with appropriate courtesy.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr. / Mrs. Jeanny Law,
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. As a returning guest who has supported Almanity on many occasions, your experience and comments are particularly meaningful to us.
We are genuinely sorry that this interaction left you feeling uncomfortable and disrespected. We have reviewed the incident with our team and understand that, although there was a misunderstanding regarding the use of the restaurant's facilities, the communication could and should have been handled more thoughtfully.
Our facilities are primarily provided for hotel guests and customers using our services. At the same time, we understand that someone passing by may occasionally have an urgent need to use a restroom. In such situations, our team should communicate the arrangement clearly and courteously from the outset, rather than allowing a misunderstanding to arise afterward.
We have therefore taken your feedback on board and will reinforce with our managers and colleagues that how we communicate a policy is just as important as the policy itself. A simple operational matter should never make a guest feel unwelcome or embarrassed.
We sincerely appreciate your continued support of Almanity and the fact that you took the time to tell us how this experience made you feel. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with the warm, thoughtful hospitality that you have experienced from us on previous visits.
Warm regards,
Phuong Le
Director of Operations

450 GUESTS - ONE JOURNEY TO DISCOVER A NEW FLAVOUR | BANH MI ANH CHÍN FESTIVAL 2026

The Banh Mi Anh Chín Festival 2026 brought new creations to the table, inviting 450 guests to taste, explore, and help answer one question: What could become the signature flavour of a new brand?

Staying true to the soul of Vietnamese Banh Mi while exploring fresh combinations inspired by local flavours, “Vietnamese Banh Mi with a Local Fusion Twist” marked the beginning of Anh Chín’s journey - a brand shaped by flavour, stories, and, most importantly, the voices of those who tasted it.

A signature flavor in the heart of the Old Quarter

Leave behind the rush of everyday life and enjoy crispy, freshly baked Banh Mi at Emerald Hoian, set against a stunning green backdrop right by the pool.

Visit our charming little Banh Mi stall, built from rustic bamboo and thatch to evoke the authentic feel of a Vietnamese village. Here, you will taste an irresistible twist on tradition: savory charcoal-grilled skewered meat paired with rich, authentic Vietnamese sausage. It’s the ultimate midday treat to recharge your energy after a refreshing swim!

CULINARY DISCOVERY 

Discover the flavors of Central Vietnam through a cooking class at Emerald Hoi An Riverside. Guided by our local chefs, you’ll learn how to prepare each dish and turn familiar ingredients into authentic local flavors.

A fun and memorable way to experience Hoi An’s cuisine and take a taste of your journey home with you.

MEET. CONNECT. INSPIRE 

A professional, tranquil, and inspiring space for meetings, seminars, or important gatherings.
At Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort, our meeting room is designed to ensure every gathering is not only productive but truly enriching, set amidst lush greenery and the peaceful rhythm of life along the Hoi An River.

Meet – Connect – Create memorable moments together.

After wandering through the ancient streets, strolling along the Hoai River, or exploring the beauty of Hoi An, your body deserves a moment of stillness to rest and recover.

Let Emerald Spa be your ideal destination, where all your senses are relaxed in a tranquil space and intensive treatments help relieve stress, release fatigue after a long day, and regenerate positive energy and balance for both body and mind.

BBQ BUFFET DINNER – GREAT FLAVORS, LIVE MUSIC & RELAXING MOMENTS

Gather your family and friends for an unforgettable evening at BBQ Buffet Dinner at Oasis Restaurant – Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort.
Indulge in a generous buffet featuring fresh seafood, premium grilled meats, hot dishes, fresh salads, and delicious desserts, all carefully prepared by our talented culinary team in a warm and relaxing atmosphere.

🎶 Adding to the experience, enjoy live music performed by our Filipino band, creating the perfect ambiance for a memorable night.

reviews.textTranslated:
Koreans, please take a look. Complaints.

I was satisfied with the accommodation itself considering the price, and it was nice swimming while looking at the river.

However, you thoughtless Korean parents, please, straighten up your behavior.

It is not education to let your kids throw dozens of stones into the pool just because your child is the best. Not only does it dirty the water, but there are 10 to 22 stones piled up on the bottom; don't you think about the other guests?

If you want to play in a public pool while abroad, please get some common sense. If you don't like that, go to a private pool villa instead.

The staff check the water quality every 1 to 2 hours, but perhaps because of the reviews, they didn't say a single word while the lower elementary kids were throwing stones. They don't even pretend to listen when my father says a word.

If I gave a low rating, it wouldn't climb to the top, and I felt sorry for the hotel, so I gave it a perfect score. Considering how many Koreans visit Da Nang, it is obvious that if I say one wrong thing, they will spread hell on affiliate communities like Mom Cafe and Da Nang Dokkaebi, and then downplay my criticism to just one or two stars to prove they were right. So naturally, I am afraid to speak up. Nevertheless, I will send an email directly to the hotel asking them to stop this kind of behavior.

Please, get some common sense. Is having a child your greatest achievement? I feel sorry for the children growing up under such parents, and I am afraid of encountering them in society in the future.

I am ashamed to be of the same nationality as them.

한국인들 꼭 보세요. 불만.

숙소 자체는 가격대비 만족했습니다 강바라보면서 수영하기도 좋았구요

그런데 무개념한 한국 ☆부모☆들 제발 행동 좀 똑바로 하세요

애들이 수영장에 돌 수십개씩 던져넣으면 우리애가 최고라서 냅두는게 교육이 아닙니다 수질이 더러워지는 것은 물론이고 바닥에 돌이 10~22개 쌓여있는데 이용객들 생각은 안하시나요?

해외나와서 공용 수영장에서 놀고 싶으면 개념은 탑재하세요 제발. 그게 싫으면 풀빌라 가시던지요

직원들 1~2시간에 한번씩 수질 체크하는데 리뷰때문인지 초등 저학년 애들 돌던지는데 한마디도 안하더라구요? 저희 아버지가 한마디해도 들은척도 안합니다

별점 낮게 달면 상위로 올라가지도 않을 뿐더러 호텔측 입장도 불쌍해서 만점 달아뒀습니다 다낭 한국인들이 얼마나 많이 오는데 말한마디 잘 못 했다가 맘카페부터 다낭도깨비 등등 제휴카페에 똥 싸지르면서 자기들이 잘했다고 돌 1~2개로 축소해서 글적을거 뻔하니까 말하기도 당연히 무섭죠 그래도 호텔측으로 직접 메일 넣어둘겁니다 이런일 제지해달라고요

제발 개념 탑재 좀 하세요 애있는게 최대업적들이세요? 그런 부모 밑에서 자라는 애들이 불쌍하고 향후 사회에서 만날까봐 두렵습니다

같은 한국인이라는게 쪽팔립니다

reviews.textTranslated:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel and would return in a heartbeat!

The location is fantastic – just a short walk to the Old Town. Our room was very spacious, cozy, and charmingly decorated, making us feel right at home.

We especially want to commend the outstanding staff. Everyone was incredibly friendly, attentive, and helpful. After a few days, they even started addressing us by our first names – which made our stay even more special.

The hot pot was a truly memorable experience. Mr. Quang prepared it for us, and it was one of the best culinary experiences of our entire trip to Vietnam. It was absolutely delicious! Ms. Uyen also took wonderful care of us and was incredibly accommodating at all times.

Many thanks to the entire team for the lovely time and the warm hospitality. We would definitely return and wholeheartedly recommend this hotel!
reviews.text:
Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in diesem Hotel und würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

Die Lage ist super – man braucht nur wenige Minuten zu Fuß bis zur Altstadt. Unser Zimmer war sehr groß, gemütlich und wirklich süß eingerichtet, sodass wir uns direkt wohlgefühlt haben.

Besonders hervorheben möchten wir das ausgezeichnete Personal. Alle waren unglaublich freundlich, aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Nach einigen Tagen wurden wir sogar schon persönlich mit unseren Vornamen angesprochen – das hat den Aufenthalt für uns noch besonderer gemacht.

Ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis war der Hot Pot. Herr Quang hat ihn für uns zubereitet und es war eine der besten kulinarischen Erfahrungen unserer gesamten Vietnam-Reise. Es hat wirklich hervorragend geschmeckt! Auch Frau Uyen hat sich sehr herzlich um uns gekümmert und war jederzeit unglaublich zuvorkommend.

Vielen Dank an das gesamte Team für die schöne Zeit und die herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen und können das Hotel von Herzen weiterempfehlen!

title: Private pool villa in quiet village, only 10 minutes walk to Hoi An ancient town
description: Villa • Sleeps 12 • 6 bedrooms • 7 bathrooms
address: Hoi An, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Hoi An is home to this villa. Hoi An Night Market and Hoi An Market are worth checking out if shopping is on the agenda, while those wishing to experience the area's natural beauty can explore An Bang Beach and Cua Dai Beach. Reaching Out - Hoa Nhap Handicrafts and Thanh Ha Pottery Village are also worth visiting. 
Hoi An Ti Hon House is nestles in a quiet village and yet right in the middle of the city. In the distance, the peaceful Thu Bon River is flowing across and the beautiful rice fields bend along the winding village roads. If you want to choose a peaceful getaway and convenient location in Hoi An, look no further than Sitting at the Ti Hon House. The house is located between Thanh Ha pottery village and Hoi An Ancient Town, about 7 minutes walk from the old town, 2km from An Bang beach, and 25km from Da Nang airport. With a convenient location where you can easily visit all the monuments of Hoi An. The Ti Hon House consists of 6 bedrooms, all of which have balconies overlooking the outside scenery and are furnished with elegant rustic furniture. Full amenities such as TV, Air-conditioner, private bathroom……., and others have a kitchen. There is a swimming pool located next to a beautiful small garden. Organize all the tours around and near Hoi An, promising to leave you with great memories. Our passion is to give you a memorable authentic experience. So you will want to come back before you leave.

La Siesta Hotel truly exceeded all our expectations! We were amazed not only by its stunning beauty, beautiful architecture, and gorgeous swimming pool, but above all, by the exceptional attention to detail and outstanding hospitality.

Every member of the staff was incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming. The level of service was simply impeccable, and they made us feel truly special throughout our stay.

We were pleasantly surprised by a beautiful decoration prepared for our honeymoon, which made our experience even more memorable.

A very special thank you to Quynh (Chloe), who went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. She was always attentive, recommended wonderful places to visit, introduced us to delicious traditional Vietnamese dishes at the hotel, and checked on us every single day to make sure we were enjoying our stay.

Every evening, we returned to our room to find a thoughtful little surprise, whether it was a cup of tea, some water, or a lovely handwritten message. These small but meaningful gestures made us feel genuinely cared for.

We will forever cherish the beautiful memories we made at La Siesta. Thank you to the entire team for making our honeymoon so special. We will never forget our time here and sincerely hope to return someday soon!

Highly recommended! ❤️

hotelDescription:
On An Hoi island, surrounded by the Thu Bồn River, this upmarket hotel with views of the Ancient Town is 6 km from An Bang beach and 29 km from Da Nang International Airport.
 Featuring river and/or town views, the warmly decorated rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes, as well as minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; many add private balconies. Suites come with living areas; some are bi-level. Family quarters are available. Room service is offered.
 Complimentary perks consist of a beach shuttle, loaner bikes, and a breakfast buffet served in an airy restaurant. There's also a bar, a gym and an outdoor pool.

From the moment we walked in, Mr. Tung made us feel incredibly welcome. He was absolutely amazing, taking the time to sit us down, explain everything and ensure we were comfortable. Within just 10 minutes of checking in, he had arranged an upgrade to a beautiful Riverfront King Room on a higher floor. As if that wasn’t already incredible, we were also treated to complimentary evening high tea, which was hands down one of the most luxurious, elegant and memorable experiences we have ever had. The attention to detail and generosity exceeded all our expectations.

We also booked our coconut basket boat experience through the hotel, and everything was organised seamlessly. Our driver picked us up directly from the hotel, and on the way back, when we asked if we could visit the pottery village, he happily dropped us off at no extra cost. These thoughtful gestures really show how much the team cares about its guests.

The resort itself is absolutely beautiful, with a tropical atmosphere, stunning river views and a lovely swimming pool that makes the whole place feel like a little paradise. With the river flowing alongside the property and beautiful views on both sides, it is such a peaceful and relaxing place to stay.

The buffet breakfast was another highlight. The selection was fantastic, and we enjoyed some of the best traditional Vietnamese food we have ever tasted. One particularly lovely touch was watching a lady handcrafting fresh Vietnamese rice paper rolls right there in the buffet area. Everything was delicious, and the quality of the food was exceptional.

Every staff member we encountered was warm, friendly and welcoming, but Mr. Tung deserves a very special mention. His kindness, professionalism, genuine hospitality and willingness to go above and beyond made our stay truly unforgettable. He made us feel valued and cared for, and he is an absolute credit to the resort.

We cannot thank the entire team enough for making our three days in Hoi An so special. It is rare to find a hotel where the facilities, food, atmosphere and hospitality are all this exceptional.

If you are visiting Hoi An, we wholeheartedly recommend Rivertown Resort & Spa! We would return in a heartbeat and would love to see Mr. Tung and the wonderful team again.

Thank you for making this such a beautiful and unforgettable experience. We will always remember our stay here! ❤️

The villas are exquisite - there’s a huge amount of space, free mini bar, towels regularly replaced, a beautiful private pool, I could go on and on about the amenities available.  There are free bikes to get round the resort and go into town, although we walked in a few times too.  There are loads of free gym and yoga sessions, free shuttle boats into town, different classes on option and then the free spa sessions, they were out of this world. reviews.text:
My first Vietnam trip = NAMIA. 🇻🇳✨

I originally chose Vietnam for this trip because I wanted to stay at InterContinental Danang. It was exactly my kind of hotel. But for just one night, I worried that the location might mean seeing very little beyond the resort.

Then I found Namia River Retreat — and choosing Namia completely changed the trip.

Our private villa came with its own pool, the food was fantastic, the farm-to-table concept was such a lovely touch, and the whole property had this incredibly peaceful atmosphere. 🌿

The breakfast was especially memorable. The bánh xèo was so crispy and delicious that we ordered it several times. In fact, everything we tried was so good that every meal became something to look forward to.

There were also so many activities and experiences to enjoy that we wished we had more time. We wanted to try everything, but our stay was simply too short. If we visit again, we would love to stay longer and fully enjoy everything Namia has to offer.

And one of the biggest perks? A 90-minute spa treatment is included in the stay. 🙌

Yes — 90 minutes. Included.

And this is not your typical hotel spa. I could write a whole separate review about it, but I’ll simply say:

Just go. Experience it for yourself. You’ll understand. 🤍

Then there was Tuyen.

We were celebrating a birthday, so this was already a special trip for us. From before we even arrived, Tuyen helped arrange our spa and sunset cruise, sent thoughtful reminders before our reservations, and our buggy was waiting for us before we even had to ask. 😂

Tuyen also arranged a river-view upgrade for us, and the view was absolutely beautiful. 🌅 For a one-night stay, that thoughtful gesture meant even more. It made our short stay feel incredibly special.

At one point, I actually thought:

“Wait… do we have a personal butler now?” 😂

That’s how attentive the service felt.

And then came the 4 PM late check-out.

For a one-night stay?!

FOUR. PM. 😭😂

I didn’t even know that was possible.

The Vietnamese afternoon heat had me a little nervous about spending the day outside, but the extra time meant we could slow down and enjoy our private pool, the river view, the spa, and simply do absolutely nothing.

And that is exactly what a retreat should feel like. 🤍

Beyond the beautiful villa, the food, and the facilities, it was the thoughtful hospitality that stayed with us.

Tuyen made our first Vietnam experience one we’ll always remember — not just as a beautiful stay, but as a very special birthday trip filled with moments we’ll treasure. ❤️

So now, when I think of Vietnam…

Vietnam = Namia.

If you’re looking for another typical five-star hotel, there are plenty of them.

But if you want a true retreat — private, peaceful, beautifully designed, with incredible food, a 90-minute spa included, plenty of activities, and service that feels genuinely personal — choose Namia.

Don’t overthink it.

Just go. You’ll understand. 🌿✨

And if Tuyen is your host, you’re in very good hands. 🤍

What really sets Namia apart for me is the wellness component. The included daily spa treatment is something I rarely see, and it became one of my favorite parts of the stay. The riverside sauna and cold plunge were equally fantastic and added to that feeling of truly being on a retreat.

The staff could not have been warmer or friendlier. Service felt genuine and personal throughout my stay.

I also think they have absolutely nailed the location. You are close enough to Hoi An to easily enjoy the restaurants, shops, and energy of town, but removed enough that when you return to Namia, it feels like your own peaceful little oasis along the river.

For clients looking for Hoi An with a strong sense of place, exceptional food, wellness, and a little more tranquility, this is a property I will happily recommend. I would absolutely return myself.

reviews.text: Excellent value.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A beautiful, authentic Vietnamese homestay that truly feels like home ❤️

I honestly cannot recommend Tan Doan An Bang Homestay highly enough. Tan and his beautiful Vietnamese family have a wonderful way of making you feel like part of their home.

The homestay itself is beautiful, clean, comfortable and incredibly well priced. The rooms are huge, with a lovely comfortable bed, a big TV, a spacious bathroom and plenty of storage for your clothes and belongings. There is a separate entry for guests and the pool is wonderful.

The location is also perfect, tucked away down a little quiet alley off the main street. You’re close to all the restaurants, cafés and everything A Bang has to offer, while still having peace and quiet. From the other side of the homestay, it’s just a short walk down the alley to the beach. You really couldn’t ask for a better location.

What makes this place so special is the family. Each morning I’ve been offered fresh fruit and coffee. I’ve been unwell during my stay and Linh has been incredibly caring and thoughtful by making me warm ginger drinks and looked after me when I wasn’t feeling well. That kindness and genuine care has meant so much to me. Thank you so much, Tan, Linh and your beautiful family, for welcoming me into your home and making me feel so cared for. ❤️

If you’re looking for somewhere authentic, peaceful, comfortable, affordable and genuinely welcoming while staying at An Bang Beach, this is the place to stay. 🇻🇳❤️

Sol An Bang is a worthwhile option for those who want to enjoy a relaxing holiday in Hoi An, especially travelers who love the peaceful atmosphere and intimate beauty of An Bang beach.

What makes Hoi An so attractive is not only its ancient town with its brightly lit lantern-lined streets, but also the slow, gentle moments spent by the sea. Staying at Sol An Bang, guests have the opportunity to enjoy the relaxed pace of life and discover the unique beauty of this land.

We hope the hotel will always maintain its high-quality service, clean spaces, and attentive hospitality so that every guest feels comfortable as if they were at home.

reviews.text:
We booked a room at the last minute while staying in Hoi An. Mai, Nhan and Loi at reception (and Thung in the restaurant) made the process easy and straightforward, and were extremely gracious and understanding when we faced some external difficulties at the end of our stay. We can’t thank them enough for helping us to have the best possible experience under tricky circumstances.

If you want to be near the action, but not right in it, this is the place for you. It is situated just south of the very busy An Bang Beach area, a short ride on a free push bike. The street is a little quieter and away from the hustle of tourists, but hosts a couple of amazing live music venues just across the road and some fantastic restaurants in the resort, and just down the street.

The resort has excellent views of the Cham Islands, and a lovely natural setting between the rooms and the beach, with bespoke swings, seating areas and lounges that are fun and relaxing. A choice of 3 pools is also a bonus. (At this time the beach is under construction due to a natural disaster late last year, however this didn’t impact on our stay too much)

We had a really lovely stay here, and wouldn’t hesitate to return.

Thanks again to the wonderful staff here! 🥰

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in diesem Hotel und können es wirklich von Herzen weiterempfehlen! Besonders das Spa war für uns ein absolutes Highlight. Wir waren während unseres gesamten Aufenthalts jeden Tag dort und es war wirklich jedes einzelne Mal unglaublich perfekt. Von der Atmosphäre über die Anwendungen bis hin zum Service hat einfach alles gestimmt. Wir konnten wunderbar entspannen und haben uns jedes Mal rundum wohlgefühlt.

Aber auch das Hotel insgesamt hat uns begeistert. Es ist ein Ort, an dem man sich einfach wohlfühlt, abschalten und den Aufenthalt in vollen Zügen genießen kann. Die gesamte Erfahrung war etwas ganz Besonderes und hat unseren Urlaub noch schöner gemacht.

Wir können dieses Hotel wirklich jedem ans Herz legen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Ein rundum perfekter Aufenthalt! ✨❤️

reviews.text: Such a lovely and relaxing stay at Aira Boutique Hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, the location near An Bang Beach was perfect, and all the staff were so friendly and welcoming. We really enjoyed our time here ❤️

I had an amazing stay at this hotel! The room was beautiful, spacious, and very clean. The staff were incredibly kind, friendly and helpful. They made me feel very welcome and well taken care of. I would definitely recommend this hotel to everyone. It is honestly one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at. I would love to come back again! Aira boutique is number one!👍👍

reviews.textTranslated: It is right in front of An Bang Beach, and the room condition is good. The balcony is a bit small for sitting and drinking a beer. The breakfast has limited options, but each item is delicious. I think you shouldn't expect much from the swimming pool; it was smaller than I thought. Perhaps because An Bang Beach itself is quiet, it seems perfect for a peaceful rest without any noise at all.
reviews.text: 안방비치 코앞이고 룸 컨디션 좋습니다. 발코니에 앉아서 맥주 마시기엔 조금 작아요. 조식은 가짓수는 적지만 하나하나 맛있어요 수영장은 기대하지마시는게 좋을것 같아여 생각보다 더 작더라구여. 안방비치 자체가 조용해서 그런지 정말 소음 하나 없이 조용히 쉬기엔 딱인거 같아요

I would love to come back to Aira Hotel, located right next to An Bang Beach.

Compared to Da Nang city center or Hoi An Old Town, this area is much quieter, and you can really feel the peaceful and authentic charm of a small seaside village. The staff were also incredibly kind and welcoming.

From check-in to breakfast and check-out, they took great care of us with thoughtful attention to detail. They also checked our schedule and kindly helped us whenever needed.

The room was beautiful, the bedding was very comfortable, and although the pool was not very large, it was 1.4 meters deep, which made it perfect for enjoying a proper swim.

If you are looking for the relaxed atmosphere of An Bang Beach and genuinely kind people, I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.textTranslated: We stayed four nights as a family and had a wonderful time. The hotel is very clean, very close to the beach, restaurants, and various shops. The breakfast was very good and varied, served right next to the pool and in a beautiful, well-kept garden. Thanks to all the staff, who were always very kind ❤️
reviews.text: Siamo stati quattro notti in famiglia e ci siamo trovati benissimo. L’hotel è molto pulito, vicinissimo alla spiaggia ai ristoranti ed ai vari negozi. Molto buona e varia la colazione servita proprio a fianco della piscina ed in un bel giardino molto curato. Un ringraziamento a tutto lo staff che è stato sempre gentilissimo ❤️

First, I would highlight the dedication and efficiency of the team to make our stay a true pleasure: target achieved! Our familly (2 adults, 2 teanagers and 1 kid) really enjoyed the stay 😄.
I confirm that photos are a bit old and that a part of the hotel is no more attached (now Daisy Retreat) but the essential remains: comfortable rooms, permanent cleaning, truely helpful people. The hotel, especially the garden would benefit from a slight renewall but it remains at remarquable level that near the sea. Kids enjoyed the swimming pool everyday.
Breakfast was a pleasure everyday with stable basics but also various / varying local food 😋. The restaurant was as simple as good tasting. It would deserve to be better known according to me.
Overall: Aira is in our top-3 hotels of our Vietnam journey 👍.

reviews.textTranslated: We spent eight nights at the Aira Boutique Hotel in An Bang in August and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. This small, family-run hotel is perfectly situated amidst restaurants and shops, just a one-minute walk from the beach (though it doesn't have its own private beach area or sun loungers). There's a pool bar and a beautiful garden, as well as laundry service and massage. Breakfast is delicious; we didn't try the hotel restaurant as there are plenty of other dining options nearby. We used the hotel as a base for all our activities (and they were happy to help with the organization). We highly recommend Aira and will definitely return when we're in Hoi An again.
reviews.text: Wir waren im August 8 Nächte im Aira Boutique Hotel in An Bang und haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Das kleine, familiäre Hotel liegt perfekt inmitten von Restaurants und Geschäften, nur 1 Minute vom Strand entfern (es hat aber keinen eigenen  Strandabschnitt und dazugehörige Liegen). Es gibt eine Poolbar und einen wunderschönen Garten, sowie Wäscheservice und Massage. Das Frühstück ist lecker, das Restaurant haben wir nicht getestet, das es rundherum genug Essensmöglichkeiten gibt. Wir nutzen das Hotel als Ausgangspunkt für sämtliche Aktivitäten ( bei deren Organisation auch geholfen wird). Wir können Aira komplett empfehlen und kommen wieder, wenn wir in Hoi An sind.

title: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort and Spa
description: Polished beachfront resort offering free loaner bikes, plus 3 bars, a spa & a restaurant.
address: Beach, Âu Cơ, Street, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 840511, Vietnam
plusCode: V9W9+7W Hoi An Dong, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set between the Thu Bon River and the sea, this upscale beachfront resort is 5 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics and 6 km from the 16th-century Japanese Covered Bridge.
 Sophisticated rooms with furnished balconies offer free Wi-Fi; upgraded rooms add river or garden views. Polished suites feature separate living areas, flat-screen TVs and whirlpool tubs. Some have outdoor showers. Room service is available,
 There are free loaner bikes, plus 2 tennis courts, 3 bars and a restaurant, Other amenities include an infinity pool, a gym, and a spa with a sauna and a hot tub.

reviews.text: Me and my wife stayed at this Resort from the 28/8/2026 until 4/9/2026 this was my first time in this resort but my wife has stayed there 3 times but everything was just great the staff were very friendly and the service was exceptional the staff remembered my wife from her previous visit and one staff member Cu'c really went out of her way in making us very welcome and looking after us on our stay. It was a shame that we never got to see her the day we left as it was her day off but the hole resort was just great breakfast was fabulous and we had a deal where you could have a lunch meal in the day or dinner at night and after dinner a cocktail every night we stayed. Great massage and a lovely pool to relax in and if we go back to Vietnam which we will as we are looking forward to heading back again next year and it will be back to Victoria Beach and spar Resort as this is like a home away from home. Thank you Victoria Beach and spar Resort for looking after us on our stay and looking forward to heading home again next year. 10 out of 10 for your hospitality. Regards Mark Eschbach and Angie Kennedy Australia
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Angus,
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful review following your recent stay at Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa.

We are delighted to hear that you and your wife had such a memorable experience with us. It is especially heartwarming to know that, after your wife’s previous visits, you both felt so welcomed and that our team made you feel at home during your stay.

We are very pleased that you enjoyed our breakfast, dining benefits, cocktails, massage and relaxing pool, and we truly appreciate your kind words about our service and hospitality.

We would also like to thank you for your special mention of Cu’c. We will certainly share your lovely compliments with her and the rest of our team. We are sorry that you did not get the chance to say goodbye before departing, but we are sure she will be delighted to know how much you appreciated her care and attention.

Knowing that Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa feels like a “home away from home” is the greatest compliment we could receive. We are thrilled to hear that you are already looking forward to returning to Vietnam next year, and we sincerely hope to welcome you and your wife back for another relaxing and memorable stay.

Thank you once again for your generous 10 out of 10 rating and for choosing to stay with us.

Warmest regards,
The Management Team

reviews.textTranslated:
Beautiful, atmospheric, rather intimate, excellent service, beautiful rooms, quiet, peaceful, with a pool, and right by the sea. A place definitely worth recommending. A little paradise in Vietnam.
Thank you to all the staff for their high-class service, and since I can't name everyone, at least Nga and the security guard, Minh, are truly wonderful!
A few words about the beach by the sea – the waterfront renovations mentioned by others don't interfere at all. The beach and access to the sea are impeccable. In the distance, a maintenance barge can be heard, but you might not be able to hear it. We may have just arrived at the end of the work.
reviews.text:
Pięknie, klimatycznie, raczej kameralnie, świetna obsługa, piękne pokoje, cisza, spokój, basen, a do tego przy samym morzu. Miejsce zdecydowanie godne polecenia. Taki mały raj w Wietnamie.
Dziękujemy całej obsłudze za wysokiej klasy serwis, a ponieważ nie moge wymienić wszystkich, to przynajmniej Nga i pan z ochrony Minh - jestescie naprawde świetni !
Dwa słowa o plaży przy morzu - wspomniene przez innych remonty nabrzeza w niczym nie przeszkadzają. Plaża i dostęp do morza bez zarzutu. W oddali barka remontowa, ktorej nie słychać. Możliwe, że trafiliśmy na końcówkę prac.

reviews.text: Me and my wife loved this place we arrived on the 28/8/2026 and left on the 4/9/2026. it it's my first time here but my wife has just had her 3 rd stay at Victoria beach and spar resort all the staff were very welcoming on our vist and very polite one staff member was outstanding (Cu'c) was always there for our needs and she remembered my wife from her previous visit along with other staff members. We liked it there at the resort that we are coming back again very soon. Loved this resort. Kind Regards Mark Eschbach & Angela Kennedy  Young NSW Australia
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mark,
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful review following your recent stay at Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa.

We are delighted to hear that you and your wife had such a memorable experience with us. It is especially heartwarming to know that, after your wife’s previous visits, you both felt so welcomed and that our team made you feel at home during your stay.

We are very pleased that you enjoyed our breakfast, dining benefits, cocktails, massage and relaxing pool, and we truly appreciate your kind words about our service and hospitality.

We would also like to thank you for your special mention of Cu’c. We will certainly share your lovely compliments with her and the rest of our team. We are sorry that you did not get the chance to say goodbye before departing, but we are sure she will be delighted to know how much you appreciated her care and attention.

Knowing that Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa feels like a “home away from home” is the greatest compliment we could receive. We are thrilled to hear that you are already looking forward to returning to Vietnam next year, and we sincerely hope to welcome you and your wife back for another relaxing and memorable stay.

Thank you once again for your generous 10 out of 10 rating and for choosing to stay with us.

Warmest regards,
The Management Team
Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa

reviews.textTranslated:
They gave me a free foot massage voucher, so I went to get it after checking out, but they just soaked my feet in boiling water and told me to leave, saying it was over. I went to reception and asked if this was right, if it was proper to just soak my feet in water and leave, and they said it was. Lol. I’ve stayed at 5-star and 4-star hotels all my life, but I’ve never seen a place this clueless and crazy. They seemed to look down on Asians because they were dealing with foreigners. I will never go back.

It was the worst resort.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued guests,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that the complimentary voucher provided was specifically for a foot bath, not a foot massage. As our Front Desk team also explained during your visit, the foot bath consists of soaking the feet in warm water and does not include a massage treatment.

We understand that there may have been a misunderstanding regarding the voucher, and we regret if the experience was different from what you expected. We will continue to review how we communicate our complimentary services to ensure that the details are clear to our guests.

Regarding your comments about breakfast and our service, we appreciate you sharing your concerns, as guest feedback helps us identify areas where we can improve.

We sincerely regret that your stay did not leave you with a positive impression, and we wish you all the best.
With regards,
The Management team

reviews.textTranslated: Update 2026: My family returned and was still very satisfied. This year, the beach extends along the entire length of the resort, not just at the two ends like last year. The resort is beautiful, with a large swimming pool and a children's wading pool. After 6-7 pm, there are no lifeguards on duty, but adults can still swim 24/7. The rooms are spacious and well-equipped. The balconies and bathrooms are large, with a big bathtub. The atmosphere is very pleasant. The breakfast buffet is delicious and varied. The staff are friendly and enthusiastic, providing information about the resort and surrounding areas. The resort provides a shuttle bus to the old town and bicycles for guests to borrow. You can ask the staff for assistance in renting a motorbike. The environment is child-friendly. My family stayed for two nights and was very happy.

title: River Beach Resort & Residences
description: Polished rooms & suites, some with river views, in a bright hotel offering dining, a gym & a spa.
address: 05 Cửa Đại, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 560000, Vietnam
plusCode: V9W8+J2 Hoi An Dong, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Offering views of the De Vong River and the sea, this airy, riverside hotel is a 2-minute walk from Cua Dai Beach.
 Featuring dark wood furnishings and marble bathrooms, the polished rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking equipment. All rooms offer balconies, some with river views. Suites add living rooms.
 Freebies include parking and an area shuttle. There’s a lively bar, and a restaurant with evening entertainment, plus an outdoor pool, a game room, and a private area on the beach. Other amenities consist of a fitness center and a spa. Activities such as cooking classes and fishing are available.

reviews.textTranslated:
Stayed from May 19th to 21st, 2025.

We spent three days there to enjoy Hoi An.

This hotel allowed us to relax between our walks in the old town and to enjoy Cua Dai Beach.

The hotel shuttles and taxis make it easy to get to the old town (5-10 minutes at most).

We benefited from very kind, helpful, and patient staff, given our limited English.

If the opportunity arises, we will gladly return to this hotel.

My favorite place to stay whenever I come to Hoi An is here.

I love the prices, the rooms, the food – everything. I especially love everyone at the resort: Nguyen, Lan Anh, Tien, and so many others whose names I didn't get a chance to ask, especially the lovely kitchen staff. Every time I asked for the pho broth to be too strong, they'd fix it the next day. 🥹🥹🥹

The peaceful morning scenery and the absolute tranquility every evening (during my stay) are incredibly wonderful experiences that no one visiting Hoi An should miss.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – A Wonderful Stay at River Beach Resort!

I recently stayed at River Beach Resort in Hoi An, and it was one of the highlights of my trip to Vietnam. The resort has a relaxing atmosphere with beautiful river views, spacious rooms, and easy access to both the beach and the Old Town.

What really made my stay special was the incredible staff.
• Anna was warm, professional, and always ready to help with anything I needed.
• Superman lived up to his name—full of energy, super friendly, and always going the extra mile to make guests smile.
• Money was wonderfully attentive and made sure every detail of my stay was perfect.
• Lily greeted me each morning with kindness and excellent service, making breakfast one of the best parts of the day.

Their hospitality made the resort feel like home. I truly appreciated the personalized service and genuine care from each team member.

If you’re visiting Hoi An and looking for a place with great views, great comfort, and truly great people, River Beach Resort is the place to stay. Highly recommended! 🌴✨

Perfekt schönes Hotel sehr freundliches Personal

We stayed at the hotel for 6 nights, on arrival we were told we had been upgraded to a river view with 2 king/queen size beds. We were greeted with a drink and a friendly face who has the name of Anna 😁. The view from the balcony overlooking the river was lovely and very peaceful. The hotel garden's were very well maintained and looked picturesque. We found the staff here to be far more accommodating than the first we stayed in and they also spoke or understood English more. They told us there was a separate bar to which we used every night and the guy who worked there was so nice. He spoke very little english but we started to communicate via a translator on our phones and he became a friend to us during our stay.( He also makes the best I love you cocktail compared to other places I tried) , so a big shout out to him. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and our conversations with Anna and lily both lovely ladies. For me Anna is the one who makes this hotel, she has such a lovely way with people and nothing is too much trouble, she goes above and beyond to help you. She spent so much of her time talking to us especially the day we left and we learnt so much from her. The hotel is very lucky to have this lady working for them a true star. I would also like to thank the hotel for the birthday cake for my husband and for the coconut biscuits on departure a nice touch. We would happily return to the hotel and revisit some amazing people we met.

reviews.textTranslated:
Relaxing requires effort.
There are a huge number of pushy scalpers.

When you're riding your bike to the parking lot, you risk running into any local who will tell you you can't go any further and have to leave your bike there and pay them 30,000 rubles.
Generally, if you manage to get through, you'll pay 30,000 rubles for parking at the beach.

There are sun loungers on the beach, and restaurants claim they're free when you order drinks and food, but the loungers are full of aggressive old ladies who insist this isn't true and that you still have to pay 50-75,000 rubles for a sun lounger. We fought back persistently and managed to get our sun loungers for buying them at the restaurant.
The prices in the restaurants are simply unrealistically high by local standards. A meal costs 150-300,000 rubles, sometimes more.

You won't be able to lie down either - there are crowds of pushy bracelet sellers.
reviews.text:
Чтобы отдохнуть, нужно приложить усилия.
Огромное количество навязчивых спекулянтов.

Пока едешь на байке до парковки, есть риск нарваться на абсолютно любого местного, который скажет, что дальше нельзя, и тебе надо оставить байк тут и заплатить ему 30К.
В целом, если пробиться, у пляжа тоже отдашь 30К за парковку.

На пляже шезлонги, рестораны говорят, что при заказе напитков и еды, они бесплатны, но на шезлонгах сидят местные агрессивные бабули, которые говорят, что это не так, и тебе всё равно надо заплатить за лежачок 50-75К. Мы настойчиво отбивались, и у нас получилось получить свои лежачки за покупку в рестике.
Цены в ресторанах по местным меркам просто нереально высокие. Блюдо 150-300 тысяч, местами больше.

Полежать тоже не удастся - навязчивые торговцы браслетиками ходят косяками.

reviews.textTranslated:
My family arrived in Hoi An during a period of continuous rain, but our experience at Wyndham Garden Hoi An was still very pleasant.

What I liked most was the staff's enthusiasm, friendliness, and willingness to assist guests. Initially, we booked a garden-view room, but the hotel helped us upgrade to a sea-view room free of charge. We are truly grateful for their thoughtfulness!

The room was quite spacious, and I especially liked the bathtub because it was large and comfortable. One minor issue was that the bed in the original room made a slight noise when I turned over. I contacted the hotel, and they quickly helped us change rooms. Their handling of the situation was very helpful and pleasant.

Breakfast was quite good, with delicious food, and the breakfast area was airy and pleasant. The hotel is conveniently located near Cua Dai Beach. They also offer a free shuttle service to An Bang Beach and Hoi An Old Town, which is very convenient for families.

Despite the less-than-ideal weather, the whole family had a wonderful vacation. Overall, I was very satisfied, especially with the staff's service. This is a hotel I would consider returning to if I have the chance to visit Hoi An again.
reviews.text:
Gia đình mình đến Hội An đúng vào những ngày mưa liên tục, nhưng trải nghiệm tại Wyndham Garden Hoi An vẫn rất dễ chịu.

Điểm mình thích nhất ở đây là các bạn nhân viên rất nhiệt tình, dễ thương và luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ khách. Ban đầu nhà mình đặt phòng view vườn, nhưng sau đó được khách sạn hỗ trợ nâng hạng miễn phí lên phòng view biển. Thật sự rất cảm ơn các bạn vì sự chu đáo này!

Phòng khá rộng rãi, đặc biệt mình rất thích bồn tắm vì rộng và thoải mái. Có một điểm nhỏ là giường ở phòng ban đầu hơi phát ra tiếng động khi trở mình. Mình có phản hồi với khách sạn và các bạn đã nhanh chóng hỗ trợ đổi phòng. Cách xử lý rất nhiệt tình và dễ chịu.

Bữa sáng khá ổn, món ăn vừa miệng, không gian ăn sáng thoáng và dễ chịu. Khách sạn nằm ngay gần biển Cửa Đại nên vị trí rất thuận tiện. Ngoài ra còn có xe đưa đón miễn phí đến biển An Bàng và khu phố cổ Hội An, khá tiện cho những gia đình đi du lịch.

Dù thời tiết không ủng hộ lắm nhưng cả nhà vẫn có một kỳ nghỉ vui vẻ. Nhìn chung mình rất hài lòng, đặc biệt là thái độ phục vụ của nhân viên. Đây là một khách sạn mình sẽ cân nhắc quay lại nếu có dịp đến Hội An.

reviews.textTranslated:
Cua Dai Beach is generally quite nice. The sea is clean during peak season. There's not much trash. There are almost no stray snorkels🐕. Jellyfish🪼 and other biting sea creatures are also almost nonexistent. The bottom is smooth and sandy. A breakwater has been cleverly constructed near the shore, effectively dampening the waves. There are no tricky or treacherous currents in the water, but it's still not recommended to swim too far out...🏊‍♀️
There are almost no ships, no annoying boats, parachutes, or other activities. The views along the shore🌴 are beautiful. Da Nang is visible in the distance. Occasionally, construction occurs along the shore, shoreline reinforcement is done, or previously started hotels are being built.
You can stroll along the shore. There are small cafes serving cocktails and cold 🍻 beer.
There are quite a few picturesque abandoned and unfinished hotels. Looking at them, you think how fleeting everything is... 🤷‍♀️
There aren't many tourists. There are 🏨 hotels nearby, like the Wyndham, Coy, Victoria, Marriott, Alli, and others. But due to the exorbitant prices, people come for 1-2 days and quickly leave...
And, of course, there are crazy bloggers who are probably already asleep hugging their phones, filming everything, but that's rather rare...which is good news)))😄😄
reviews.text:
Пляж Куа Дай, в целом, неплох. Море в сезон чистое. Особого мусора не наблюдается. Почти нет бродячих оглоедов🐕. Всяческих медуз 🪼и прочих кусачих обитателей моря, также, почти нет. Дно ровное, песчаное. Недалеко от берега очень грамотно сооружен волнорез, который хорошо гасит волны. Хитрых и коварных течений в воде также не присутствует, но заплывать далеко все же не стоит…🏊‍♀️
Кораблей почти не плавает, нет назойливых катеров, парашютов и прочих активностей. Виды на берегу красивые🌴. Вдалеке виден Дананг. Иногда вдоль берега что-то строят, укрепляют береговую линию или продолжают строительство ранее начатых отелей.
Прогуляться вдоль берега можно. Есть небольшие кафе, где подадут коктейли и холодное 🍻 пивко.
Попадается немало живописных заброшенных и недостроенных гостиниц. Глядя на них, думаешь, как все быстротечно…🤷‍♀️
Туристасов не очень много. Рядом есть 🏨 отели, вроде Виндхэма, Кой, Виктории, Марриотта, Алли и пр. Но из-за чрезмерных ценников народ приезжает на 1-2 дня и быстро сваливает дальше…
И, конечно, встречаются сумасшедшие блогеры, которые, наверное, уже и спят в обнимку со все подряд снимающими телефонами, но это, скорее, редкость…что не может не радовать)))😄😄

reviews.textTranslated: We were shocked when we reached this beach. The colorful heart with the inscription "Cua Dai Beach" seems almost cynical given the devastating state of the surroundings. The beach has been completely destroyed and is unusable due to massive construction work. Excavators, construction vehicles, and torn-up sand are everywhere. But the worst thing is the atmosphere. Many buildings along the beach appear completely abandoned and dilapidated. You can't help but be reminded of a horror or zombie movie. A post-apocalyptic scene, the kind you usually only see in the cinema – only unfortunately, it's reality. There's no chance of relaxation. Anyone who comes here risks not just boredom, but a serious dose of depression. An absolute disappointment and zero stars if I could give that.
reviews.text: Wir waren schockiert, als wir diesen Strand erreichten. Das bunte Herz mit der Aufschrift "Cua Dai Beach" wirkt angesichts des verheerenden Zustands der Umgebung fast schon zynisch. Der Strand ist durch massive Bauarbeiten komplett zerstört und unbenutzbar. Überall Bagger, Baumaschinen und aufgerissener Sand. Aber das Schlimmste ist die Atmosphäre im Umfeld. Viele Gebäude am Strand wirken völlig verlassen und verfallen. Man fühlt sich unwillkürlich an einen Horror- oder Zombie-Film erinnert. Eine postapokalyptische Kulisse, wie man sie sonst nur aus dem Kino kennt – nur leider Realität. Von Erholung keine Spur. Wer hierher kommt, riskiert nicht nur Langeweile, sondern eine dicke Portion Depression. Ein absoluter Reinfall und null Sterne, wenn ich dies vergeben könnte.

reviews.text: Amazing hotel. Two lovely pools. Awesome breakfast. Friendly staff . Do the Vietnsm special banquet. Food and entertainment . Lantern making and clay models. Highly recommend. Had river view ground floor room . Beautiful views

I really enjoyed my time at Hoi An Beach Resort. The team was welcoming, attentive, and always ready to help. My room was spotless and cozy, and the resort’s unique setting between the river and the beach made the stay even more special. Breakfast offered a great variety of tasty options. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I would gladly recommend this resort to anyone visiting Hoi An. I look forward to staying here again!

reviews.textTranslated:
“Absolutely do not go to this truly terrible resort.”

An older female waitress at the restaurant is racist. Avoid her. I specifically experienced discrimination against Koreans.

She did not provide Koreans with the same seats she had given to Japanese guests.

The TV did not work due to system issues, and the beach was difficult to use because it was under construction.

The staff's service was incomplete and unfriendly.

On top of that, there was even a racist staff member...

The location was also far from the Old Town, the swimming pool was small, and the breakfast was meager. The extra bed provided made it difficult to sleep because it gave me back pain.

I have traveled to many places in Da Nang and Hoi An, but I want to tell you that this is the worst.

Don't be fooled by other reviews.

Dear Our Valued Guest,

Please accept our sincere apologies the beach construction,
Most importantly, we have taken your feedback regarding the alleged discrimination at our restaurant very seriously.
We consider this matter in high regard, as every guest deserves to be treated with fairness, respect, and kindness, regardless of their nationality. The experience you described is entirely inconsistent with the hospitality standards we strive to have
We expect to clarify that our hotel does not engage in any form of racial discrimination; all guests are treated with equal respect. Regarding to this situation, a table was already occupied by guests who arrived earlier before you therefore, it was not possible to reassign that table to you.
It appears there may have been a misunderstanding between you and our staffs at the restaurant
We sincerely apologize for any distress this incident may have caused you.
Again, thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention.
We value your feedback and hope you will allow us the opportunity to serve you in the future
Kind regards,
The Resort Management Team

reviews.textTranslated:
I had a wonderful experience at Hoi An Beach Resort, located at 01 Cua Dai Street, Hoi An. The resort boasts a lush, peaceful, and airy environment, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a vacation with family and friends.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and comfortable. The staff were friendly, enthusiastic, and always ready to assist guests with a professional and attentive attitude. I especially loved the close connection with nature and the tranquil atmosphere the resort provided.

The resort's location is also convenient for exploring Hoi An and surrounding attractions. Overall, it's a great choice for those seeking a comfortable vacation with good service and a peaceful setting.

I am very satisfied with my experience at Hoi An Beach Resort and will definitely return on future occasions. I will also recommend this place to my friends and family when they visit Hoi An!

Hoi An is definitely a worthwhile experience!
reviews.text:
Tôi đã có một trải nghiệm rất tuyệt vời tại Hoi An Beach Resort, địa chỉ số 01 Cửa Đại, Hội An. Khu nghỉ dưỡng có không gian xanh mát, yên bình và thoáng đãng, rất thích hợp để nghỉ ngơi, thư giãn và tận hưởng kỳ nghỉ bên gia đình, bạn bè.

Phòng nghỉ sạch sẽ, rộng rãi và thoải mái. Đội ngũ nhân viên thân thiện, nhiệt tình, luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ khách hàng với thái độ chuyên nghiệp và chu đáo. Tôi đặc biệt yêu thích không gian gần gũi với thiên nhiên cùng bầu không khí thư thái mà khu nghỉ dưỡng mang lại.

Vị trí của resort cũng thuận tiện cho việc khám phá Hội An và các địa điểm tham quan xung quanh. Nhìn chung, đây là một lựa chọn tuyệt vời cho những ai đang tìm kiếm một nơi nghỉ dưỡng thoải mái, chất lượng dịch vụ tốt và không gian yên bình.

Tôi rất hài lòng với trải nghiệm tại Hoi An Beach Resort và chắc chắn sẽ quay lại trong những dịp tiếp theo. Tôi cũng sẽ giới thiệu nơi này đến bạn bè và người thân khi có dịp đến Hội An!

Rất đáng trải nghiệm khi đến Hội An!

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a peaceful place away from the crowds and the city, I would definitely recommend this hotel. The staff are generally nice, especially Miss Hien, who was very kind and helpful.

The facilities are a bit outdated, and some rooms need renovation. The food was okay, but there could be more variety. The pho was the only dish that changed daily, while most of the other food stayed the same.

One thing we noticed was the service in the restaurant and bar. When I asked a girl at the bar for a bucket of ice, she seemed annoyed. The second time I needed ice, I decided to go to the bar myself because I didn’t want her to feel like I was ordering her around. We also felt that some restaurant and kitchen staff were warmer toward Western guests than Asian guests, which made us feel a little unwelcome.

Overall, most of the staff were friendly, and we enjoyed the peaceful location. With some renovation, more food variety, and more consistent hospitality, the experience could be much better.

reviews.text: Good place

This was mine and my partners second time staying with Hoi An Beach Resort and it was just as wonderful as the first time we stayed!

After having a bad experience with a different hotel, the reception staff went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable, even when I became unwell whilst waiting to check in! They were kind, caring and just really helpful.

The rooms and facilities are exceptional. They are clean, tidy, and well maintained. You can tell there is an attention to detail, and it definitely reflects the quality of the hotel.

I definitely look forward to staying with Hoi An Beach Resort in the future, as this hotel is just amazing in every way!

reviews.textTranslated:
There are many accommodation options in Hoi An. After looking around, I decided to stay a bit further out, where there would be much less noise from people and vehicles. It's about a 15-minute walk from the hotel to the Old Town. If it's not raining, it's not far to walk along the riverbank or the road. However, September is the rainy season, so it becomes a bit inconvenient when it rains, as there will be standing water along the way, and the sidewalks are not in good condition, full of potholes and often blocked by cars and motorcycles.

Welcome snacks were provided upon check-in. The hotel's floors 2-7 are the accommodation area, the first floor houses the lobby, swimming pool, bar, and dining area, and the basement contains a gym and spa. I chose a river-view room, specifically requesting a high floor, and the hotel provided a second-to-top floor. The view at night was truly beautiful; the lights of the riverside houses and the moonlight reflected on the riverbank, with occasional small boats carrying lanterns passing by. Although there were occasional horn sounds, the soundproofing was decent, and I wasn't disturbed much while sleeping at night. The bathroom had a separate shower and toilet, and the bathtub was quite large. A common problem with Vietnamese hotels seems to be unstable water pressure and hot/cold water; mold was also clearly visible. The equipment looked high-quality in photos, but in actual use, it felt like cheap, knock-off items.


The first floor is the breakfast dining area. When we went downstairs the next day, it was probably still too early; the Vietnamese didn't feel hot, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning. They only turned it on around 8 am when it got a little warm. On the third day, it rained, and the weather was cooler, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning either. The dining environment was clean, and the selection was quite good, much better than the supposedly four-star sea-view hotel we stayed at in Da Nang later. This time, we chose the hotel's spa. Firstly, we didn't have to travel long distances, and secondly, it was more comfortable to shower before the massage. The price was reasonable. Although they asked if we wanted a strong, regular, or gentle massage, it felt like they were just asking. The gentle massage felt a bit painful, while my wife's strong massage felt too soft. There were welcome snacks before the massage, but the staff stood in front of us, making it impossible to relax. The bamboo tube spa really involved rolling heated bamboo tubes over our bodies—it was so hot it hurt! It's more suitable for people who like a strong massage and have thicker skin.


This accommodation included one free airport transfer from Da Nang to the hotel. You'll see staff holding nameplates as you exit the airport. If you book through the hotel, the transfer to Da Nang costs 300,000 VND. Previous reviews mentioned that calling a Grab car is cheaper, and the hotel's rental cars weren't in great condition. Considering the rainy season and the potential difficulty in finding a ride, I booked through the hotel beforehand. The car used was a manual Vios, and it was indeed quite old, but the driver was okay.

In terms of price, there are probably more affordable accommodations in Hoi An, but a river-view room for less than 2,000 VND per night for six days is acceptable. It's about a 15-minute walk to the Old Town and about a 10-minute walk to the Hoi An Show. However, if you have elderly people or children, staying in the Old Town would be more convenient.
reviews.text:
會安住宿選擇蠻多的，看了一輪決定住在外圍一點的地方，人車聲音的干擾會少很多，從飯店走到古城區大概15分鐘左右，沒下雨的話沿著河岸走過去或走馬路不算遠，不過9月開始是雨季，下雨就會有點不方便，因為沿途會有積水，人行道也不算完善，坑坑洞洞之外也會有汽機車占據。

入住有迎賓小點心，飯店2-7樓是住宿區，1樓是大廳泳池跟酒吧用餐區，地下室是健身房跟SPA區，這次選了河景房，有特別註明要高樓層，飯店也給了次頂樓，晚上看出去真的蠻漂亮的，河邊房舍燈光與月光映照在河岸上，偶爾有提燈小船經過，雖然時不時有喇叭聲，但隔音還算可以，晚上睡眠的時候不太會被干擾，衛浴是乾濕分離，浴缸蠻大的，越南飯店的通病好像都是水壓跟冷熱水不穩，發霉的部分也清楚可見，設備看起來跟拍起來有質感，不過用起來就像掏寶貨啷啷的。

一樓是早餐用餐區，第二天下樓的時候，可能還太早，越南人覺得不熱所以沒開冷氣，快八點吃到有點熱的時候才開，第三天下雨，天氣比較涼爽，所以也沒有開冷氣，用餐環境乾淨，選擇也算多，比後來去峴港住的號稱四星海景飯店好多了；這次選了飯店的SPA，一是不用舟車勞頓，二是可以先沖個澡再按摩比較舒服，價格算合理，雖然會問要重手普通還是柔軟，但整體感覺起來就是問而已，要柔軟感覺偏痛，太太要重手感覺偏軟，開始之前也有迎賓小點心，不過服務人員會站在前面，沒辦法有放鬆感，竹筒SPA就真的是拿加熱竹筒在身上滾，熱到刺，比較適合喜歡重手加皮厚一點的人。

這次住宿有含一次免費峴港機場接送到飯店，出機場就會看到接送人員拿著姓名紙板，如果透過飯店訂，接送到峴港的費用是30萬盾，看到之前評論說自己叫GRAB會比較便宜，而且飯店叫的車況也不太好，考量到雨季可能不好叫車，所以還是先透過飯店訂了車，當天接送的車是手排VIOS，確實車況偏舊，不過司機態度還OK。

以房價來說，會安應該還有更多更便宜的住宿，但六日一晚不到兩千的河景房，走路到古城區大約15分鐘，到會安秀大約10分鐘，距離算可以接受，只是如果有長輩或小孩的話，住在古城區還是會方便一些。

reviews.textTranslated:
The rooms are clean and the view is better than anywhere else in the area, but the hallway is like a greenhouse and very hot. They don't turn on the air conditioning in the hallway, only in the rooms. Lizards might come up onto the balcony in the evening, but they don't enter the rooms. Also, there are flying cockroaches, typical of Vietnam, in the hallway; they do enter the rooms, but the probability is low because the room air conditioning keeps the temperature low.

The breakfast is on the smaller side in terms of variety and size, but the taste is above average. The pho changes daily with options like beef and chicken. The bread is French-style, which has a different texture than German bread, but I am satisfied. On days when stir-fried chicken is served, you can make a top-notch chicken banh mi by dipping a baguette in it.

The shower water in the bathroom is clean.

From midnight to 10 AM, a chicken from the next-door neighbor crows; by around 10 AM, it crows so loudly that its voice becomes hoarse, and then it stops, perhaps because its voice is hoarse.

The remote control stopped working because the battery died; it would have been nice if they had provided spare batteries.

reviews.textTranslated: This is a newly opened hotel that you can check out when you travel to Hoi An. The swimming pool is a nice touch, and the breakfast is also quite good!
reviews.text: 到會安旅遊可以參考的一家新開幕旅館～裡面的泳池小巧思還有早餐都很不錯！

I highly recommend this hotel. Location is great, very near the old town and there’s shops and restaurants nearby. Staff was also great. We had a problem with our room because of paint smell and they happily moved us to another room which was bigger than what we booked (free upgrade!). Breakfast selection was also so good.

They also offer van service to/from airport or Da Nang - price was super worth it especially if you’re a big group.

I have no complaints about this hotel. Truly a wonderful stay!

Cozy An Boutique Hotel is a lovely, quaint property in a great location, about a 10 minute walk from Hoi An’s Old Town.

The location was perfect for us as it’s not too busy and we could stroll into the old town along the river or via the road. Near the hotel there are plenty of restaurants, spas, minimarts, coffee shops and a laundromat all within easy walking distance. There’s also a newly opened sports bar with the largest tv screen in Hoi An a few doors down serving AMAZING hot pies.

The hotel is beautifully decorated and has a good sized swimming pool, free bicycles and a buffet breakfast with a good variety of options. There is also a small gym, although we didn’t use it as there are only a few pieces of equipment. The rooms are a decent size, clean and have a nice view. As we’re travelling with kids, we opted for a family interconnecting room, which was well priced and adequate for what we needed.

reviews.textTranslated:
I booked a room with a river view on the 7th floor and stayed for two nights.

The price was about 150,000 won for two nights.

I was also able to use the free pickup service from Da Nang, so I saved about 10,000 won on taxi fare.

Above all, the staff were incredibly friendly.

I was especially grateful for the local staff member who liked Korea and could speak a little Korean and treated me with such kindness.

The breakfast was fresh and delicious, and since it was served from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM, I liked being able to enjoy a leisurely breakfast compared to other hotels.

The swimming pool next door was also well-maintained, and I made good use of the free bicycle rental service.

If you know how to ride a motorbike, I recommend renting one for about 1.5 million VND per day.

It is really convenient for getting around the area.

Overall, I was very satisfied with the value for money, and the staff were incredibly friendly.

If I come back to Hoi An, this is a place I definitely want to stay at again.

title: Little Hoi An Boutique Hotel & Spa
description: Refined rooms & suites in a warm hotel offering sleek dining, a spa & a gym, plus river views.
address: 02 Thoại Ngọc Hầu, An Hội, Hội An, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam
plusCode: V8GF+94 Hoi An, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Overlooking the Thu Bồn River, this polished hotel in the city center is a 12-minute stroll from the bustling Hoi An Central Market.
 Warm rooms with French Colonial-inspired decor and wood furnishings offer views of the Old Town or the river. All provide free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, and tea and coffeemakers, plus minibars and safes. Suites add balconies with river views. Room service is available.
 Free perks include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's a sleek bistro with an open kitchen, a stylish lounge, and an outdoor pool with a bar. Other amenities include a spa and a gym. Cooking classes are available.

It truly felt like coming home. The hotel itself is a converted old house (unsurprising, right?), so of course some of the facilities can't be perfect. However, considering the price, overall it was very satisfying: clean, comfortable, cozy, convenient, and the attentive service was impressive. There were some outside noises at night, but I found it acceptable and not enough to affect sleep.

Dear Yunxiu,

Greetings from Hotel Petite Hoi An (Boutique Hotel & Spa)!

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your wonderful experience with us. We are delighted to know you had a warm and comfortable time here, feeling right at home.

We sincerely appreciate your appreciation for Kate's warm service, her recommendations for local cuisine, and her assistance with booking. We are always committed to providing personalized and thoughtful service, and we are delighted that Kate contributed to your positive experience.

We also appreciate your understanding regarding the historical preservation of the hotel building and the inherent limitations of some facilities. We are pleased to know that you generally found the hotel clean, comfortable, and conveniently located, and that our service impressed you.

Regarding the noise issue at night, we greatly appreciate your understanding. We are committed to creating a peaceful and relaxing environment for all our guests and will continue to improve.

Thank you again for your positive review. We look forward to your next visit and another unforgettable experience!

Sincerely,

Hotel Management Team

We booked three rooms for one night and were pleasantly surprised to be upgraded to better rooms upon arrival. The river views were amazing and really elevated the experience.
Check-in was smooth and welcoming.
The staff member who first assisted us was especially friendly and informative (unfortunately I didn’t catch his name). The beds were very comfortable, and the air conditioning worked perfectly.

Breakfast, which was included, was outstanding—especially the made-to-order omelets. In the evening we had a few drinks at the bar, and the two servers who helped us were attentive and accommodating.

When one of my drinks didn’t meet my taste preferences, they kindly removed it from the bill. At checkout, Kayle was extremely friendly and helpful. When we asked about purchasing two umbrellas, she generously provided us with two brand-new ones.

Overall, we had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this hotel.

We have now stayed at Son Hoi An Boutique Hotel & Spa a couple of times, and we absolutely love it! It is such a unique and special hotel, full of character and charm. Almost every room has its own individual design, and the beautiful artwork throughout the hotel, including on the walls and roof, adds to its distinctive style and personality.

The location is fantastic, just a short walk from Hoi An Ancient Town, making it perfect for exploring everything this beautiful place has to offer.

However, what truly makes this hotel so wonderful is the incredible staff. From the doorman to reception, the restaurant team and the housekeepers, everyone greets you with a big smile and goes above and beyond to help. Their genuine warmth and hospitality make every stay feel special.

A special mention to Trang and Mrs Li at reception, and Trang and the entire restaurant team. Thank you for always making us feel so welcome and looking after us so beautifully. You all do an amazing job and are a huge part of what makes this hotel so special.

It is rare to find a hotel where you feel less like a guest and more like a friend returning home. We feel truly honoured to be your guests and are already looking forward to coming back next year and seeing all your friendly faces again.

Thank you for everything you do. You make Son Hoi An Boutique Hotel & Spa a truly wonderful place to stay, and we cannot recommend it highly enough!

reviews.textTranslated:
This is a truly fantastic, amazing, and beautiful hotel. The French-style interior features detailed decor, and the color scheme and furniture in each room are unique. The attention to detail is meticulously crafted down to the smallest aspects. It is very charming. The staff are very friendly and well-trained. Although I have stayed at other 5-star and boutique hotels, this one left such a strong impression that it perfectly matched my taste. I would recommend this to honeymooners looking for a place that isn't just a big, flashy, and crowded hotel. A hotel I definitely want to stay at again... This hotel is absolutely fantastic—beautiful, charming, and honestly, a little dangerous… because once you stay here, ordinary hotels may never feel quite the same again!

The entire hotel feels like a carefully designed French-style boutique dream. Every room has its own personality, with a completely different layout, color palette, furniture, and little details. Nothing feels mass-produced or copied and pasted from a hotel catalog. You can tell that someone put an almost obsessive amount of thought into every corner. And the staff? Wonderful. Friendly, genuinely warm, and exceptionally well-trained without ever feeling overly formal.

I’ve stayed at quite a few five-star hotels and boutique hotels, but this one really stood out to me. It happens to match my personal taste almost perfectly—which, of course, is the most dangerous kind of hotel!

I would especially recommend it to honeymooners and couples who want something intimate, romantic, stylish, and full of character rather than another huge, flashy hotel where you feel like one of several hundred guests.

I absolutely loved my stay here. If I come back to this area, I already know where I’ll be staying. No need to look around—I’ve found my hotel!

reviews.text:
My family and I had an exceptional stay at Son Hội An, easily one of the best boutique hotels we’ve experienced. The swimming pool was beautiful and relaxing, and the entire property felt luxurious, calm, and impeccably clean.

From the moment we arrived, the staff were outstanding. A lovely lady at reception welcomed us warmly on our first night after a last‑minute change of plans, and she was incredibly accommodating. Mr Trung was a wonderful, caring, and attentive member of the reception team who consistently went out of his way to help. The general manager was equally impressive — professional, friendly, and clearly committed to ensuring guests have a perfect stay.

Our family interconnecting rooms were ideal: super clean, tidy, and thoughtfully designed with interesting décor that gave the hotel real character. Breakfast was very nice, with fresh options and great service. The hotel also has a lovely spa, and the owner’s brother runs an excellent leather shop — Yes Leather — where the craftsmanship is genuinely top‑quality.

A luxurious setting, amazing staff, spotless rooms, and great value. Highly recommended.

Though it quite nice overall,trivial things drive people crazy.

This hotel was nice, the room size was big enough to accommodate us, full of paintings, with 2 comfy beds, and it even had 2 TV’s, one in the bathroom, which was large and top quality with a bathtub and shower. We had a balcony and a sofa and multiple charging ports. The breakfast was very tasty, with a wide range of food and beverages. There was also a pool and a lounge which I liked, and the staff were very friendly. However I have a couple main concerns with pests and smells. The whole hotel smelt of a strange peppermint, they played the same music looped in the lobby. There were also many ants or small bugs crawling all over me at times, especially in the lobby on the first day, I took a sweet from the sweet bowl and got several ant like bugs on my forearm. There was also a hole in the ceiling of our room by the curtains, where lizards crawled in through, and made clicking sounds. It would be nice if they patched up these holes. On the last day, I was very disappointed to find a baby cockroach crawling in my room, I really think the hotel should do a better job at pest control, although I understand that it is a tropical area, and the hotel is partially open air, so these issues can arise.

글쓰기
Extremely Disappointing Stay
There was an extremely strong moldy smell in our room. We tried running the dehumidifier and using air freshener to cover it, but the smell was still unbearable. The dehumidifier was too noisy to keep running continuously, and there was only one room key, so we couldn’t leave it running when we went out.
The bathroom design is also very inconvenient. The toilet is located beyond the shower area, so whenever someone takes a shower, you have to walk across a wet floor to use the toilet.
The cleanliness was disappointing as well. There was a lot of hair around the decorative stones next to the bathtub, and it was genuinely dirty.
The breakfast was also far below what we expected from a five-star hotel. Eggs were left at room temperature overnight, and the hotel did not even provide proper coffee. Staff also kept clearing our plates while we were still eating, which made the entire breakfast uncomfortable.
The staff were not friendly or welcoming either.

hotelDescription:
Overlooking the Thu Bồn River, this unassuming hotel is a 9-minute walk from Chùa Cầu, an 18th-century Japanese bridge, and 2 km from Hoi An bus station.
 Colorful rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screens, safes and minibars, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. All have balconies or terraces with river or city views, plus en suite wet rooms with rainfall showers. Traditional suites add free-standing tubs. A family suite has interconnecting bedrooms.
 A welcome drink is included. A sophisticated restaurant serves Western dishes; there’s also a bar. Other amenities include an indoor lap pool flanked by stone pillars, plus a spa and a gym.
