reviews.textTranslated:
A great place. We've been here again and would gladly return.

The location – close to the Old Town, just a few minutes' walk, yet right by the river – is simply perfect.

The spa – amazing! And I'll tell you a little more about it, because it definitely deserves it. It's a very comfortable, peaceful, and pleasant place, away from the outside noise. Relaxing music, comfort, spaciousness, and truly attractive prices. This isn't some random spa you just walk into from the street and don't know what to expect. Everything is completely professional.

I had the great pleasure of using Mira's services today. She's the best in the world! 😊 Complete professionalism, charm, and a smile. I chose two completely different treatments, and both were performed perfectly.

Mira – warmest regards and thank you! I recommend you wholeheartedly.

And judging by the attention to detail evident in every aspect of the hotel's operation, I'm convinced that the other spa staff also represent an equally high standard.

A place is made of people, and that's no different here. We have the pleasure of living in a place where the staff are warm, welcoming, and helpful. They respond quickly, offer support, and sometimes I feel like they read my mind.

It's definitely a place you want to return to.
reviews.text:
Świetne miejsce. Jesteśmy tutaj po raz kolejny i znowu chętnie wrócimy.

Położenie – blisko Old Town, zaledwie kilka minut pieszo, a jednocześnie nad rzeką – jest po prostu idealne.

Spa – rewelacja! I o nim trochę więcej, bo zdecydowanie na to zasługuje. To bardzo komfortowe, spokojne i przyjemne miejsce, z dala od zewnętrznego hałasu. Spokojna muzyka, wygoda, przestrzeń i naprawdę atrakcyjne ceny. Nie jest to przypadkowe spa, do którego wchodzi się z ulicy i nie wiadomo, czego się spodziewać. Wszystko jest w pełni profesjonalne.

Miałam dzisiaj ogromną przyjemność skorzystać z usług pani Miry. Jest najlepsza na świecie! 😊 Pełen profesjonalizm, urok i uśmiech. Wybrałam dwa zupełnie różne zabiegi i oba były wykonane perfekcyjnie.

Miro – serdecznie pozdrawiam i dziękuję! Polecam Cię z całego serca.

A sądząc po dbałości o szczegóły, którą widać w każdym aspekcie funkcjonowania hotelu, jestem przekonana, że również pozostałe osoby pracujące w spa reprezentują równie wysoki poziom.

Miejsce tworzą ludzie i tak jest też w tym przypadku. Mamy przyjemność mieszkania w miejscu w którym pracownicy są serdecznie, ciepli, pamiętają, pomagają. Szybko reagują, oferują wsparcie, czasami mam wrażenie, że czytają w myślach.

Zdecydowanie jest to miejsce, do którego chce się wracać.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Renata Stańczyk,

Thank you so much for returning to Little Residence and for taking the time to share such a heartfelt and detailed review with us. It truly means the world to our entire team to know that you continue to enjoy your stays with us.

We are delighted that you love our location, nestled by the river and just a few minutes’ walk from Hoi An Old Town. We are especially happy to hear that you enjoyed your time at our Spa and appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, professionalism, comfort, and value we strive to provide.

Mira will be absolutely delighted to hear your wonderful words! Your compliments about her professionalism, warm personality, and the treatments you experienced are truly appreciated. We will certainly share your kind message with her.

Your beautiful words about our team touched us deeply. We believe that genuine hospitality comes from caring for our guests, and knowing that you feel welcomed, remembered, and supported is the greatest compliment we could receive.

Thank you once again for your trust and for choosing to return to Little Residence. We look forward to welcoming you back again and again, and hopefully making each visit even more special.

With warmest regards,
Little Residence Team

We are very sorry to read your comments. However, after carefully checking the information provided in your review, we would like to clarify several important points.
We have thoroughly checked our reservation and guest records and cannot find any reservation or stay at Lantana Boutique Hoi An Hotel & Spa under the name James Stoddart.
Furthermore, the details mentioned in your review do not correspond with our property:
Lantana Boutique Hoi An Hotel & Spa does not have a room category called “Suite” as described in your review.
We do not have an attic or rooftop room of the type referred to in your comments.
The photographs associated with this review do not appear to be photographs of Lantana Boutique Hoi An Hotel & Spa.
For these reasons, we are concerned that this review may have been posted for the wrong property.
We fully respect the right of every guest to share their genuine experience, and we always take feedback seriously. However, it is equally important that a review accurately reflects the hotel where the guest actually stayed.
We therefore kindly ask you to double-check the hotel name and property associated with your stay. If you did stay at Lantana Boutique Hoi An Hotel & Spa, we would be very happy to investigate this matter personally. Please contact us directly and provide your reservation details or dates of stay so that we can verify the information and assist you appropriately.
If you confirm that this review was posted for the wrong property, we would sincerely appreciate it if you could kindly remove or correct the review.
We apologize for any misunderstanding and thank you for taking the time to check this matter.

Warm regards,
Sally
Operation Manager
Lantana Boutique Hoi An Hotel & Spa

Located less than a 10-minute walk across the river from Hoi An's Old Town, and only a 5-minute walk from the night market, this hotel offered a peaceful escape from the nightly festivities. The spacious room featured beautiful, heavy wooden furniture and a lovely stone bathtub.

reviews.text: We loved our inexpensive and relaxing stay here for 2 weeks with my husband 3 years ago. Breakfast is tasty and cooked fresh and brought to our room every morning. We will definitely come back.

reviews.textTranslated:
First of all, it's located a 5-minute walk from the beach. Access is via steps, and the sign with the name of the facility is well-hidden. The reception resembles a tailor's shop. The welcome was good, with some information and a variety of breakfast options (see photo). Communication was a bit difficult.
A small pool is located next to the entrance.
Wheelchair access is possible, but only in the two ground-floor rooms, despite a few small steps. Access to the upper floors is via stairs only.
My suite with a private pool, located on the first floor, is spacious and very bright.
Large and comfortable bed, refrigerator, AC with remote control, safe, spacious wardrobe, two bedside tables, two chairs with small tables, kettle with water and coffee, electrical outlets and lights near the bed.
The bathroom is not very large, with a shower with excellent jets, an electrical outlet near the sink, and decent lighting.
Balcony with tables and two chairs and a small private pool.
Contrary to what was stated on the Booking website, the sea is barely visible!
The hotel isn't on the seafront but in a quiet area. Restaurants, shops, and massage parlors are within walking distance.
Breakfast is served poolside. The internet works flawlessly.
reviews.text:
Innanzitto è localizzato a 5 minuti a piedi dalla spiaggia. Accesso tramite scalini e la scritta con il nome dell'infrastruttura ben nascosta. La reception assomiglia ad una sartoria. Accesso possibile a persone in sedia a rotelle, ma solo nelle due camere al pianterreno, malgrado qualche piccolo scalino come ostacolo. Accesso ai piani superiori unicamente via scale.

Letto grande e comodo, frigorifero, AC con comando, cassaforte, armadio capiente, due comodini, due sedie con tavolini, bollitore con acqua e caffè, prese elettriche e luci vicino al letto.

Balcone con tavolini e due sedie e piccola piscina privata .
Rispetto a quanto indicato sul sito Booking con il mare non si vede neanche con il cannocchiale!
L'hotel non è sul mare ma in una zona tranquilla. A pochi passi ristoranti, negozi e saloni massaggi.
La colazione è servita a bordo piscina. Internet funziona senza problemi.

hotelDescription:
Set along Cua Dai Beach, this laid-back resort is 6 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics and 7 km from Hoi An Ancient Town.
 Ranging from rooms and suites to bungalows, the unassuming quarters offer free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and minifridges, plus sitting areas, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some have free-standing tubs, balconies and/or terraces.
 Freebies include breakfast, welcome drinks and local shuttle service. Dining options consist of 3 restaurants and 2 bars. Other amenities include a private beach area, an outdoor pool and a gym, plus a game room and a tennis court. There's also a spa with a sauna, a steam room and a hot tub.

reviews.textTranslated: The hotel is located next to the pier, with two great beaches nearby. There are very few people here, so you can really relax here, even though we're already on vacation in Da Nang, but here the vacation feels completely different. The hotel itself isn't exactly fancy or modern, but it's somehow very cozy. I can't even say a bad word about it. Our room was very small, so maybe that's what created the feeling of coziness, but no, the coziness sets in as soon as you step inside. The owner of the hotel and restaurant is a very kind woman and will help you with any questions. On the ground floor, she makes buns that smell so good you know what you want for breakfast the night before—they're simply amazing. It feels like visiting your grandmother in the countryside. I envy anyone who gets to visit this island and this hotel! Don't hesitate to go, you won't regret it!
reviews.text: Отель находится рядом с пирсом. Рядом 2 классных пляжа. Народа очень мало, тут прям отдыхаешь, не смотря что мы и так в отпуске в Дананге, но здесь отдых ощущается совсем по-другому. Сам отель не сказать что какой-то классный или современный, но в нем почему-то очень уютно, даже слова плохого про не скажешь, у нас очень маленький номер, может из-за этого и создается ощущение уюта, но нет, уют наступает сразу как только перешагнешь порог. Хозяйка отеля и ресторана очень добрая женщина, поможет решить любой вопрос. На первом этаже она готовит булочки от запаха которых уже с вечера знаешь чем хочешь завтракать, это просто бомба. Ощущение как будто съездил к бабушке в деревню😁. Завидую тем кто попадёт на этот остров и в этот отель! Езжайте смело, не пожалеете!

reviews.textTranslated: Amazing experience at this homestay. The room was a bit small and the bathroom basic. We were a little rushed, but luckily we were able to book a room at the Hammock. Once there, she had everything we needed (scooter, snorkeling gear, great restaurant). She's very adaptable, helpful, and available. On the last day, when we didn't know if the boats would be leaving for our return trip, she was incredibly responsive, changing our tickets to make sure we could get back. In short, a lovely person. Thanks again, Chi Linh ❤️

Le dernier jour, alors qu'on ne savait pas si les bateaux partiraient pour rentrer, elle a été très réactive en nous changeant les billets pour être sûr qu'on puisse rentrer. Bref une personne adorable. Encore merci Chi Linh ❤️

reviews.textTranslated:
This is a wonderful place! We spent two days at the hotel and felt right at home.

Firstly, this is the best hotel on the island; we researched other options, and I can confirm it. The hotel is located on the edge of the beach, in a quiet and clean area. There's a coral reef in the water, and you can rent a mask and snorkel to swim to the neighboring beach.

Secondly, the level of service is simply incredible! First, the owner helped us book boat tickets, and then helped us change our dates when we decided to stay an extra night. The receptionist was a gem. She treated us to fruit, let us use the hotel grounds as if they were her own, and showered us with attention.

Thirdly, the rooms are simply wonderful. We stayed in two different rooms, and both were excellent, very clean, the beds were soft and comfortable. Each room has a panoramic view of the beach and sea. The only drawback I would highlight is the weak air conditioning in one of the rooms. I would recommend checking the coolant. Otherwise, I'm seriously thinking about coming for a longer period.
reviews.text:
Это отличное место! Мы провели в отеле два дня и чувствовали себя как дома.

Во-первых, это лучший отель на острове, мы изучали другие варианты и я могу утверждать. Отель находится на краю пляжа, в тихом и чистом уголке, в воде коралловый риф и можно взять в аренду маску и трубку и сплавать до соседнего пляжа.

Во-вторых, уровень сервиса просто невероятный! Сначала хозяин помог нам забронировать билеты на лодку, а потом помогал нам сменить дату, когда мы решили остаться еще на одну ночь. Администратор — золотая женщина. Она угощала нас фруктами, позволяла использовать территорию отеля как свою собственную и окружила нас вниманием.

В третьих, номера просто замечательные. Мы жили в двух разных комнатах и обе комнаты были отличными, очень чистыми, кровати были мягкими и удобными. Из любого номера открывается панорамный вид на пляж и море. Единственное что я бы подчеркнула — слабый кондиционер в одной из комнат. Я бы рекомендовала проверить обновить охлаждающую жидкость.

В остальном, я всерьез задумалась о том, чтобы приехать на более длительный срок.

4. The motorbike rental price was 200,000 VND/bike/day. However, the bikes were very old and broke down while we were riding. Two girls broke their legs trying to pedal, and we had to ask a local for help to get them going again. When we called the owner, they told us to take the bikes to get repaired ?_?

Stayed one night at this homestay and were honestly very disappointed.

The rooms are essentially metal boxes—more like bunkers—with no windows, which makes them heat up a lot during the day. They’re also extremely poorly insulated; you can hear everything from neighboring rooms, even small movements like someone turning in bed.

The whole setup felt quite confusing and unorganized. We had to pay upfront, and some people handed us the key, but it wasn’t clear if they were actually responsible for the place. There was no proper welcome, no real communication, and no checkout process at all.

The property itself feels randomly put together: a tent in the back, constant watering in the front area, a huge table with no clear purpose, and some scattered plants. Overall, it lacks structure and feels a bit strange and unfinished.

On top of that, there was loud music playing throughout the night, which made it hard to rest.

While the room was reasonably clean, it definitely doesn’t justify the price—especially compared to other places in Vietnam. For what you get, it feels significantly overpriced.

Would not recommend staying here.

Do not stay here. You will regret it.
Descriptions on Booking do not match what you get when you arrive. The management will apologise for adding the wrong descriptions for rooms and then blame you for taking their word for truth and not checking the photos. "Garden view" - no such thing. The room has no windows. "Futon" now means a cheap foam mattress thrown directly on the floor. "Terrace" is a shallow step to put your shoes on. This business is riding on the back of one single good room and stretching the truth until it snaps. They have a total mismatch with their clientele and their idyllic surroundings. This was an extremely jarring experience. A relaxing rural retreat this was not!

We thought this place would be chill and that we would be able to spend the cooler morning hours on the grounds enjoying the views... But instead, we were kept up until 2am by a group of rude, rowdy, drunk guests. The management should have made sure that this did not happen. They did not. In fact, they lied and told us the loud music and accompanying human noise (screeching loudly to be heard on top of the awful music blasting out of the provided speaker) would be dealt with before 10pm. It went on until almost midnight, after which the human screeching and beer drinking continued uninterrupted until after 2am.

Not only was our night ruined but so too was our next day. After finally getting to sleep in our corrugated metal box room with no windows, we awoke (much later than planned) to find the same guests colonising the shared space yet again - although this time hung over, a lot quieter and commandeering all of the cooling electric fans. It was too hot to try to enjoy anything as it approached midday. We left quickly.

This was a terrible, terrible, terrible experience.

Avoid at all costs!

updatesFromCustomers.text:
Đọc đánh giá của mọi người thấy khen hết lời, bước chân vào thì ối giời ơi.
Đặt chân đến thì đc tiếp đón bởi 1 thanh niên với khuôn mặt và cách nói chuyện ko mấy thiện cảm, đã vậy còn đòi thu tiền trước trong khi mình đã đặt tiền trước. Vào nhà thì nền nhà rất bẩn, nhớp nhớp mà phải đi chân đất lên cầu thang và hành lang khá tối.
Vào phòng thì thôi rồi, không tủ lạnh, ko tivi, đến cái tủ để quần áo cũng không nốt. Nhà vệ sinh thì vòi sen hỏng móc treo nên tắm phải cầm sen giơ lên, chậu rửa mặt sắp bung ra nên vừa sử dụng vừa sợ nó rơi vào chân.
Phản ánh với cô chủ mà mọi người khen là niềm nở nhiệt tình thì nhận đc câu " nhà nghỉ nên chỉ có vậy thôi". Khi đặt đồ ăn mình có nhờ chuẩn bị giúp mình ít rau để ăn sashimi cá ngừ và nhờ thái hộ ( mình bảo sẽ trả phí ), nhưng khi thái cá bếp ko biết làm để cá vụn nát và dính đầy nước vào, mình lại phải xin phép vào tự làm.
Nói chung đây là chỗ mà mình sẽ chỉ đến 1 lần và những đánh giá tốt đẹp trên đều ko đáng tin.
Mọi người nên cân nhắc kỹ trước khi ăn nghỉ ở đây nhé

reviews.textTranslated: I booked a room here for September, but because it's very rainy and stormy in Hue during that month, I messaged the manager to ask if I could get a refund, and they readily agreed. Regardless of other issues, the customer service alone is excellent (other places rarely offer refunds). I saw many reviews saying this place is very close to the beach and even has a restaurant, making it very convenient. I will definitely visit again for a vacation when I have the chance. The best time to visit is June, July, and August, everyone! <3
reviews.text: Mình book phòng ở đây cho tháng 9 nhưng vì tháng 9 biển Huế mưa dông nhiều nên mình nhắn hỏi bạn quản lý có được hoàn cọc không, bạn đã sẵn sàng hoàn cho mình. Chưa cần biết các vấn đề khác như thế nào nhưng riêng dịch vụ CSKH như vậy là siêu tốt rồi (những chỗ khác khó mà cho hoàn cọc). Mình thấy mọi người review chỗ này rất gần biển, lại còn sở hữu nhà hàng ăn nữa nên rất tiện. Khi nào có dịp nhất định sẽ lại ghé nơi đây nghỉ dưỡng. Đến đây đẹp nhất là vào tháng 678 nha mọi người <3

reviews.textTranslated: My family was traveling across Vietnam, so we looked for accommodation along the way. The guesthouse had a restaurant on the beach with delicious food, but the rooms were renovated family homes, a bit old, not soundproof, with gaps in the doors making privacy feel lacking, and the bed linens were still covered in sand. It was okay for an overnight stay because the area is still quite deserted and it's hard to find homestays or hotels, but not for a comfortable stay. On the plus side, the rooms were cheap and had air conditioning, wall fans, and hot water. I forgot to take pictures of the room.
reviews.text: Nhà mình đi xuyên Việt nên tìm chỗ ở trên đường đi. Nhà nghỉ có cả nhà hàng ngoài bãi biển ăn ngon, còn nhà nghỉ thì là các phòng gia đình cải tạo lại, hơi cũ, không cách âm, cửa hở khe cảm giác không được riêng tư, chăn ga gối vẫn dính cát, để nghỉ qua đêm thì tạm được vì khu này vẫn còn khá vắng vẻ và khó tìm homestay, khách sạn, còn để thoải mái thì không. reviews.textTranslated: Terrible, the room was bad, no TV, no refrigerator, no wardrobe, the bathroom was run-down and had no exhaust fan. The landlord had a very unpleasant attitude, especially the male guest. It's near the beach, but the beach is a small bay so there are no waves.

reviews.textTranslated:
The room was stuffy and reeked of mothballs.

There were two 1.8m beds, one table, and one chair.

The bathroom was quite dilapidated; the sink was sagging, and there was a toothbrush and a cup.

Two coat hangers. Two small towels.

The wall fan was covered in a thick layer of dust, probably not cleaned in years.

Other than that, there were no other amenities.

Not suitable for families with young children.

The advantage was that it was directly on the beach. The beach was amazing.

The restaurant wasn't good, nor was it cheap. The chopsticks were moldy. Everything was just makeshift. We stayed for one night, then the kids wanted to go home.

The service was okay, no problems.

The price of 400k VND is high for the quality. 400k VND in the city is much cleaner and newer.
reviews.text:
Phòng bí, nồng nặc mùi băng phiến.
Có 2 giường x 1m8, 1 bàn, 1 ghế.
Nhà vệ sinh khá xập xệ, bồn rửa đã xệ dốc rồi, có bàn chải, cốc đánh răng.
2 cái mắc áo. 2 khăn tắm nhỏ.
Quạt treo tường bám một lớp bụi siêu dày, chắc mấy năm rồi chưa được rửa.
Ngoài ra không còn tiện ích gì khác.
Không phù hợp gia đình có trẻ nhỏ.

Ưu điểm là đi thẳng ra biển. Biển thì thích vô cùng.

Nhà hàng không ngon, cũng không rẻ. Đũa thì mốc. Toàn ăn tạm, ở tạm. Cũng được 1 đêm thì bọn trẻ đòi về.

Dịch vụ ok, không có vấn đề gì.

Giá 400k là cao so với chất lượng nha. 400k ở thành phố sạch mới hơn nhiều.

reviews.textTranslated:
The location is great, right opposite the path through the forest to the beach. You can get here by bus 10-N2 from Hue city center or near the airport, 4 trips a day, around 50k VND.
The guesthouse is family-run and doesn't have many rooms, so it's best to book early during peak season. The rooms are spacious and clean, with pristine white bed linens and pillows, well-functioning equipment, and fast Wi-Fi. The water pressure is sometimes weak.

The owner is extremely friendly, attentive, and generous.
Motorbikes are available for rent at 150k VND/day.
There are many shops and restaurants nearby with a full range of services.
reviews.text:
Vị trí đẹp ngay đối diện là lối đi xuyên qua rừng ra bãi biển. Có thể tới đây bằng xe buýt 10-N2 từ trung tâm thành phố Huế hoặc gần sân bay, ngày 4 chuyến, ~50k.
Nhà nghỉ kiểu gia đình không có nhiều phòng nên mùa du lịch cần đặt sớm. Phòng rộng rãi, sạch sẽ, chăn ga gối nệm trắng trẻo mới tinh, trang thiết bị hoạt động tốt, wifi nhanh. Riêng nước đôi lúc yếu.
Chủ nhà cực thân thiện, chu đáo và xởi lởi.
Có xe máy cho thuê giá 150k/ngày.
Xung quanh có nhiều hàng quán với đầy đủ dịch vụ.

hotelDescription:
Set on a lagoon, this tranquil spa resort is 3 km from Bach Ma National Park and 11 km from Thiền Viện Trúc Lâm Bạch Mã Buddhist temple.
 The chic villas feature mountain and lagoon views, satellite TV, minibars and living areas, plus bathrooms with outdoor showers. Some are built on stilts over the lagoon, and have private sundecks. Upgraded villas feature private pools; a few offer kitchenettes, gardens and extra bedrooms.
 There are 3 restaurants, 1 set over the lagoon, as well as a bar and a spa with a sauna and a hot tub. Activities such as tai chi, yoga and chakra balancing classes (fee) are also available.

reviews.textTranslated:
I chose to stay at the resort with my family at a rather rushed time, and I didn't have much time to research it beforehand like I usually do when planning a trip.

However, upon arrival, I was extremely satisfied. Initially, I thought the place would be just average, but that afternoon, while cycling around (bicycles are available for guests at the resort – there are many, and the borrowing/returning process is very reasonable based on resort regulations. For example, my two-room villa had four bikes parked in front of the villa), I realized how vast the grounds are. The villa I booked was only located at the very beginning, near the main entrance and lobby area...
The accommodation area is further inside (with electric carts to take guests in and out)... and there are many other accommodation options inside, including rooms on the hill and hotel-style rooms (which are more affordable and offer more choices)... and they all share the same amenities as the common swimming pool and other shared facilities.

The weather wasn't ideal when we went, with dark clouds covering the sky... but towards evening, the sky cleared up 😅 which helped salvage the beautiful scenery. We were able to admire the clouds, the sunset (it would be even better on a clear day) over Tam Giang Lagoon.

The room service was good. The only problem my family encountered was that the air conditioner in our room was leaking water, requiring a technician to fix it, which interrupted our plans a bit. However, everything was understandable because the staff were very friendly and attentive.

I noticed that there weren't many staff members, but they were always quick to assist guests when needed.

In the evening, you can eat at the resort or walk to the restaurants in front where there are local specialties with a pretty good seafood menu.

Breakfast at the hotel was abundant and luxurious. The breakfast buffet didn't have too many dishes, but it satisfied all tastes and offered choices for my family, from children to the elderly.

My family really enjoyed this place and would definitely choose to return again soon.
reviews.text:
Mình chọn nghỉ dưỡng tại resort cùng gia đình vào 1 thời điểm khá vội vã, mình cũng chưa có thời gian tìm hiểu qua nhiều như những lần mình hay lên kế hoạch đi chơi.
Tuy nhiên, khi đến nơi thì thật sự mình cảm thấy vô cùng hài lòng. Không gian nơi đây ban đầu tưởng cũng chỉ là bình thường thôi, nhưng thật sự vào chiều đó khi đạp xe đi dạo(xe đạp có sẵn cho khách tại resort-có rất nhiều xe luôn,và việc sắp xếp mượn/trả rất hợp lý dựa trên quy định của resort.Như villa của mình 2 phòng là có 4 xe để trước villa) thì mình mới cảm nhận là khuôn viên quá rộng.Căn villa mình đặt chỉ là nằm ở vị trí đầu tiên ngay gần cổng chính vào và khu vựa sảnh thôi...
Khu vực lưu trú còn tít bên trong(có xe điện đưa khách ra vào)..và bên trong thì còn nhiều phân khu phòng nghỉ dưỡng lắm,trên đồi và dạng hotel nữa (chi phí phòng sẽ mềm hơn,dễ lựa chọn hơn).. và vẫn có tiện ích là hồ bơi chung và tiện ích chung như nhau.
Lúc mình đi thời tiết không mấy thuận lợi,mây đen kín bầu trời..nhưng đến gần chiều thì trời quang mây tạnh😅 cũng giúp mình cứu vãn cảnh đẹp nơi đây, có thể ngắm cảnh sắc mây trời,hoàng hôn (trời đẹp chắc tuyệt hơn) trên phá Tam Giang nữa.
Dịch vụ phòng tốt..Chỉ có một điểm trục trặc gia đình mình gặp là máy lạnh phòng mình bị chảy nước ào ạt,phải cần gọi kỹ thuật vào sữa chữa một buổi làm gián đoạn kế hoạch gia đình một chút,tuy nhiên mọi thứ cũng thông cảm được vì các bạn nhân viên ở đây khá dễ thương và chu đáo.
Mình thấy ở đây nhân viên không có đông, nhưng luôn hỗ trợ khách khi cần 1 cách nhanh nhất có thể.
Buổi tối thì mình có thể ăn tại resort hoặc đi bộ ra phía trước có những quán ăn đặc sản của người dân quanh đó với menu hải sản khá ổn.
Ăn sáng tại khách sạn thì phong phú,sang trọng.Buffet sáng không quá nhiều món nhưng đáp ứng đủ khẩu vị cũng như lựa chọn cho gia đình mình từ trẻ con đến người lớn tuổi.
Nơi đây gia đình mình cũng rất thích và cũng sẽ chọn làm điểm quay lại một ngày gần nhất.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 – Absolutely Amazing Experience!

Vedana Lagoon in Hue was an incredible experience from start to finish!

The customer service was a perfect 10/10. Every staff member was extremely friendly, kind, welcoming and always willing to help. The level of hospitality was outstanding and really made our stay special.

The bungalow was absolutely amazing, beautifully designed, spacious, peaceful and spotlessly clean. The entire resort was very well maintained, and the attention to detail was impressive.

The food was fantastic, especially the delicious breakfast with plenty of great options. Room service was also incredibly fast, and everything arrived fresh and beautifully prepared.

One of the highlights of our stay was watching the breathtaking sunset over the lagoon in the afternoon. The views were absolutely stunning and created such a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere.

Everything about this resort exceeded our expectations, from the beautiful surroundings and amazing accommodation to the exceptional service.

I highly recommend Vedana Lagoon to anyone visiting Hue or looking for a peaceful luxury getaway in Vietnam. Truly a 10/10 experience, and we would absolutely love to come back!

title: Angsana Lang Co, Central Vietnam
description: Upmarket beachfront getaway offering multiple bars & restaurants, plus an outdoor pool & a spa.
address: Commune, Canh Duong Village, Chân Mây - Lăng Cô, Huế, Vietnam
neighborhood: Canh Duong Village, Chan May - Lang Co
plusCode: 8XM4+P8 Chan May - Lang Co, Hue, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set along Canh Duong Beach on the sea, this upscale seaside resort is a 6-minute walk from the Thanh Toan Bridge and 9 km from the QL1A national route.
 Refined rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; some have balconies and/or sea views. Suites add living rooms and dining areas. Room service is available.
 There are 5 restaurants and bars, including an open-air seafood eatery. Other amenities consist of a private beach area with sunloungers and games. There's also an 18-hole golf course, an outdoor pool and a gym, plus a spa and a kids’ club. Kayaking, jet skiing and snorkeling can be arranged.

reviews.textTranslated:
Does anyone think this is a picture of a villa?

- The floor is covered in dirt (insects defecated on it and weren't cleaned).

- The bedsheets and pillows in our room smelled strongly of men's body oil 😖. Nails on the bed came loose, causing two children to cut themselves and bleed 😢.

- Some rooms had TVs and refrigerators, others didn't. None of the rooms had bottled water; at least the accommodation should have provided bottled water for guests, not just empty bottles like this, especially since our group booked a 7-room villa for 6250k/night.

- Out of 7 rooms, 5 had broken door locks; if the outer doors weren't broken, then the toilet doors were all broken.

- The glass door of the shared toilet in the women's room was shattered, you could see everything from the outside :((.
- The kitchen was incredibly dirty, the walls were covered in black dust, not to mention the storage drawers and the counter...
A truly terrible experience regarding the room quality here. How can a service operate in such a poor state and still welcome guests??? The pictures online looked amazing, but upon arrival, I was horrified 😱. Everything looked excessively old and worn. The only positive point was the abundance of greenery and the airy atmosphere, but that was it. It was utterly awful!
reviews.text:
Có ai nghĩ đây là hình ảnh của 1 villa ko ?
- Sàn đầy chấm bẩn ( côn trùng ị xong ko chùi nên bị dính đầy )
- Ga gối ở phòng mình toàn mùi hôi dầu của đàn ông 😖, Đinh đóng ở giường bung ra làm 2 trẻ em bị quẹt chảy máu 😢.
- Tivi, tủ lạnh thì phòng có phòng ko. Nước suối thì ko phòng nào có cả, ít nhất chỗ nghĩ phải bỏ chai nước suối sẵn cho khách chứ ko fai trống trơn như này trong khi đoàn mình đặt villa 7 phòng 6250k/1 đêm.
- Đặt 7 phòng thì hết 5 phòng cửa khoá bị hư , ko hư cửa ngoài thì cửa toilet cũng bung hết.
- Cửa toilet chung phòng nữ bể kính toe, đứng ngoài thấy hết :((.
- Bếp quá bẩn , bụi đen cả tường chưa kể mấy hộc đựng đồ hay trên bàn bếp...
Một trải nghiệm cực kì tề về chất lượng phòng ở đây , sao mở dịch vụ mà có thể để nó tệ đến mức này vẫn đón khách được nhỉ ???
Trên mạng thì ảnh lung linh mà đến nơi nhận phòng phát hoảng 😱, nhìn cái gì cũng cũ kĩ quá mức lun, chỉ có điểm cộng là cây xanh nhiều thoáng mát , zị thôi, quá sức tệ !

The villa is situated by the river with expansive views, perfect for a family, friends, or group vacation. The riverside scenery along the Bo River offers a relaxing atmosphere, blending seamlessly with the breeze and water.

It features a beautiful outdoor swimming pool, a spacious garden, and an outdoor BBQ area – ideal for gatherings, small parties, or birthday celebrations.
Because the villa is located on the outskirts of Hue (Quang Dien), visiting major tourist attractions like the Imperial Citadel and Thien Mu Pagoda will take longer compared to hotels in the city center. Therefore, if you prefer exploring the city center, you should consider Soleil's properties there, which offer excellent service. However, if you prefer to reconnect with nature and the peacefulness of a Vietnamese countryside, then you've come to the right place.

Ask the reception for any good tips and places in Hue, and you’ll get some hidden gems! Thanks Quinn and Linh, you have been so precious!!
By motorbike, it is 15-17 minutes from the old city. A bit further from the touristic hub but this is what you’re looking for when you choose a quiet place with big garden, at 3 steps away from town…
Definitely and totally recommended 100 %

reviews.text: Home xinh, không khí dễ chịu. Ở chill thoải mái cực

So disappointed…

With my partner, we wanted to stay in a peaceful hotel for this period in Hue because it’s our anniversary. Then, we found this “incredible hotel” on the picture for a price of 890.000đ without the breakfast.

The staff is friendly, the room is great but you can hear everything outside (like there is no door). And there are two corridors with small stones for the ground so you can be sure to get up earlier and to sleep very late. Especially when there is a group of full Vietnamese people who do a party with karaoke in front of the hotel, who speak so loudly, who screams from the garden, etc. And yes, even with the earplugs, you can hear everything like they are next to you.
To understand, the hotel is just in front of the river and between both, there is a little garden for the view, belonging to the hotel so it’s quite close to the room.
Honestly, I was so excited to go in this hotel, the room was so clean and pretty, the staff were also friendly. And then, first night, we just wanted to go.

This review is not against the staff who are adorable, but they must change something for the noise (change the door or stop accepting the group of 35 guests, considering all the previous reviews on Google maps, please…)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Lihsin Hong,

First of all, happy anniversary to you and your partner! Thank you for choosing to stay with us for such a special occasion, and for taking the time to share your detailed feedback.

We are delighted that you appreciated our clean, comfortable rooms and the friendliness of our staff. At the same time, we are truly sorry that the noise prevented you from having the completely peaceful stay you envisioned.

As mentioned during our pre-arrival communication, that day Va welcomed a group had small celebration parties. We always ask them to keep the speaker volume as low as possible and directed toward the river. However, we fully understand that even with advance notice, the noise can still impact a relaxing celebration.

We will certainly keep this in mind and remind future guests to keep the noise down to avoid disturbing others. Your feedback regarding soundproofing and noise from the corridor/garden is extremely valuable, and we are actively looking into solutions to improve our guest experience.

We sincerely appreciate your kind words about our team despite the disruption. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back on a quiet weekday in the future to offer you the serene experience you truly deserve.

Warmest regards,
Va Riverside Retreat

reviews.textTranslated:
A Wonderful Escape at Va Riverside Retreat

Where to begin? The place is simply peaceful and rejuvenating. The Perfume River, the beautifully maintained garden, the refreshing pool with its breathtaking view… Everything invites you to experience serenity and the good life.

But what truly makes this stay exceptional is, above all, the staff—so friendly, smiling, warm, and attentive. A huge thank you to Giang, Trang, and Thao, who took such good care of us, always with a smile, great kindness, and boundless generosity. Their presence and thoughtful touches greatly contributed to making our stay wonderful.

The room was impeccably clean, pleasant, and comfortable, and the service was impeccable. We also greatly appreciated the services offered on-site: laundry, scooter rental, and especially the breakfast lovingly prepared each morning.

Thanks to them, we had an absolutely divine stay, a truly convivial and memorable experience. Thank you so much for all your thoughtful touches, your kindness, and your incredibly warm welcome.

We leave with our hearts full of wonderful memories and we will definitely be back. A truly special place that we wholeheartedly recommend, even though we wish it could remain a secret!
reviews.text:
Une parenthèse merveilleuse au Va Riverside Retreat

Par où commencer ? Le lieu est tout simplement paisible et ressourçant. La rivière des Parfums, le jardin magnifiquement entretenu, la piscine rafraîchissante avec sa vue à couper le souffle… Tout invite à la plénitude et à la douceur de vivre.

Mais ce qui rend ce séjour véritablement exceptionnel, c’est avant tout le personnel, ô combien amical, souriant, chaleureux et attentionné. Un immense merci à Giang, Trang et Thao, qui ont été aux petits soins avec nous, toujours avec le sourire, une grande gentillesse et une infinie bonté. Leur présence et leurs attentions ont largement contribué à rendre notre séjour merveilleux.

La chambre était d’une propreté irréprochable, agréable et confortable, le service impeccable. Nous avons également beaucoup apprécié les services proposés sur place : laundry, location de scooter, et surtout le petit déjeuner préparé avec amour chaque matin.

Nous avons passé un séjour absolument divin grâce à elles, mais aussi un véritable moment de convivialité et de partage. Merci infiniment pour toutes vos attentions, votre gentillesse et votre accueil si chaleureux.

Nous repartons le cœur rempli de beaux souvenirs et nous reviendrons absolument. Une adresse précieuse que nous recommandons les yeux fermés, même si nous aimerions qu'il reste notre secret !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Adeline & Elodie ,

Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts for your wonderful review! We are deeply touched by your thoughtful and heartwarming words.

We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere at Va Riverside Retreat, the serene views of the Perfume River, our refreshing pool, and the cleanliness of your room. It is also great to know that our breakfast, scooter rental, and laundry services contributed to making your stay seamless and comfortable.

A special thank you from Giang, Trang, and Thao! Your lovely compliments mean the world to them. Caring for our guests with genuine warmth and smiles is our top priority, and they are thrilled to have helped create such beautiful memories for your getaway.

Thank you for your glowing recommendation (even if we keep this place our little secret together!). It would be an absolute pleasure to welcome you back anytime you visit Hue.

Warmest regards,

The Va Riverside Retreat Team
Riverside would like to thank you for your 5-star rating. We look forward to seeing you again next time!

It’s an absolute paradise. Lush and green, beautiful suites and the staff are amazing.

My wife, daughter and I spent two wonderful nights at Pilgrimage Village Resort, and it was undoubtedly one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

After the busy streets of Hanoi and Da Nang, and before heading to the lively chaos of Saigon, this place was exactly what we needed. A true oasis of peace and relaxation.

The resort is simply stunning. The lush gardens, beautiful flowers, swimming pools and every little corner of the outdoor areas create an incredible atmosphere of calm and beauty. Just walking around the property is a pleasure.

Our villa was exceptional. Spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, spacious and extremely comfortable. Even the smallest details had been considered, including mosquito treatment in the room to ensure a peaceful night's sleep. And the bathroom? Absolutely enormous! Beautifully designed, incredibly well equipped and finished with exceptional taste and attention to detail.

Breakfast was another highlight. An amazing selection of fresh, high-quality food, with pretty much everything you could wish for.

The staff deserve special recognition. Everyone was incredibly friendly, attentive and professional, always available when needed but never intrusive. That perfect balance of hospitality that makes you feel truly welcome.

And I cannot finish this review without mentioning two experiences that made our stay even more special.

First, the massages! We received 30 minutes of complimentary massage for each night of our stay, meaning a full hour per person over our two nights. The lady who treated me was absolutely fantastic. Without exaggeration, one of the best massages I have ever had!

Second, the 7 AM beginner's Tai Chi session. What a wonderful way to start the day! Practising Tai Chi surrounded by such beautiful and peaceful surroundings was an experience I genuinely believe everyone should try at least once.

Pilgrimage Village is much more than just a hotel. It is a place where you can slow down, disconnect from the outside world and simply enjoy being there.

Would I return? Without the slightest hesitation. And next time, I would definitely stay longer!

Thank you to the entire team for making our family stay so memorable.

aNhill Boutique is a boutique hotel that leaves a lasting impression with its tranquil atmosphere and sophisticated design. The elegance reflected in its name is evident throughout the space, creating a style that is not overly ostentatious yet meticulously crafted down to the smallest detail.

The building and interior strike a balance between modern beauty and a calming comfort. The incorporation of nature-inspired elements and subdued color palettes makes it ideal for those seeking a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Even in photographs, the attention to detail in the spatial composition and the use of light is evident, giving it a distinctive boutique hotel character.

A particularly appealing aspect is the consistency between the impression conveyed by the name aNhill Boutique and the overall high-quality, serene image of the facility. Rather than the uniform atmosphere of large hotels, it's an attractive accommodation where you can appreciate the scale and design itself.

Overall, it gives the impression of a hotel that prioritizes atmosphere, design, and tranquility over flashiness. If you want to enjoy a relaxing stay in a sophisticated space, aNhill Boutique is definitely worth considering.

reviews.textTranslated: This isn't my first time here, and I've loved it every time before. But this time, I was really disappointed with how noisy the hotel was when they rented it out for the wedding reception. As a resort with prices ranging from 3-6 million VND per night, not including villa rooms costing 10-15 million VND for relaxation, I felt like I was in a budget hotel with loud karaoke, pounding music, and a shouting MC. The constant stream of people also made me uneasy about security. Even on a normal weekend, this would be unacceptable, let alone during a holiday when all the rooms were booked. I think the revenue during these days should be enough for the hotel to prioritize the comfort of its guests.

We stayed at the anHill Hotel for three nights and it was one of the best hotel experiences we've ever had! We received such a warm welcome from Julia, and all the staff were incredibly attentive and friendly. We felt completely at ease at all times and would have loved to spend the whole day at the hotel! The room was cleaned twice a day, and we received thoughtful little touches from the team, which we really appreciated. The pool was fantastic, and the entire hotel grounds were so well-maintained that you couldn't help but feel comfortable. The city is about 15 minutes away by taxi – you can take a wonderful break from all the hustle and bustle of travel at the anHill.

We thoroughly enjoyed the hotel's offerings on Vietnamese coffee making and rice paper production, and we even got to feed the koi!

We wholeheartedly recommend this hotel and would definitely love to come back again! 🤎

reviews.textTranslated:
Ancient Hue Garden Houses – A Hue experience even more beautiful than expected! 🌿

I was truly surprised by how much more beautiful and luxurious Ancient Hue was than I had anticipated! Before arriving, I thought it would just be a traditional garden-style hotel, but once inside, I realized how meticulously and exquisitely it's been designed.

Nestled in the Kim Long area, Ancient Hue embodies the beauty of old Hue houses, with its ancient tiled roofs, intricate wood carvings, courtyards, and lush green gardens. Traditional architecture is cleverly combined with modern amenities, creating a space that is both classic and luxurious without being ostentatious.

What I liked most was the sense of privacy and tranquility. Everything is gentle and elegant, from the decor and colors to the harmony between architecture and nature. The sophistication of Ancient Hue doesn't lie in its flashiness but in its profound aesthetic sense, making you feel like you're in an old Hue mansion rather than a typical hotel.

This time, I arrived in Hue during the rainy season. The sky was overcast, the trees were a deep green, and the rain-soaked tiled roofs added to the tranquil and romantic atmosphere. There was no need to go far; just sitting and admiring the garden, listening to the rain, was enough to make the trip worthwhile.

Ancient Hue is not only beautiful but also soulful. It's a place to stay that truly embodies Hue's unique character, luxurious in its own way, and far exceeded my expectations. 💚
reviews.text:
Ancient Hue Garden Houses – Một góc Huế đẹp hơn cả mong đợi! 🌿

Thật sự bất ngờ vì Ancient Hue đẹp và sang hơn kỳ vọng của mình rất nhiều! Trước khi đến chỉ nghĩ đây là một khách sạn mang phong cách nhà vườn truyền thống, nhưng bước vào rồi mới thấy nơi này được chăm chút và tinh tế đến từng chi tiết.

Nằm nép mình trong khu Kim Long, Ancient Hue mang vẻ đẹp của những ngôi nhà rường Huế xưa, với mái ngói cổ, những đường nét chạm khắc gỗ, khoảng sân và khu vườn xanh mướt. Kiến trúc truyền thống được kết hợp khéo léo với tiện nghi hiện đại, tạo nên một không gian vừa cổ kính, vừa sang trọng nhưng không hề phô trương.

Điều mình thích nhất là cảm giác riêng tư và bình yên ở đây. Mọi thứ đều nhẹ nhàng, thanh lịch, từ cách bài trí, màu sắc đến sự hài hòa giữa kiến trúc và thiên nhiên. Cái sang của Ancient Hue không nằm ở sự hào nhoáng mà ở gu thẩm mỹ rất có chiều sâu, khiến người ta có cảm giác đang ở trong một dinh thự Huế xưa hơn là một khách sạn thông thường.

Lần này lại đến Huế đúng những ngày mưa. Trời âm u, cây cối xanh thẫm, những mái ngói ướt mưa càng làm không gian thêm trầm mặc và lãng mạn. Chẳng cần đi đâu xa, chỉ ngồi ngắm khu vườn, nghe tiếng mưa rơi cũng đủ thấy chuyến đi thật đáng giá.

Ancient Hue không chỉ đẹp mà còn có hồn. Một nơi lưu trú mang đậm bản sắc Huế, sang trọng theo cách rất riêng và thực sự vượt xa mong đợi của mình. 💚

reviews.text: We’ve been travelling south east Asia and this hotel stands out. Very good service. Entire staff is very friendly. The rooms were clean and impressive and the grounds and atmosphere were exceptional. If I were to use adjectives to describe it I would use: lush, boutique, luxury, impressive, pretty, peaceful, elegant with a sense of traditional charm.

reviews.textTranslated: Great
reviews.text: Tuyệt vời

Quite easily the best hotel I've ever stayed in. Service was impeccable, with friendly and warm staff diligently attending to our every need. The architecture, grounds and rooms are beautiful - especially the restaurant and the bar area.

We opted for a room with a private pool, and were pleasantly surprised that it was cleaned twice daily including mopping the floors, which was a nice touch. The pool was incredibly clean and a delight to use, secreted away under giant plants which made for a lovely ambience.

Given our love of Vietnamese food, we were surprised to find that the restaurant here provided some of the best, authentic meals we've eaten in the country. Breakfast was included, a la carte and unlimited, and the quality was miles above that of standard breakfast buffets elsewhere. We usually ordered three dishes between us to share, as well as iced coffees and infused teas or fresh juices, and staff would routinely ask if we wanted more.

Both breakfast and dinner had a wide selection available, and we felt this did not come at the cost of quality. We tried noodle soups, duck confit, chilli grouper, clams, shrimp in Thai sauce, fried rice, banh mi, bun bo hue... I even had a cheeseburger for breakfast out of curiosity, and it was so good I had to order a second one!

It also has to be said that the opening times of the restaurant are much appreciated - breakfast served until 10:00, and dinner until 22:00, allows for so much flexibility when it comes to going out on day tours, or wanting a lie-in.

Finally, the hotel were very helpful in organising a transfer to our next hotel in Hoi An. They had an itinerary planned, and the price was competitive with similar excursions on Booking.com. This gave us lovely peace of mind!

The only downside would be that the location of the hotel is not within easy walking distance of many of the attractions or eateries of Hue, but with ease of travel through apps like Grab this is a very minor issue.

We already wanted to come back to Vietnam after this holiday, and this accomodation has made that even more likely. I would recommend that anyone coming here stays at Ancient Hue Garden Houses!

Lovely, can image a better stay in Hue, would come back again
Liked
· We used to stay at a big hotel, so Ancient Hue is such a fresh place. We expected the Hue atmosphere from the photos, but this exceeded it. We booked 2 Cong Canh rooms, which are one large unit of two rooms connected by a shared entrance, plus a guest room. The whole facility is submerged in green with lovely flowers and trees. The room is spacious, and in a good way, so it makes you feel warm and calms you down. The interior is well thought out and fits the overall theme. You may feel dark at first, but when you get used to it, you will love it. You will love the à la carte breakfast as well. We tried three different dishes and loved all of them.
The facility is located near the palace, so if you want to the weather is good, you can actually walk to some of the sightseeing spots.

Disliked · There is no separate key card to keep the electricity on, so when you go out of the room and bring the key with you, everything is off. When you come back to the room it may take some time for the room to cool down again.

I had a very memorable stay at Melody Riverside Homestay. The homestay was clean, quiet, and the rooms were tidy and well-equipped. The location was convenient, and the space near the river was very airy and relaxing.

What impressed me most was the hospitality of Mr. Phong and his children. The whole family was friendly, enthusiastic, and always ready to help guests with even the smallest things. Thanks to their thoughtfulness and warmth, I felt right at home.

plusCode: FH5J+J3 Thuan Hoa, Hue, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set on a lush 3-hectare estate along the Perfume River, this premium hotel with art deco styling is 2 km from the Imperial City and 16 km from Phu Bai International Airport.
 Accommodations range from relaxed rooms overlooking the pool to elegant suites with 4-poster beds, separate living areas and claw-foot tubs. All have flat-screen TVs, tea and coffeemakers, and free Wi-Fi; most offer balconies with river or garden views.
 Along with a fine-dining restaurant and a lobby lounge, there’s a saltwater outdoor pool, a poolside bar, a spa and a gym. Other amenities include dinner cruises, cooking classes and a boutique selling local handicrafts.

These include King beds measuring 2.0 x 2.0 metres, Queen beds measuring 1.8 x 2.0 metres, and Twin beds measuring 1.0 x 2.0 metres. Your comments regarding the swimming pool have also been taken very seriously, as the safety and well-being of our guests are always our highest priority. Our pool has different depths ranging from 1.6 metres to 2.7 metres, with a lifeguard on duty daily from 6:00 to 21:00. We are pleased to know that you were safe following the incident. reviews.text:
🌿 Một kỳ nghỉ thật đáng nhớ tại Azerai Huế

Tôi đã có một kỳ nghỉ rất tuyệt vời tại Azerai Huế và thực sự ấn tượng với sự tận tâm của đội ngũ nhân viên.

Ngay từ khi bước vào resort, tôi đã cảm nhận được sự thân thiện, vui vẻ và chuyên nghiệp. Từ các bạn lễ tân, nhân viên nhà hàng đến đội ngũ tại hồ bơi, ai cũng nhiệt tình, nhẹ nhàng và luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ khách. Sự chu đáo ấy khiến tôi và gia đình cảm thấy vô cùng thoải mái.

Điều tôi đặc biệt hài lòng là không gian sạch sẽ, yên tĩnh và được chăm sóc rất kỹ lưỡng. Phòng được dọn dẹp cẩn thận, mọi thứ đều gọn gàng và chỉn chu. Có thể cảm nhận được sự tận tâm của những người đứng phía sau để tạo nên một kỳ nghỉ trọn vẹn cho khách hàng.

Đây không chỉ là một nơi để nghỉ ngơi, mà còn là nơi mang đến cho tôi cảm giác được chăm sóc và trân trọng. Những nụ cười thân thiện và sự nhiệt tình của nhân viên chính là điều khiến chuyến đi trở nên đặc biệt hơn.

💚 Cảm ơn Azerai Huế vì một trải nghiệm thật đẹp và đáng nhớ. Tôi chắc chắn sẽ quay trở lại và rất vui lòng giới thiệu nơi này cho bạn bè, người thân.

reviews.textTranslated:
-Rooms: Beautiful, clean, comfortable, with plenty of water/tea/soft drinks and seasonal fruit. Previously, the area right next to the Perfume River had a river view and a small path from the garden to the riverbank, but now that area is built, there's no longer a path to the river from the garden, and the view is somewhat limited.

-Staff: All the staff are very lovely, from the receptionist, the staff at Le Parfum restaurant, the doorman, the bartender… they are all friendly and enthusiastic.

-Location: Right in the city center, easy to get around, the hotel has bicycles if you want to cycle around Hue.

-Swimming pool: Quite good.

-Atmosphere: Quiet, even though the hotel is on a main road, the rooms are quiet and you sleep very well.

-Food: Delicious! The French bread and braised pork were the two best dishes I tried during this stay. Azerai has a small vegetable garden to supply the restaurant. You should definitely try the salted coffee at Le Parfum restaurant; it's delicious.

- Bar: quiet, chill, the bartender is charming, and the drinks are quite good.
reviews.text:
-phòng: đẹp, sạch, êm ái, nước/trà/soft drink, trái cây theo mùa đầy đủ. Trước đây khu vực ngay sát sông Hương chưa xây dựng thì có view sông và có lối mòn nhỏ đi từ vườn ra bờ sông, mà giờ bên đó xây rồi nên không còn lối đi ra sông từ vườn nữa, và tầm nhìn cũng bị hạn chế phần nào.
-nhân viên: các bạn đều rất dễ thương, từ bạn ở quầy tiếp tân, bạn ở nhà hàng Le Parfum, anh doorman, anh ở quầy bar… đều dễ thương và nhiệt tình.
-vị trí: ngay trung tâm thành phố, dễ di chuyển, có xe đạp của khách sạn nếu bạn muốn đạp xe vòng quanh Huế.
-hồ bơi: khá okie
-không gian: yên tĩnh, dù khách sạn ngay đường lớn nhưng phòng yên tĩnh, ngủ rất ngon.
-đồ ăn: ngon nhé, bánh mì Pháp và thịt kho là hai món mình thấy ngon nhất trong lần ở này. Azerai có vườn rau nhỏ để cung cấp cho nhà hàng. Đặc biệt nên thử món cafe muối tại nhà hàng Le Parfum, ngon nha.

reviews.textTranslated:
I booked a cheap room, so I didn't expect a fantastic hotel; I was only staying one night, so I didn't need much. However, upon check-in, the room didn't have blankets, and it took two hours for the receptionist to provide them. The room was peeling paint, the air conditioner was too hot, and there were flies.

I was especially unhappy with the receptionist who wore braces; she was very rude. As soon as I arrived, she told me I had to check out at 11:30 AM, even though the app I booked indicated a 12:00 AM check-out. I've always stayed at hotels with check-in times of 2 PM and check-out times of 12 AM. I said, "I see you don't have to check out until 12 AM," and she replied, "No, please check out at 11:30 AM." I didn't say anything more because my work was finished around 10 AM the next morning. But I started to think the service was terrible. The next day, because my work lasted longer, I arrived back at the hotel at 11:15 AM to get my key and waited for her for 5.7 minutes because she was busy entertaining foreign guests. Then I asked the staff if I could check out at 12 PM via the app because my child was sweating. I wanted to let the child rest a bit and take a shower in the bathroom to clean up, and I would check out at 12 PM. The staff rudely refused, even though I asked to let the child shower for a little while. I then reported back that the app showed my check-out at 12 PM. The staff member said they had already notified me yesterday at 11:30 AM. But I paid for check-out until 12 PM! Yesterday I didn't argue because I thought I'd finish my business early. I paid in full; I didn't ask for anything. After that, I checked out at 11:28 AM. I went straight to the room to get my things because I had already packed beforehand. I told the staff I would give a one-star rating, and they apologized and asked for my understanding. This is the second time. They apologize and ask for understanding just because I'm giving a one-star rating. A very bad experience at this hotel.
reviews.text:
Mình thuê phòng rẻ nên cũng không đòi hỏi khách sạn phải tuyệt vời, mình chỉ ở 1 đêm nên cũng không cần gì nhiều. Tuy nhiên nhận phòng thì phòng chưa có chăn, báo lễ tân 2 tiếng sau mới có. Phòng bong tróc, điều hòa nóng, có ruồi.
Đặc biệt mình không hài lòng bạn lễ tân đeo niềng răng, bạn rất xấu tính. Mình đến nhận phòng chưa gì đã báo 11:30 phải check out trong khi app mình đặt có báo 12:00 mới phải check out. reviews.text:
If you’re looking for an unforgettable Vietnamese dining experience, this hidden gem of a restaurant is a must-visit. Specializing in both shredded chicken and fried chicken dishes, the menu offers an incredible balance of flavors and textures that capture the essence of traditional Vietnamese cuisine.

First visit I ordered the shredded chicken, and it was nothing short of spectacular. The tender chicken was perfectly seasoned, I was shown how to mix the lime with salt and the dressing added a tangy and savory punch, making every bite refreshing and satisfying.

My next visit, I couldn’t resist the fried chicken.
Crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, this dish is a perfect example of how simplicity done right can create something extraordinary. The chicken was served with a side of salad, orange rice along with a flavorful dipping sauce that perfectly complemented the crispy skin and succulent meat.

The portions were generous, prices are very affordable and the staff were incredibly welcoming, providing top-notch service. The restaurant itself has a cozy, relaxed atmosphere, making it the perfect spot for a casual meal with friends or family.

I have dined in and also ordered takeout on a few occasions, never been disappointed either way.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Vietnamese flavors in a warm, friendly setting!

Black coffee was fine. He gave me a cup of tea to go alongside it.

Love it.

Little coffee place off the beaten track—I come here whenever I can because the iced coffee is good and they have the best prices in the city. Only 20k for milk coffee and 25k for my favorite salt coffee. They always serve free tea with lots of ice, which is really nice on a hot day too :) love their passionfruit juice…haven’t tried the  banh mi yet, but I see lots of people ordering them!

This has become our go-to place for an inexpensive, delicious Banh Mi and a cold coffee or beer.

Really nice young guys run the place and take a lot of care making the food; slicing and prepping everything to order. And then when finished, they carefully place a mesh cover back over the workstation to keep flies out. It’s little things like this where you can tell if someone really cares about the food and the customers…

They always turn fans on for us and make sure we have an extra chair to place our bags on, etc.

Very happy to have found and to frequent this little shop. Highly recommend.

reviews.text:
While craving banh mi, I stumbled upon this shop along the way. Although the name seemed different from the Google listing, the location and opening hours matched Nha Viet.

We arrived for dinner around 6 pm, and the shop was still open.

Inside, there was ample seating, and al fresco seating was available along the road. However, numerous vendors approached us while dining in al fresco.

We ordered the two recommended banh mi options suggested by the counter staff, which did not disappoint.

The meat was pork and a mix of other meats, if I recall correctly. The meat was tender and flavorful, complemented by seasoned vegetables that enhanced its taste.

Everything was delicious, with crunchy bread on the outside and soft on the inside.

The serving time was fast, and the portion size was reasonable for the price. We also ordered three drinks, all of which were excellent. The options included an avocado shake, mango yogurt, and hot cocoa, none of which were overly sweet. However, the temperature of the hot cocoa was lukewarm, rather than hot, despite my request for it to be extra hot. I suppose this is typical in Vietnam.

Everything else was perfect.

**A must-try banh mi spot in Da Nang**
I had the chance to try the beef sausage (chả bò) and sunny-side-up egg banh mi at **Banh Mi - Bread Thao**, and it was truly a satisfying experience.

The baguette was freshly baked, crispy on the outside, and warm on the inside. The filling was generous and flavorful – the beef sausage was savory and well-seasoned, and the egg added a nice richness. Simple ingredients, but prepared with care and great balance.

The shop is clean and airy, and the service is friendly and welcoming. The staff speak English well, which makes it easy for international travelers to order. Prices are affordable and fair for both locals and tourists.

If you’re in Da Nang and looking for a high-quality, authentic banh mi, this place is definitely worth a visit.

An Absolutely Perfect Anniversary Dinner at Le Comptoir

Our 4th wedding anniversary dinner at Le Comptoir was truly a perfect experience.

From our email correspondence before the visit, to the warm welcome we received when we walked through the door, and all the way until we left, every moment was exceptional.

In particular, Myriam Moretto showed an extraordinary level of care and consideration toward my wife, who is 19 weeks pregnant.

Before we began the six-course menu, she thoughtfully considered the sauces, cooking methods, and harmony of the ingredients, and kindly modified several dishes for my wife, incorporating elements from the eight-course menu at no additional charge. It made us feel that we were receiving a truly special and personalized experience created just for us.

My wife was also able to enjoy a wine pairing experience alongside me, thanks to the team’s incredible kindness and patience. Even when I asked several times to confirm that the wine offered to her was truly 0.00% non-alcoholic, they responded with genuine warmth and professionalism.

We were equally impressed by the professionalism of the entire team. Every dish was explained with care and precision, and every course was served with remarkable attention to detail.

We would also like to express our sincere gratitude to the sommelier, who introduced each wine—from the sparkling and white wines to the reds—with such warmth, knowledge, and genuine pride in their work.

Although there were some language barriers, every member of the serving team continued to treat us with extraordinary kindness and consideration throughout the entire evening. Their hospitality truly touched us.

The evening ended beautifully with a special “Happy 4th Anniversary” lettering service, making our anniversary dinner absolutely perfect.

If we ever need a reason to come back to Da Nang, visiting Le Comptoir again will be one of the first reasons that comes to mind.

Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for the wonderful hospitality, thoughtfulness, and care you showed to both of us. You made our 4th wedding anniversary an unforgettable memory.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a heartwarming and detailed review! Happy 4th Anniversary from all of us! We are deeply honored that you chose to celebrate such a special milestone with us at Le Comptoir.

Myriam and our entire team are absolutely thrilled to hear that your evening was so memorable. Ensuring the comfort, safety, and delight of expecting mothers is something we take great pride in, so we are delighted that the customized course adjustments and our 0.00% non-alcoholic wine pairing made your wife’s experience feel truly seamless and special.

Providing a personalized, attentive fine dining experience is at the heart of what we do. From our kitchen team carefully tailoring each dish to our sommelier curating thoughtfully paired selections, we aim to deliver authentic French cuisine with genuine warmth and care. Hearing that our team's dedication touched your hearts is the greatest reward we could ask for.

As a Michelin Selected restaurant in Da Nang, creating unforgettable celebrations like yours inspires us every day. We cannot wait to welcome you and your growing family back to Le Comptoir whenever your journeys bring you back to Vietnam! 💙🤍❤️

reviews.text:
Le Comptoir – An unforgettable signature tasting menu experience

We booked the Le Grand Menu Signature for a special dinner, and every single course was thoughtfully crafted, beautifully plated, and full of wonderful, layered flavours.

The meal started with delicate amuse-bouche, fresh BB Boudeuses oysters served on ice with a bright mignonette, paired with warm house-baked bread. Next came a stunning fish course in a clear aromatic broth, followed by the luxurious caviar dish, silky and balanced. The main pigeon was perfectly cooked, tender pink meat with rich fruit purée and nutty crunch that complemented the game beautifully.

The cheese selection was absolutely phenomenal — a huge curated table of French artisanal cheeses, from creamy bries to bold blues and aged hard cheeses, served with dried fruits, nuts and homemade preserves. The dessert sequence was such a lovely surprise: the wooden chocolate box engraved with Happy Wife Happy Life was such a charming touch, filled with handcrafted petit fours.

The open kitchen counter seating lets you watch the chefs work their magic, the service was attentive and knowledgeable, and the wine pairing worked seamlessly with every dish. This is fine dining with heart, not just pretty plates. Every bite felt intentional.

A wonderful night for a celebration. Highly recommend the signature grand menu if you love classic French gastronomy with refined modern touches. Will absolutely return!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a magnificent, detailed, and heartwarming review!

We are truly honored that you chose Le Grand Menu Signature for your special celebration. Chef Olivier and our entire culinary team design this tasting menu to be a complete journey through classic French gastronomy with modern precision, so hearing how much you enjoyed each progression—from the fresh BB Boudeuses oysters and delicate fish broth to the caviar and perfectly roasted pigeon—means the world to us.

Our curated artisanal cheese table is a passion project for us, so we are thrilled it was a highlight of your evening! We are also delighted that the engraved wooden box added a special, personal touch to your dessert sequence and celebration.

Watching the kitchen team at work from the counter while enjoying the wine pairing is truly the best way to experience Le Comptoir, and knowing that every detail felt intentional to you is the highest compliment we could receive.

Thank you again for your glowing review and high recommendation. It was an absolute pleasure hosting you both, and we cannot wait to welcome you back for another unforgettable evening in Da Nang!

reviews.text: This is the most good value Michelin star restaurant I have ever tried so far.  Very nice food and ambience, and good use of local herbs and flavors.  We took the 6-course Retour de voyage menu plus 3 pcs of oyster, with 5 glasses of wine pairing. It only costs around $1080 HKD or 150 USD! The wine pairing is particularly excellent and like all other good French restaurants, they provide really good homemade bread and pastries. I couldn’t resist but to encore the mini olive pastry which is divine. All course were good but the main course lamb suddenly twisted into a somewhat Indian pallet. While I personally quite like the curry flavor in the sauce, it kind of deviated from the Vietnamese breeze. But as a whole, this is definitely a must-go for any food lover.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Chef Olivier and his kitchen team put an immense amount of passion into crafting our seasonal tasting menus. Chef Olivier loves combining traditional French culinary techniques with vibrant local Vietnamese herbs and subtle global influences—like the aromatic spice accents in our lamb main course inspired by his travels—to create a unique and elevated dining journey. Knowing that you found the wine pairings exceptional and couldn’t resist an extra helping of our olive pastry is the ultimate compliment for our entire team!

As a Michelin Selected restaurant in Da Nang, our mission is to offer an exceptional fine dining experience that delivers outstanding quality, warm ambiance, and incredible value for our guests.

Thank you once again for your passionate support and high recommendation for all food lovers. We look forward to welcoming you back to Le Comptoir for another unforgettable evening of authentic French cuisine on your next trip to Da Nang!

(English below) 
Tại Sky View Restaurant, chúng tôi tin rằng một món ăn tốt cho sức khỏe hoàn toàn có thể là một trải nghiệm bùng nổ vị giác . Bông Cải Áp Chảo là sự sáng tạo của đội ngũ đầu bếp Sky View Restaurant dành cho những thực khách yêu thích lối sống thực dưỡng và ẩm thực tinh tế.

✨ Trải nghiệm ngay tại Sky View Restaurant.
_____
More than just a vegetarian dish, our Cauliflower Steak is a chef-crafted creation designed for guests who appreciate wholesome dining and refined flavors.
Featuring pan-seared cauliflower, creamy green pea purée, fresh arugula, chimichurri, and vibrant red pepper sauce, this dish delivers a delicate balance of flavor, texture, and presentation.
Created to offer a healthier yet equally sophisticated dining experience, it's a perfect choice for those seeking something light, nourishing, and beautifully crafted.

🌊  THE FLAVOUR OF THE SEA, ELEVATED 🌊 
(English below)
Lấy cảm hứng từ nguồn hải sản phong phú và tươi ngon của vùng biển miền Trung, Sky View Restaurant tuyển chọn và mang đến "Hải Sản Đà Nẵng Đốt Lửa"– một trải nghiệm ẩm thực tinh tế và khác biệt.
Sức hút của món ăn đến từ vị ngọt của tôm, độ giòn của mực, vị béo của cồi mai cùng cá biển tươi ngon. Tất cả cùng hòa quyện và thăng hoa dưới ngọn lửa bùng cháy ngay tại bàn - một kỹ thuật độc đáo giúp giữ trọn vị ngọt tự nhiên và mọng nước của từng loại hải sản, đồng thời khơi dậy hương thơm biển khơi đầy mê hoặc.
Thêm vào đó là sự kết hợp tinh tế cùng khoai tây fondant mềm mịn, rau củ theo mùa và hai loại sốt đặc trưng được sáng tạo độc quyền bởi đội ngũ đầu bếp Sky View sẽ dẫn dắt vị giác của thực khách qua từng cung bậc cảm xúc khác nhau.
Đây là cách Sky View Restaurant kể câu chuyện về Đà Nẵng qua từng nguyên liệu địa phương và món ăn được chăm chút đến từng chi tiết.
✨ Hãy để Sky View kết nối bạn với hương vị đặc trưng của biển Đà Nẵng, trong không gian ngắm trọn thành phố từ trên cao.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Riverside Terrace Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. The rooftop view was the highlight of the night, with an amazing riverside atmosphere that made the whole experience even more special and relaxing.
A special thank you to Van, our waitress, who was incredibly attentive, friendly, and very fast with service. She made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal and always checked on us with a smile. Great food, stunning rooftop views, and excellent service — highly recommended when visiting Da Nang!

We visited this restaurant yesterday. We booked a table in advance via Instagram, and there were no issues with that; they responded quickly. We specifically chose the fourth-floor terrace so we could watch the Dragon Bridge show in the evening. The waitstaff were friendly and tried to resolve issues promptly. That pretty much sums up the positives of the place. My child ordered the Marsala Gnocchi but couldn't finish it; I couldn't finish it either after trying his portion—it was incredibly salty. Then again, I’m just sharing our experience; perhaps some people actually like it that way. We spent a long time choosing a pizza and eventually ordered the Meat Lover Pizza. That was a huge mistake. The pizza was incredibly spicy. I generally dislike spicy food—even just a little bit. There was no indication on the menu that this pizza was spicy, even though other items did have such notes. I urge you to add a spicy label to the menu for this pizza so other guests don't end up as disappointed as I was yesterday (assuming they don't like spicy food, of course). It was a very unpleasant surprise. They offered to replace the pizza with a non-spicy one for free, but the experience was already ruined. They also offered a complimentary cocktail, but we declined; we didn't want anything else at that point. The only good thing about the pizza was the dough—it was actually excellent. Overall, the food was terrible. I would never come back here. I really regret choosing this place.

From the moment we walked in we knew we were going to have a good night. Straight away the owner came over and introduced himself. It was amazing to hear and see how passionate he is about his restaurant and his customers. This restaurant is located with an amazing view of the dragon bridge. Our food did take an hour to come out, however, it was worth it!! The lasagne is amazing! The owner compensated due to the wait time and let us up on the terrace to watch the dragon bridge show! I would recommend booking in advance to get a table on the terrace if you are wanting to see the show as there is limited seating and the restaurant is very busy! I have to give credit to the staff too who were so attentive and helpful.

Best tiramisu I've ever had in my lifeeee!!
Amazing creamy cheesy salmon pasta with sizeable salmon chunks (I was licking my plate) lychee cocktail to die for and to finish it off the most delectable tiramisu (and I'm tiramisu obsessed) in an adorable mug that made my entire week.
Service was lovely and attentive (we were served by the wonderful Hau) top location and lovely warm atmosphere.
So many food options to choose from!!
Overall no complaints, a delicious experience, I'm full and happy.

Awesome service and food. Our server was Hein and what a great guy, he recommended us some dishes and even took good pictures of us. The salmon he recommended was great and everything we ordered was really yummy too. The view is nice and the atmosphere is nice too, we’re coming back next weekend to see the dragon bridge show

I've been traveling in Southeast Asia for a few months now, and called a craving for Italian food for the first time in a long time. I'm so glad I did and that the Riverside terrace restaurant was here when that happened.

truly an amazing dining experience. the bruschetta sampler was incredible and recommended to me. does spaghetti and meatballs was also very nostalgic. I finished off my meal with a double espresso and chocolate gelato and both were perfect.

I can't say enough about the service though. extremely friendly and attentive staff. I can't say a bad word about this restaurant and I wish I could give the service 10 Stars instead of 5.

bravo 👏

We had the pleasure of dining at this fantastic Italian restaurant in Da Nang city centre and decided to take a night off from local cuisine. It was definitely worth it.

The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment we arrived. We chose to sit on the balcony. The stairs were a bit of a workout (haha), but absolutely worth it for the beautiful view. We even caught the sunset, which made the experience even more special.

The food was delicious. I ordered the chicken parmigiana, which came with a side of pasta, and the flavours were spot on. The portion sizes were just right, leaving you satisfied without feeling too full.

Overall, I loved the vibe of this place. It’s relaxed, inviting, and perfect for a great meal. If I’m ever back in Da Nang, I’ll definitely return. Highly recommend if you’re in town and craving some quality Italian food.

Huge disappointment – the magic is completely gone! ⭐⭐

On our last visit, this restaurant was an absolute gem. It served delicious, authentic Italian food and was run by an Italian owner who played live guitar, creating a truly magical atmosphere.

Unfortunately, the restaurant has changed hands, and all of that magic is gone. The food is okay, but nothing more than mediocre.

There was nothing special about it, and we got some rather boring pizzas where the crust and toppings just didn’t harmonize.

What made it even more disappointing was that we contacted them via WhatsApp three days in advance to specifically confirm if they still had the same owner and live music. They assured us they did, but the reality was a massive letdown. The cozy live guitar was replaced by terrible, loud, "ferry-style" music. The local Vietnamese musicians didn't even know the lyrics to the songs, making the whole experience noisy and distracting rather than atmospheric.

We will unfortunately not be returning, and we can no longer recommend this place to anyone.
