reviews.text:
We are South African, coming from a country with a large Indian population and a strong love for bold, flavourful curries, so we are quite picky when it comes to Indian food. This meal absolutely delivered as everything we ordered was excellent.

The chicken tikka masala was creamy, well balanced and full of flavour. The chicken was tender and clearly well marinated. The lamb biryani was fragrant and beautifully presented with generous pieces of juicy lamb and a lovely mix of spices. It came with raita on the side which added a nice cooling contrast. The garlic naan was soft, warm and generously brushed with garlic and butter, perfect for scooping up the curries. To finish, we shared gulab jamun, which was warm, soft and soaked in syrup and the perfect way to end the meal.

The restaurant itself has a warm, stylish atmosphere with a lovely bar area and comfortable seating. Service was quick and the staff were genuinely friendly and attentive throughout. The place quickly filled up while we were there and it was just an average Tuesday night. Overall, a fantastic Indian meal in Da Nang and definitely somewhere we would return to and happily recommend.

reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Maazi. We visited the restaurant multiple times during our stay and had a consistently good experience every time. The food was excellent, and everything we tried from the garlic naan and crispy corn bhel to the kadai paneer and dal makhani was delicious and well prepared.
The staff were polite, friendly, and attentive, making it a very pleasant dining experience. The location is also convenient, just a short distance from Dragon Bridge.
One small downside is that regular drinking water isn’t provided, and outside water cannot be brought in, so you have to purchase bottled water. It would be great if complimentary regular water was available.
Overall, a great place for Indian food in Da Nang and definitely worth considering if you're craving authentic Indian flavours while in Vietnam.

My sisters and I had dinner here on May 3 and were impressed at how tasty everything was. There was a dish i wasnt impressed with - the pani puri bc the pani/sauce was thick and and had too much ginger for my taste. But the corn app was phenomenal and the paneer tikka masala in the dishes was reallllllly tasty snd the paneer so soft and melty. We also had the shrimp dish which also had a completely different flavor palette than the paneer which was good because sometimes restaurants use the same sauce for everything. The service was also great as within minutes he got us the extras we asked for. Am recommending this place to my family too - high praise.

reviews.text:
Amazing food in a fantastic restaurant. The sounds, sights and amazing smells make this a great culinary experience.

Our server, Suraj went out of his way to explain each dish we were interested in to ensure we had the best experience.

We started with the Papadum & chutney dipping sauce, followed up with the Keema cheese loaded fries, Tandoori Chicken Tikka and then Desi Butter chicken accompanied by Cheese naan, Tandoori Roti and Chappati. Dessert was a delicious Gulab Jamun.

A glass of chilled white wine and an ice cold beer topped off the evening.

I definitely recommend this restaurant if you're chasing Indian cuisine in Da Nang.

During my trip to Da Nang, I was honestly craving some authentic Indian food after continuously trying different cuisines for almost a week. That’s when I visited Maazi Da Nang, and I can confidently say this is one of the best Indian restaurants in the city. The moment the food arrived, it completely brought my taste buds back to life after 7 days of travelling.

The flavors were rich, authentic, perfectly balanced and felt just like home. Every dish was freshly prepared with proper Indian spices, something that is very difficult to find while travelling abroad. The aroma, presentation and taste were simply outstanding. You can genuinely feel the effort and passion they put into maintaining authentic Indian flavors.

Apart from the food, the ambience of the restaurant was warm, clean and welcoming. The staff members were extremely polite, friendly and made sure we were comfortable throughout our dining experience. Service was quick and professional, which made the experience even better.

If you are visiting Da Nang and missing Indian food, then this place is an absolute must-visit. I would highly recommend Maazi Da Nang to every Indian traveller and food lover. Trust me, this restaurant will definitely make your trip even more memorable. 🇮🇳❤️

We had an amazing dining experience at MAAZI Da Nang! Every dish was incredibly delicious, full of authentic flavors, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was warm and cozy, making our dinner even more enjoyable.

A special thank you to Bao, who took such great care of us. He was genuinely kind, friendly, attentive, and always made sure we had everything we needed. His excellent customer service made us feel so welcome from start to finish.

If you’re looking for authentic Indian food in Da Nang with outstanding service, this place is definitely a must-visit. We’ll definitely come back. Highly recommended! ❤️🇮🇳✨

We visited MAAZI Indian Restaurant with a friend, and it was my first time trying Indian food. Everything was delicious, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. We really enjoyed the experience.

A special thanks to Taleb, who served us during our visit. He was very friendly, helpful, and welcoming. Since we were new to Indian cuisine, he guided us through the menu and helped us choose some traditional Indian dishes that suited our tastes perfectly.

Thank you, Taleb, for your excellent service and for making our first Indian food experience so enjoyable. We highly recommend this restaurant!

Delicious. Service from Anish was amazing he was very welcoming and friendly. We got the samosa chaat, panic puri, butter chicken and paneer biryani. Too much for just two people but we got leftovers for lunch tomorrow so we're happy. Would recommend!

reviews.text:
Undoubtedly, this is an experience worth trying. And I can say for sure — it’s not for everyone. For people who love Michelin restaurants, it’s often more about the label, where the food frequently does not match the quality that is claimed. Yes, Michelin today is largely a commercial story.

Now, about this place we visited today — this is a story about real quality, about details, which is the most important thing. Yes, details. And for those who are actually able to appreciate them. These details include the service — and I would even say synchronized service — the quality of the food itself, the presentation, and of course the interior and the intimacy. Because intimacy is key here.

There are only three tables on the second floor. We’ve already been here once with friends from our group. And downstairs there are two tables: one for two people and one for a small group. So in total, the restaurant serves only three tables. Just imagine that. The entire kitchen and the entire staff work exclusively for you. Can you imagine that? Yes, you can — in places like this.

This is not for people who love flashy social gold. This is for those who truly know how to appreciate what is offered here. This is my second time at this restaurant, and I’m sure I’ll come back again and again, because now I live in Da Nang. And this is one of my absolute favorite places. Yes, it may not be a place for everyday dining due to the cost, but why not allow yourself such exceptional cuisine from time to time?

From what we ate, my absolute favorite was the lamb. The lamb here is prepared in the best way I have ever tried in my life. And it turns out — I do like lamb after all. In other places, I didn’t. I can say with certainty: this is the best lamb I’ve ever eaten.

As for the steak: it was most likely cooked sous-vide. And it’s simply fantastic. Excellent meat, excellent quality. There is absolutely no sense of freezing and defrosting. Everything is served exactly as it should be. And I’m saying this as someone who lives in Argentina — the country of meat. This is one of the best steaks I’ve ever had in my life. Even better than the ones I cook myself.

Of course, the tartare. The tartare is done beautifully. Everything is correct, with an excellent recipe. This is something that only people who truly love tartare can appreciate. We also tried the seasonal fish. The portion was small, but everything was very flavorful and well executed. And the risotto — truffle risotto — simply brilliant. Brilliantly made, delivering pleasure to every single taste receptor.

In fact, I’ve tried almost everything at this restaurant. We also tried the set menu before. I liked about 70–80% of the dishes in the set menu. Around 20% were just okay. But overall, the set menu is still a very good alternative for those who want to try everything at once. Not everything from the main menu, of course — it’s a separate selection — but it’s a very solid experience that deserves attention.

Now about alcohol. This is definitely the weak point. Some of the alcohol here is spoiled. Some of it, frankly speaking, does not match the level of the food at all. That’s why the second time, we didn’t drink alcohol. And honestly, everything is great even without it.

I understand that Vietnam is not Argentina or France, so wine culture is simpler here. And another reason the wine is spoiled is likely not the restaurant itself, but the supply chain — from producer countries to distributors and then to restaurants. I’ve noticed this not for the first time in Asia: much of the alcohol, especially red wine, is spoiled or sour. Red wine cannot be kept for more than a few hours at temperatures above 22–24°C. That’s something to keep in mind.

Overall, this is an experience that truly deserves attention. And I recommend it to those who are genuinely capable of appreciating it.

Find a cozy corner, choose light and wholesome dishes, and enjoy a balanced, refreshing meal together.

Tại The Nomad Kitchen, những bữa ăn lành mạnh không chỉ mang đến dưỡng chất mà còn là cách tuyệt vời để gắn kết với người bạn đồng hành của mình. Một phần salad tươi mát, một lát bánh mì sourdough nướng vừa giòn, hay đơn giản là một ly nước ép nguyên chất, tất cả đều góp phần tạo nên một cuộc hẹn đầy dịu dàng và tinh tế. 
Chọn một góc bàn yên tĩnh, gọi vài món ăn nhẹ nhàng và tươi mới, và tận hưởng bữa ăn thật trọn vẹn cùng nhau nhé.
—
𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗡𝗢𝗠𝗔𝗗 𝗞𝗜𝗧𝗖𝗛𝗘𝗡

Refuel right after your gym session with our wholesome combo: a protein-packed Turkey Ham Omelette paired with a refreshing glass of fresh juice.
➖ 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘆 𝗛𝗮𝗺 𝗢𝗺𝗲𝗹𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲: packed with protein from homemade turkey ham, nutrient-rich spinach, creamy cream cheese, served with a slice of mixed-nuts sourdough bread and avocado on the side.
➖ 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗵 𝗝𝘂𝗶𝗰𝗲: made with seasonal fruits and vegetables. No added sugar, just pure goodness to help you hydrate and recharge.
All fresh. All balanced. All ready for you after a good sweat.
---
Bổ sung năng lượng sau buổi tập với combo dinh dưỡng của The Nomad Kitchen: Turkey Ham Omelette giàu đạm kết hợp với một ly nước ép tươi mát.
➖ 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘆 𝗛𝗮𝗺 𝗢𝗺𝗲𝗹𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲: kết hợp turkey ham nhà làm giàu protein, rau chân vịt giàu dưỡng chất, phô mai kem béo mịn, ăn kèm với bánh sourdough hạt mix và bơ tươi.
➖ 𝗙𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗵 𝗝𝘂𝗶𝗰𝗲: ép từ trái cây và rau củ theo mùa, không thêm đường, chỉ có vị ngon thuần khiết để bạn bù nước và nạp lại năng lượng.
Tươi ngon, cân bằng, và sẵn sàng tiếp sức cho bạn sau mỗi buổi tập.
—

At The Nomad Kitchen, our rotisserie chicken is slow-roasted every Sunday in a traditional rotisserie machine, allowing the meat to stay tender and naturally juicy while the skin turns evenly golden with a delicate crispness and a rich, comforting aroma.
Served with roasted potatoes, seasonal vegetables, and warm gravy on the side, it’s a generous, well-balanced dish that’s perfect for sharing at the table.
To make sure each chicken is prepared at its best, we recommend placing your order at least 24 hours in advance via our Hotline or Fanpage.

Ăn kèm với khoai tây nướng, rau củ theo mùa và phần xốt nóng dùng cùng, đây là một lựa chọn vừa đầy đặn, cân bằng và rất phù hợp cho những bữa ăn muốn chia sẻ cùng nhau trên bàn.

reviews.text:
As full-time travelers behind our Sunsets & Speakeasies YouTube channel, we eat out a lot, and The Nomad Kitchen on An Thuong 32 seriously impressed us. We showed up hungry—this was our one and only meal of the day—and thankfully, we picked the right place. The space itself is clean, modern, and open, with a relaxed atmosphere that lets the food take center stage.

We decided to share everything, which turned out to be the way to go. The steak was perfectly prepared, with a quality cut and excellent cook. The General Tso’s chicken special was packed with flavor, but the Wagyu Reuben sandwich was sublime. Easily one of those dishes where you take the first bite, look across the table, and immediately know you’re both thinking the same thing. The kitchen team clearly knows what they’re doing—not only with flavor and technique, but with beautiful presentation as well.

We paired everything with two fresh juices and somehow found room to finish with a gorgeous lemon tart, which was the perfect bright ending to a seriously satisfying meal.

The staff were incredible throughout our visit—friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Between the professional kitchen team, quality ingredients, presentation, and service, The Nomad Kitchen punches well above a casual neighborhood restaurant.

If you’re staying around An Thuong in Da Nang, put this one on your list. Come hungry, order a few things to share, and do not skip that Wagyu Reuben.

Highly recommended. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Dustin 😊

reviews.text:
Very friendly service, which was appreciated!

Unfortunately, the food was just ok. I felt like my chicken pesto sandwich was quite tasteless and lacked seasoning, and quite cold (a scarce amount of chips too). My boyfriend enjoyed the steak on his salad but he also thought it was just ok.

We got a free dessert because I asked about the sandwich and chips.

We probably wouldn’t return, wasn’t a favourite and was expecting much better.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jackie, thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback, and also for the kind words about our service — our team really appreciates it.
Regarding the seasoning, we understand your point. Because we have customers from many different countries and preferences, we intentionally keep the seasoning a bit lighter than we personally might prefer. For that reason, we always place salt and pepper on the table so everyone can adjust the flavor exactly to their taste.
About the chips in the sandwich, it seems our kitchen made a mistake and didn’t add the usual amount — thank you for pointing that out. We’ll make sure to remind the team so it doesn’t happen again.
We’re glad you mentioned the issue while you were here so we could offer you a dessert, but we’re still sorry that the experience didn’t meet your expectations. If you ever decide to give us another try in the future, we’d love the opportunity to do better.
Thanks again for visiting us and for the feedback. 🙏
Dani.

reviews.text:
Arrived here for food at around half twelve on a Sunday. We hadn't booked so sat upstairs as it was fairly busy. We were quickly served, the waitress was lovely and super attentive. We both ordered the buffalo roast dinner and a couple of cold beers. The food was fantastic! The meat was super succulent and all the accompanying vegetables perfectly cooked and tasty. As a Brit I found it to be a first class roast dinner.

The rest of the menu looks amazing too, so I think we will be back very soon. Highly recommend this place 👌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you souch Steve 🙏☺️😍

reviews.text: Stopped here looking for a healthy late night dinner (7pm). Didn't expect much but turns out the food was good quality and delicious. My chicken salad was pretty filling. Spent about $530,000 dong for two meals and two juice drinks. Came with complementary bread-cracker sticks while you wait. We will be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for such a nice review:)

reviews.text:
If you are experiencing a bit of local food fatigue and craving some top-tier Western comfort food, The Nomad Kitchen is an absolute lifesaver! True to its name, this place is a fantastic haven for expats, travelers, and digital nomads in Da Nang.
Their menu boasts an incredible Mediterranean selection, but they are especially famous for being a sandwich and burger paradise. The ingredients are always fresh, the portions are hearty, and the flavors hit the spot perfectly. The venue itself is modern and inviting, featuring lovely outdoor seating under hanging greenery and a spacious glass-fronted dining room. It’s a brilliant, reasonably priced spot to grab a satisfying dinner, meet fellow travelers, or simply enjoy a taste of home. Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Lealia, make us really happy.

reviews.text: The food wasn’t bad but a bit overpriced for what you get. The service was lovely though, especially the girl with the tattoo, very friendly and spoke good English, and had such a warm smile. She really stood out!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're so glad that our service stood out to you and that our friendly, English-speaking team member made your visit so pleasant. We will be sure to share your kind words with her. We also appreciate your constructive note about the pricing and will take it into consideration with our team. We look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

reviews.text:
Amazing place to have fish.

I have eaten fish in many places but this one stands out above everything else.

The texture was perfect. Crispy on the outside and incredibly tender inside. It almost melted without feeling too soft. That balance is rare.

The flavor was clean and fresh. You could really taste the quality of the fish, not hidden behind heavy seasoning. 🫶🏻

It took me two weeks, but I finally found it!
You know when you’ve been traveling for ages and you hope a pray that your new destination will have your perfect go-to restaurant that has a great menu, fresh ingredients, reasonable prices, nice atmosphere and attentiveness staff.
Can’t wait to try breakfast 😊
Yup, this is the one!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
hank you so much for taking the time to share this. We know how exhausting traveling can be, and hearing that we became your 'perfect go-to spot' after a long search is the highest compliment we could ever hope for.

We can't wait to welcome you back for breakfast—our morning menu is crafted with love, and we're sure it'll be the perfect start to your day. See you very soon!

title: Gypsy Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
ownerDescription:
THE GYPSY is perched on the rooftop of the stylish New Orient Hotel in Hai Chau district. The panoramic, wrap-around terraces offer 360-degree views of the stunning Da Nang skyline overlooking the city and the iconic river.
The restaurant and lounge bar have been designed to the finest detail, wowing guests at every turn. THE GYPSY offers a modern dining experience, revisiting world-famous ingredients & recipes with a twist using different cooking techniques including a custom made wood fire oven.
Behind the Gypsy is a multicultural crew who brought their experiences from Cannes, Hong-Kong, Shanghai to create an unforgettable dining experience for their guests.

reviews.text:
We stumbled upon The Gypsy while looking for rooftops in Da Nang online and booked for the following evening.
The menu is Mediterranean-inspired, and honestly, the food was 10/10. There wasn’t a meal we didn’t love!
We HIGHLY recommend both the pan seared scallops and lamb skewer from the mains - both were cooked to perfection.
As Australians, we are spoilt for choice back home. But this meal has surpassed even some of the better restaurants back home.
On top of a great meal, the service was phenomenal, and the views were epic!
We cannot wait to return to Da Nang to come back to The Gypsy!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the incredible 10/10 review, Bianca! We are absolutely thrilled that finding us online led to such a memorable dining experience on our rooftop. Hearing that our pan-seared scallops and lamb skewers stood out to you—and even surpassed some of the fantastic dining options you have back home in Australia—is a massive compliment to our kitchen team. We are so glad you enjoyed our epic views and phenomenal service as well, and we already can't wait to welcome you back on your next trip to Da Nang!

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved our dinner at Gypsy Rooftop Restaurant & Bar. We ordered two set menus and every single dish was delicious — beautifully presented, well balanced, and consistently impressive from start to finish.

The rooftop setting is also gorgeous, with a really nice atmosphere and view, making the whole evening feel very special.

Service was excellent as well. A special mention to Ly, who was extremely professional, attentive and friendly throughout the dinner. He explained everything clearly, checked on us at the right moments and made sure we were well taken care of without being intrusive.

Great food, beautiful ambience and outstanding service. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Da Nang. Highly recommended!

We will be sure to pass along your special shoutout to Ly—he will be delighted to hear that his professional and attentive service made your evening feel so seamless and special.

reviews.text:
An absolutely fantastic dining experience from start to finish! The atmosphere was elegant with an amazing view, creating the perfect setting for dinner. I ordered a Truffle Pizza, Truffle Rigatoni, and a cocktail, and everything was beautifully presented and full of flavor. The quality of the ingredients really stood out.

What made the experience even better was the staff. Everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, attentive, and professional throughout the evening. As a lovely surprise, they even treated me to a complimentary shot at the end, which was a very thoughtful gesture.

I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Da Nang. Excellent food, outstanding service, and a wonderful atmosphere. I will definitely come back!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the fantastic review and recommendation, Gregory! We are delighted to hear that you had such a memorable dining experience at The Gypsy Da Nang and that you enjoyed our views, cocktails, Truffle Pizza, and Truffle Rigatoni. Delivering top-quality dishes and warm, attentive hospitality is what we strive for every night, so knowing our team made your evening special—right down to that final toast—means the world to us. We truly appreciate your support and can’t wait to welcome you back on your next trip to Da Nang!

reviews.text:
My wife and I had dinner at Gypsy for my wife's birthday on Friday April 24th, 2026. From the moment we walked through the entryway we knew the night would be something special. The service was exceptional - staff constantly ready to top up glasses etc, without being in any way intrusive. The food was beautifully prepared, cooked and presented and was absolutley delicious. Chef prepared a special amuse bouche which was divine. We started with oysters and the goat's cheese salad. Although the oysters are a little smaller than we are used to in Australia, they were excellent. The goat's cheese salad was delicious. For mains, I had the mushroom rigatoni and my wife had the seafood risotto and they were both absolutely delicious. The wine list was pretty extensive and reasonably priced for Vietnam, where wines can be quite expensive. We finished off with the blueberry cheesecake, presented with the staff all singing "Happy Birthday".
We had such a great night that as we were walking out, we made another booking for our last night in Danang. We highly recommend Gypsy rooftop - it was a sensational experience.
Update; we returned on Monday night 4th May 2026. The scallop tartare was delicious, as was the salmon spaghetti. Service was again sensational. We will definitely be back next time we visit Danang.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi John,

Thank you so much for choosing Gypsy to celebrate your wife's birthday! It was a pleasure having you both with us on April 24th, and I am thrilled to hear that the evening felt special from the moment you arrived.

I’m particularly glad the service hit that perfect balance of being attentive yet non-intrusive—that is exactly what we strive for. It’s also great to hear your feedback on the menu; I will certainly share your compliments with our Chef regarding the amuse-bouche and the mains. We are quite proud of our wine selection and are happy it hit the mark for you.

Sharing that birthday cheesecake with the team's singing is always a highlight for us, too!

We are honored that you’ve already booked your final night in Da Nang with us. We look forward to welcoming you back for another sensational experience before you head home!

Warm regards,

The Owner

reviews.text:
I decided to come to Gypsy Rooftop because I thought it was cool spot to see the city of Đa Nang from. I have to say that this spot blew my socks off. The poolside lounge has a 180° view of the city and is tastefully decorated with an option to dine inside the restaurant.

The restaurant offers a fusion of Mediterranean cuisine with a Vietnamese flare. I ordered the waygu linguine and my partner ordered the truffle rigatoni. The noodles we done to perfection, the meat portion was plenty, and the PORTIONS were rather large (I can't believe I'm writing this :o). The servers ended up adding more truffle aioli to my partners dish, which we thought was a hit overkill, as the rigatoni was quite rich.

I honestly think that the portions could be a little bit smaller because the dishes are rich with flavours that it is impossible to eat the whole thing; the prices should also reflect the smaller portion sizes.

The service was top notch. All the servers spoke english and we're well versed in suggesting wine pairings to along with the dishes. My partner absolutely loved the cocktails he had there. Needless to say, we'll be going back before we leave.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Adela, thank you so much for the detailed and thoughtful review! We are thrilled that our 180° rooftop view and the Wagyu Linguine "blew your socks off." It’s also wonderful to hear that our team’s wine pairing suggestions hit the mark.

Regarding the Truffle Rigatoni, we truly appreciate your honest feedback about the richness and the extra aioli. We strive for that perfect balance, and your comments on portion sizes and flavor intensity are very helpful for our culinary team to hear. We hope to welcome you back again before you leave Da Nang to try another one of our fusion creations!

reviews.text: The atmosphere was fantastic, and the service was truly first-class. What I really appreciated was that the staff were attentive without ever making you feel pressured or overwhelmed. They took the time to explain the dishes in detail, including where the ingredients came from and the story behind the food. Everything felt thoughtful and genuine. Definitely a wonderful dining experience and highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the glowing review and high recommendation, August!

We are so glad to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere and received first-class service. Our team works hard to offer attentive, genuine hospitality that feels welcoming without being intrusive. Knowing that you appreciated the detailed stories behind our dishes and the origin of our ingredients means so much to us—we love sharing the passion that goes into every plate!

Thank you for joining us at **The Gypsy Da Nang**, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another thoughtful dining experience soon!

reviews.text: We visited during the weekend fireworks and had an amazing time! The buffet that night was excellent, and I highly recommend trying the pasta station. While it is on the pricier side, the stunning rooftop views, incredible food, and the firework show made our first night absolutely unforgettable. The staff was also incredibly nice and welcoming.

reviews.text:
Ponte Cafe & Eatery was such a beautiful brunch experience in Da Nang. The atmosphere immediately caught our attention — peaceful, clean, cozy, and relaxing with the greenery and koi pond right by the window. It was the perfect little spot to sit, eat, and enjoy the scenery.

We ordered the salmon with a fresh side salad, sourdough bread, and scrambled eggs on the side. Everything came out fresh, beautifully presented, and delicious. The salmon was especially good, and the scrambled eggs were cooked just right. Our drinks were also refreshing and paired perfectly with the meal.

Now let me tell you about the owner/waitress — she was funny, welcoming, and sweet to the bone! Her personality made the experience even better. After we finished eating, she even gave us food so we could feed the koi fish outside. That little touch turned brunch into a whole experience and made the visit feel extra special.

The food was great, the service was warm, and the atmosphere was beautiful. This is absolutely a place I would return to while in Da Nang. 5 stars all the way.

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience absolutely not worth the hype.
Visited after seeing the great Google reviews and drove around 5 km specifically to have dinner here. Unfortunately, the experience was pathetic from the food to the staff’s attitude.

I ordered a basic paneer dish and rotis, and both were extremely disappointing. The paneer tasted like frozen tomato gravy that had simply been reheated with paneer thrown into it. No proper masala, no flavour, no effort. It tasted like something from a very average local dhaba, not a restaurant with such high ratings.The rotis were equally bad paper-thin, poorly cooked and completely below average.
To make matters worse, the staff member taking the order had a very poor attitude when I gave honest feedback. Instead of listening, he seemed unnecessarily offended.What is the point of customer feedback if you are not willing to accept it?

I honestly don't understand how this place has such high ratings. For me, it was a complete waste of time, money and energy, and it completely spoiled the evening. Would definitely not recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Madam,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

First, regarding the Paneer dish, we would like to clarify that all our gravies are prepared FRESH every day in our kitchen. We do not use frozen gravy and simply reheat it with paneer added. We take pride in serving freshly prepared food to our customers.

Regarding the roti, our rotis are intentionally thin, which is our usual style (and our naan is prepared in the same style). We do not use yeast or baking powder to make them thick like some other restaurants. This is how we have always prepared our bread, and most of our customers are very happy with it.

During your visit, when you shared your feedback, our staff politely tried to make both of you happy by offering to replace the roti and Lachha Paratha that you had ordered. We also have CCTV cameras in the restaurant, so the interaction can be reviewed. From our side, we genuinely tried to assist you and did not intend to show any attitude or disrespect.

We serve many customers every day, including large groups, and we regularly receive positive feedback about our food and service. Of course, we understand that everyone's taste and expectations are different, and perhaps we simply could not match your expectations on this occasion.

We respect your opinion, but we also feel it is unfair to judge the entire restaurant based mainly on ONE CURRY and the BREAD. Nevertheless, we appreciate your feedback and will continue doing our best to provide fresh food and friendly service to all our customers.

We are sorry that our food and style were not suitable for your taste, and we hope you have a better dining experience elsewhere.

Regards,
Manvar Rasoi Team

reviews.text:
The cutest little pink Gelato spot I came across in Danang. The staff are very kind and courteous and the gelato is OUT OF THIS WORLD!

As a girl from an island country, the best mangoes I’ve tasted is back home. GioiA’s mango sorbet was as if that mango had been frozen and served. It was just 100/10

I also tried the mint chocolate chip which was the perfect level of minty and not smack you in your face mint.

My brother tried the biscotti and he loved that it tasted like cinnamon, I’m not the biggest cinnamon fan but the two flavors were quite interesting.

They also add waffle cone peices with your gelato that is super yum!

If you’re in Danang I highly recommend checking these guys out!

Had salted Carmel ice cream. It was okay. Just didnt satisfy my sweet tooth. They were out of mint, and thats what i wanted. But i got my next favorite. Not sure why they didnt have a new batch made well before running out. Online menu wasn't up to date either. It a owners responsibility not a reviewer who posted a year ago. Over all customer satisfaction isnt high.

Stopped by last night for dessert after dinner and were met with two friendly and encouraging staff, their smiles were inviting and they let my boyfriend and I try a few samples before ordering. The gelato was packed with flavor and smooth, we will be going back!

I got the medium size (two scoops) of tiramisu and strawberry yogurt. I believe it was 70k. This is my second time here and I was super disappointed. The first time (months ago) was sooo good. I’m not sure if they switched vendors but the gelato is now so bland. Last time I got blueberry yogurt and the yogurt flavor was exactly like Vietnamese yogurt, sweet and tart. This time it barely tasted like yogurt. And the tiramisu tasted like banana bread ice cream for some reason. There was no espresso flavor at all. The entire gelato was very flavorless this time. I don’t think I will return here.

My favorite: Rum Raisins > Longan Oloong tea > Salted Caramel > …
Good point is I can try multiple flavors before making decision
Tasty gelato with good price and located in a place where there are lots of things to try.

I absolutely loved Gioia Gelati! I choose the Salted Caramel and Mint Chocolate options and both were so good that they blew me away. The Salted Caramel was so luxurious without being too sickly sweet, and then Mint Chocolate has this sharp, cool taste then and felt so refreshing! Aside from the delicious gelato, the owner were friendly and welcoming and the cozy vibe made it a space that was easy to relax and enjoy. I’m definitely making a return visit.
Gelati are joy... and are delicious! I have tried Biscoff and Coffee, both were amazingly tasty. I would just want to try all the other flavours now! Will have to go back... :)

Little Dogs is such a special place, a lovely community hub as well as an amazing cafe.

They specialise in English desserts, with my favourites there being the scones, banoffee pie, lemon drizzle cake, trifle, and caramel shortbread. They are all freshly made and very much remind me of the bakes my English granny makes.

One of the highlights of the cafe is the owner, Minh. She is such a lovely lady and makes you feel so welcome! There are also her two little dogs who have the calmest and sweetest temperament.

They’re a popular cafe and always super busy but still keep their prices affordable, with most desserts being around 30k.

They also do savoury food, they used to do a proper authentic English fish and chips with mushy peas and tartare sauce, so please bring this back guys!

🐶☕Little Dogs Coffee and Cake Cafe

I wish I could give it higher than 5 stars.

Since we started slow traveling, one thing we really miss is having a dog. So we made a special trip to Little Dogs Coffee and Cake Cafe, and let me tell you, it was one of the best decisions we have made in Da Nang!

When we first arrived, we were a little disappointed because there were no dogs around. The owner must have noticed because she went and got the dogs for us! 🥹 That absolutely made our day. They were so friendly and excited to be petted, and we could have spent hours with them. The owner was just as wonderful, taking the time to talk with us and making us feel so welcome.

Honestly, at that point, I didn't even care if the coffee and pastries were any good. We were already having such a great experience!

BUT LET ME TELL YOU... the food and drinks did not disappoint! The salted coffee was easily one of the best we have had so far in Da Nang. We also tried a Vietnamese iced coffee, and we shared a pound cake filled with whipped cream, fresh strawberries, and strawberry puree. The cake was simply perfect, with just the right amount of sweetness to go along with our coffees. ☕🍰

And did I mention the prices? Ridiculously good!

We usually enjoy trying a different coffee shop every morning, but this place is going to be an exception. We are already talking about making regular trips back, getting our dog fix, and trying some of their banh mi sandwiches next time.

This is exactly what I love about Vietnam. It's not just about the food or the places you visit. It's the people, the little unexpected experiences, and the places that make you feel at home even when you're halfway around the world.

I honestly wish we had a cozy, inviting place like this back in Las Vegas. Until then, we'll just have to keep coming back here! 🐶❤️

If you're in Da Nang and love dogs, good coffee, delicious cake, and genuinely friendly people, put this place on your list. You won't regret it!

Amazing coffee, delicious desserts, and a great atmosphere. The Banh Mi was really tasty, but the cheesecake was absolutely incredible!

One of the best parts was having two adorable dogs hanging around the café the whole time. Being able to pet them made the experience even more special.

Definitely a place I’d happily visit again!

reviews.text:
I came here mainly to work, and the space is definitely one of this café’s strongest points. The interior is clean, minimal, and comfortable, with plenty of seating and a quiet atmosphere that makes it easy to focus. The small outdoor courtyard is also a nice spot if you prefer some fresh air.

Unfortunately, the coffee was a letdown. I ordered an iced black coffee, but the flavor tasted rather flat and lacked the clarity and sweetness I would expect from a specialty coffee shop. Considering their branding, I was expecting a much better cup.

Overall, it’s a decent place to work or have a meeting, but if you’re visiting primarily for the coffee, it may not meet your expectations. Hopefully they can improve the consistency and quality of their brews.

Coffee: 9/10 – the standout feature. The shop roasts its own beans, focusing on specialty coffee with a wide range of bean varieties and brewing methods. Customers particularly praise the cappuccino, pour-over, and Ethiopian/Panamanian coffees.
* Ambiance: 9/10 – spacious, airy, and filled with greenery; the air-conditioned indoor area is relatively quiet, making it suitable for working or studying, while the outdoor area offers a more relaxed vibe.
* Service: 9/10 – generally positive feedback regarding the friendly and enthusiastic staff.
* Price: 8.5/10 – considered reasonable given the quality of the specialty coffee.
* Location: 9/10 – the Truong Thi 6 branch is very convenient for those just arriving in Da Nang, as it is located close to the airport.

Passport Coffee Lab is a truly lovely stop for anyone who appreciates a cozy atmosphere and quality coffee. Right at the entrance, a small bonsai plant by the window sets a calm, earthy tone for the whole space.

The interior is thoughtfully decorated with wooden shelving displaying V60 pour-over sets, books, plants, and charming little trinkets — it's clear the owner put a lot of care and personal style into the design.

The baristas are skilled and meticulous in every step of grinding and brewing, which really shows their dedication to the quality of every cup. The coffee menu here is impressively diverse, with each cup being rich, aromatic, and full-bodied.

The pastries here (croissants, strawberry tarts) are fresh and beautifully presented too — perfect alongside a good cup of coffee.

A lovely little coffee discovery in Da Nang!

I happened to walk past this place and was immediately attracted by the beautiful and cozy atmosphere, so I decided to stop by and take a look. The staff were very friendly and recommended the Lemon Cold Brew, so I decided to give it a try and take it away.

Honestly, the drink was surprisingly good! The cold brew had a refreshing coffee flavor with a bright, slightly tangy lemon taste. It was a really enjoyable drink, especially for a hot day in Da Nang. 🍋☕️

I also really liked the atmosphere of the café. It feels comfortable, relaxing and welcoming, making it a nice place to slow down and enjoy a coffee.

I’m glad I happened to discover this place by chance. If you’re visiting Da Nang and love coffee, I definitely recommend stopping by Passport Coffee Lab and trying the Lemon Cold Brew.

Hopefully more visitors will discover this place and come here to enjoy the coffee and experience the atmosphere for themselves.

Definitely a place I’d be happy to visit again! ❤️

Absolutely wonderful place to have some amazing coffee and work. The food is also amazing. My husband and I came around 11am and the upstairs was full of workers but there was plenty of seating outside. There are also plugs outside which is great and the outside space wraps around the building so you don't have to sit on the busy street. The atmosphere is very inviting with the industrial modern look. We ordered the orange lemongrass cold brew and the Ethiopian v60. I personally thought the cold brew was the best I've ever had and it packed a good punch of caffeine. We got the v60 iced and it was also very good. We also ordered a salad and chicken sandwich the food was made to order and was so fresh and delicious. Great place to work from as the wifi is great and there is enough space and not too loud. The staff was very pleasant and attentive. Would absolutely recommend and come back.

We’re really happy to see Passport Cafe open a new location near My Khe Beach. The coffee is good, and the space is chill with air conditioning. The second floor is quiet—great for getting some work done while enjoying your coffee. The staff are friendly and always smiling.

The music is soft and not too loud, so it’s easy to have a conversation.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot to relax or work. We’d definitely come back again.

When Language Meets the Memory of Taste

The first sips of coffee may evoke familiar sensory memories of jasmine, peach, or ripe citrus. Known as the priming effect, this process can shape how we perceive a cup before fully experiencing it.

Yet, tasting notes can also bias perception, leading us to seek expected flavors rather than observe what is truly present. The challenge lies in distinguishing genuine sensory impressions from memories shaped by words.

The Anchor of Taste provides a point of reference through blind cupping, side-by-side comparisons, and tasting across different temperatures. With this sensory foundation, cup notes become a reliable map where language guides perception without defining it.

At XLIII Coffee, our Sensory Guides view their role as a profound privilege, taking the time to patiently guide our companions through our curated archive. reviews.text:
We first tried XLIII in Ho Chi Minh City last year and absolutely loved it, so visiting their flagship store in Da Nang was a must!

This is where they roast all their coffee beans, with a strong focus on light-roasted, single-origin specialty coffees. They also offer an impressive selection of rare and limited-production beans, which makes the experience even more exciting for coffee lovers.

There are three ways to enjoy their coffee: Americano, pour-over, and milk-based drinks. Each bean is paired with a specific brewing method to bring out its unique characteristics and flavors.

Highly recommend sitting at the coffee bar! The baristas personally introduce the beans, explain their flavor profiles, and share the stories behind them. It feels more like a guided coffee-tasting experience than just grabbing a cup of coffee.

reviews.text:
Came in for the soft shell crab but they said it was seasonal. So I got the Lobster combo.
The service was a little below average and the food took a while to arrive. It came out with nice presentation. There were not many people.

The lobster was really good, the morning glory, garlic rice was good. However, everything tasted so rich and heavy. I felt like the entire plate was covered in sauce including the fruit.

Overall, the prices were higher, the service was below average, the food was good, and they added a cover charge.

I just like to also mention that this place gives incentives for good google reviews but I will remain honest with mine.

Service is good, attentive and friendly. The food is ok, it's good but it's also overly rich. The lobster is half, although it looks whole. Soft shell crab is nice and prawn too. Pricing is on the expensive side.

I feel the only good dish was the morning glory. The black pepper lobster combo had everything mixed with the oil, and that also soaks the rice and fruits. The butter garlic prawns also too heavy in butter and not much in flavor. The seafood meat are overcooked.

Awarded Penangite Gold stamp of approval.

Do note that there are free snacks provided if you post a review, which was worrisome when I arrived. However, thankfully the food was quite good. Tried the butter garlic lobster and red chilli prawn. Lobster was more worth the value than the prawns, and had fresh, sweet taste. Refreshing change of flavour from the other Vietnamese food

I was looking forward to trying lobster here but the experience was really bad.
The lobster had a very sea-like taste, and no sweetness. I just had a few bites and felt sick. The people around were all Asian and they seemed to enjoy it, maybe it was a cultural thing.
Usually I am quite adventurous with food, but this time… bad.

Nice quiet, chill environment that serves large portion of seafood meal options that are children friendly too.
Orders came up fast, too.

Very Disappointing Experience

We booked a snorkeling trip the day before and were told to come at 10 AM. They said a fisherman would take just the two of us to the reef for 45 minutes, then bring us back — sounded great. But when we arrived, no one spoke English, and it took ages to even understand what we were there for. We were told to come back at 10:45, and suddenly it turned into a full group tour with guides and lots of people. Totally not what we were promised.

We ended up on a speedboat that stopped at two other places first to drop off people, then finally took us to the reef. The spot itself was beautiful — but people were literally stepping on the corals, and when we told the guides, they either ignored us or said they didn’t care. We were allowed to snorkel for just 20 minutes, then had to sit on the boat again while they picked up the rest of the group.

To make it worse, we were overcharged — the sign said 100,000 VND per person, but we paid 300,000 VND for the two of us because we thought we were getting a private trip. It was absolutely not what we were told. After the trip, we asked for the 100,000 VND difference back, and luckily they gave it to us — but overall, it was a frustrating and disappointing experience. Wouldn’t recommend at all.

We were really looking forward to a quiet snorkeling experience and asked the day before. We were told to come at 10:00 and that a fisherman would take just the two of us to the reef for 45 minutes. When we arrived, no one spoke English, and it took a long time to understand what was going on. We were told to come back at 10:45 — suddenly, there were lots of people and tour guides, and we had no idea what was happening.

We ended up on a speedboat that made two stops to let out people before finally heading to the reef. The coral reef was beautiful — but sadly, we saw people stepping on the corals. When we told the tour guides, they either ignored us or said they didn’t care. We only got 20 minutes in the water before being called back onto the boat, and then had to sit and wait again while the others were collected.

We were also overcharged at the beginning — the price didn’t match what was written on the sign. Thankfully, after the tour we complained and got the difference refunded.

Overall, it was very disorganized, frustrating, and upsetting to see the lack of care for the reef. It could have been a great experience with better communication and more respect for the environment.

reviews.textTranslated:
This place seems to be buying reviews, but my island tour here was TERRIBLE. There are already so few boats, why cram so many people in and make them wait for over two hours? On the way back, they made up excuses – one said the boat was broken, the other said it was out of fuel. At least try to make up a story to fit together. The food was meager, and the tour description said we'd visit several places, then they said we HAD TO RENT A MOTORCYCLE OUTSIDE OF THE COST.

The tour description said we'd go to the beach and then go snorkeling, but in reality, we ONLY HAD TO CHOOSE ONE OF THE TWO.

And the people at the pier were incredibly aggressive in trying to poach customers. When I went, I even witnessed a fight between groups pushing each other's belongings because they were competing for customers.

I'm not sure about other tours, but if you hear the name Tran Khue, please avoid them 🙏
The beaches on Cham Island are very beautiful, I admit, but to pay that price for such terrible service, I can't stand it 🙏
I was exhausted for two days afterward because of the heat and the long, drawn-out wait. Thinking about it makes me so angry.

reviews.textTranslated:
Tran Khue Restaurant is a reasonable choice when visiting Cu Lao Cham, especially if you want to enjoy a complete meal without having to think too much about choosing dishes. The restaurant serves pre-packaged combos, which are quite substantial and delicious. The seafood is fresh and well-prepared, especially the steamed clams, fried fish, and grilled squid.

The biggest plus point of the restaurant is its extremely beautiful location – right next to the beach, with a refreshing breeze, a spacious and cool atmosphere. Sitting and eating while admiring the sea and enjoying the fresh air is truly relaxing. The staff are enthusiastic, serve food quickly, and are attentive.

Overall, this is an ideal stop for tourists on tours or families who want a delicious, reasonably priced lunch with stunning scenery in Cu Lao Cham.

Trần Khuê Restaurant là một trong những lựa chọn hợp lý khi đến Cù Lao Chàm, đặc biệt nếu bạn muốn thưởng thức bữa ăn trọn gói mà không cần phải suy nghĩ quá nhiều về việc chọn món. Nhà hàng phục vụ theo dạng combo sẵn, khá đầy đặn và hợp khẩu vị. Các món hải sản tươi ngon, chế biến vừa miệng, đặc biệt là nghêu hấp, cá chiên và mực nướng.

Điểm cộng lớn nhất của nhà hàng là vị trí cực kỳ đẹp – nằm ngay sát bãi biển, gió thổi lồng lộng, không gian thoáng đãng, mát mẻ. Ngồi ăn vừa ngắm biển vừa tận hưởng không khí trong lành thực sự rất thư giãn. Nhân viên phục vụ nhiệt tình, lên món nhanh và chu đáo.

Tổng thể, đây là một điểm dừng chân lý tưởng cho du khách đi theo tour hoặc gia đình muốn có một bữa trưa ngon lành, giá hợp lý và phong cảnh tuyệt vời tại Cù Lao Chàm.

reviews.textTranslated:
Tran Khue Restaurant in Cu Lao Cham is a wonderful destination for those who love food and nature. The restaurant has a spacious atmosphere with stunning sea views, creating a relaxing and pleasant feeling.

The dishes here are all prepared from the freshest ingredients, especially the seafood. I was very impressed with the grilled and hot pot seafood dishes, which were both delicious and rich in the flavors of the sea. The traditional dishes are also prepared very subtly and attractively.

The staff are friendly, professional, and always provide attentive and thoughtful service. Tran Khue Restaurant is not only a place to enjoy delicious food but also a place to enjoy the beautiful scenery of Cu Lao Cham. If you have the chance to visit, don't forget to stop by this restaurant for a memorable experience.

reviews.text:
We dropped by for lunch and had the whole place to ourselves because they seem to focus mostly on the dinner crowd. Keep in mind there is no A/C, so it gets incredibly hot during the day. I would highly recommend coming for dinner instead.
The crab soup with greens (Ghẹ nấu rau muống) was excellent. The greens actually tasted more like sweet potato leaves than morning glory. The crab meat was remarkably sweet and fresh, and the broth had a subtle spicy kick that really opened up our appetite.
The seafood fried glass noodles (Miến xào hải sản) featured incredibly sweet pineapple chunks, and the noodles absorbed all the savory flavors beautifully. It came loaded with shrimp, squid, and wood ear mushrooms, making for a perfectly balanced savory dish.
For the salt and pepper mantis shrimp (Tôm tít rang muối), the owner went above and beyond by helping us peel them, which was amazing service. The shrimp were packed with rich roe.
We also tried the lemongrass stir-fried clams (Hến xào). The herbal flavor was a bit too intense for my personal liking, but it came with a complimentary baguette for dipping into the sauce. The bread had a lovely buttery aroma and tasted delicious.
To top it all off, they even treated us to a complimentary plate of watermelon at the end of our meal. Great food and fantastic service.

reviews.text:
Among the seafood joints in Da Nang, Be Nu holds a curious place.
It sits in Alley 267 Ngo Quyen. The place is small. It has the feel of the outskirts of Hoi An, or some familiar village back in Quang Nam. A quiet patch of sky hangs over the tables. Low brick walls run around the yard. In the corner, a jackfruit tree bends under the weight of its fruit. Further off, in the neighbor’s yard, a mango tree stands heavy with green fruit, drawing every eye.
The seafood tanks are bright and clean.
By six in the evening, the tables begin to fill. Chinese, Vietnamese, Westerners. They come because of the good words written about the place on the internet.
I ordered the pufferfish stewed with turmeric, mantis shrimp in garlic butter, squid egg hotpot, grilled stingray, steamed clams, and tamarind crab. The food came fast. One dish after another, neat upon the table.
When the bill came, it was just a little over one million dong. Then, you understood why they keep coming back.

Recommended by a Vietnamese friend, we went there with instructions on what to order, but my friend hadn't mentioned it was in a residential area. It is a true hidden gem that locals know about.

​It was a rainy day, and there were only local tables plus ours. The owner lady took care of us like a mom, teaching us the proper way to eat everything correctly. They provided plastic gloves and a bowl for shells, which they kept emptying for us throughout the meal. The taste was exactly as others had described.

​I felt like they even planned the serving order; we started with steamed mantis shrimp for a clean, fresh taste, followed by clams and steamed fish. The fish was the best part of today because it was meaty, fresh, and soft with very few bones. We ended with a hot pot that was completely full of seafood.

​You can see they do business sincerely. The owner lady was super kind and understands enough English for ordering, such as the price, steamed, grill, and how to cook. We only used translations if we had more specific requests. We felt so well taken care of, and the bill turned out cheaper than we thought. It was worth the trip, and I would definitely come again

reviews.textTranslated:
My terrible experience with restaurant staff
My family didn't go snorkeling, so we went to the restaurant to rest beforehand and asked for food early because we had children. The restaurant was okay. While waiting, because no one was there to guide us, we sat at a table supposedly set for another group (the table only had bowls and plates, no food yet). We bought some fresh seafood from the restaurant and asked them to prepare it for us. The restaurant prepared the dish and brought it out to us. Suddenly, while we were eating, a staff member (a thin woman with a gaunt face) came out and said this wasn't our table and asked us to move to another table. We agreed, but she spoke very rudely, saying we sat there without asking anyone. I explained that we had already told them we were tour guide Phuc's group, but we didn't see anyone guiding us, and now they were blaming us. Anyway, I just wanted to keep the peace and only asked for food for the children to eat. But no, the restaurant staff made us wait for over an hour, until 1 PM, while other groups who arrived later got to eat first. After our tour guide returned, they complained that we were seated in the wrong place and had an unpleasant attitude (this was relayed by the tour guide).
It's unacceptable for service staff to have such a petty and resentful attitude towards customers. I wonder if the manager or owner of the restaurant is aware of this? But if the owner reads this review, please retrain your staff. In this day and age, you can tell immediately whether a service is good or not. Even if the restaurant caters to tour groups, it's not a monopoly on the island. If the service isn't good, customers can book in advance to avoid the restaurant.

ownerDescription: Quán cafe view sân bay đẹp tại Đà Nẵng

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Today we visited Maay Rooftop with our family for the first time, and we absolutely loved it!

The view is simply incredible. You’re so close to the runway that watching planes take off and land is an unforgettable experience. The airplanes fly literally right over your head, making the experience even more exciting and unique. If you’re an aviation enthusiast or simply enjoy spectacular views, this place is an absolute must-visit.

Even though the café hasn’t officially opened yet, we received such a warm and heartfelt welcome. Everyone was incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely hospitable. You can already tell how much love and passion has gone into creating this place.

One more thing we really loved is the view from the fourth floor. From there you get a beautiful panorama of the surrounding mountains, and it looks like the perfect place to watch the sunset. We can’t wait to come back in the evening next time!

We sincerely wish the entire team a successful opening, many happy guests, and continued growth and prosperity. We’re sure this will soon become one of Da Nang’s most unique and popular cafés.

Thank you for your wonderful hospitality and for making us feel so welcome. We had a fantastic time and will definitely be back. Highly recommended to anyone visiting Da Nang! ❤️✈️☕🌄

reviews.text:
The location, right on the sea front, 2 minutes walk from the sea port. The owner is friendly, speaks English. The room was lovely with kettle, TV, hairdryer and nice bathroom area. Good quality snorkel and mask for hire.

The owner can get ferry tickets cheaper than at the ferry port on Cua Dai!!
I came back to Cham Island 2 weeks later and stayed here again.. brilliant!!. The owner does lovely food too.
The owner arranged motorbike rent so I drove round the island.. beautiful 😍
There are seafood restaurants virtually next door.. friendly there too.
You can eat or drink from the rooftop balcony.. beautiful view.. took photo.
I thoroughly recommend here. Everything spotlessly clean too.

Fantastic little homestay, stayed here for my 40th birthday. Room was immaculate and very comfortable. The owners were very kind and helpful. We had our evening meal here and the food was fantastic, fresh seafood beautifully cooked. The location is perfect right in the center of the town facing the harbour. 1 minute walk from the ferry dock. Will definitely come back and stay again.

We stayed for three nights and it was perfect. The island is stunning with lots of snorkelling, swimming, nature, family run restaurants and a relaxed vibe. The best part was staying at Cham Corner Lookout. The location is very central in the main settlement, the room was comfortable and we made use of the rooftop terrace. Most importantly Hang is a wonderful host, she was helpful, attentive and friendly. Anything we needed was taken care of and we’d highly recommend staying here for your time on Cham 😊

We just had breakfast and it was good. Mango smoothie was really good and the young lady waiting on us was really nice and with good English skills. Its located directly on the port so view is great but comes with a cost which is same for all the restaurants here - many flies. But this has nothing to do with the restaurant. The waiting time was a bit long but as I assume they make everything fresh, its justified. In all of the other restaurants we also waited longer.

We planned to stay here for 2 nights but ended booking another night. It’s a family business and I was pleasantly surprised by the service. We were contacted before arrival, picked up at the port (without us asking) and the owner was available on WhatsApp all the time.

Thank you for your hospitality ❤️👌🏻

Came here for breakfast because the free breakfast at my hotel wasn't good enough. This restaurant has the largest breakfast selection out of the other restaurants. The food was good and I'll likely return.

They don't have a lot of seating available. They should also focus on bringing items out at the same time. For example, my son was done with his food before they gave him his drink. It would be appreciated to be able to drink while eating.

Rooms are clean and modern, and look freshly renovated. The location is right at the front of the village, with the façade looking directly onto the ocean. The service is very kind and helpful too ... I actually forgot something important when leaving the hotel, and they quickly arranged to send it back to the mainland for me, with the greatest care. Thank you!

A beautiful room with a sea view, essentials all included such as toiletries, towels, water etc. The bed was comfortable, the shower was hot and the room has air con. They serve food and coffee which was also very nice. The owner, Hang was absolutely lovely, making sure we had everything we needed.

reviews.text:
One of the best restaurants in town. We've been to more than 10, and this one is the best for Vietnamese food. The portions are good, and you're getting a nice amount of meat in them, which is something I learned to appreciate in Hoi An as a westerner used to consuming a fair amount of protein every day. Everything is seasoned but not overly so. The food is delicious, in our opinion.

This is a family-owned establishment, which is always great to support. The dogs are very cute. There are some nice little touches you can see that you won't find in other restaurants, for example, their plates, glasses, etc.

I did have some issues here, though. First was having a hair in one dish. And the second was not getting correct change once while the place was busy and kids were involved in handling it, but it was partly my fault that I didn't check it right away. But it was only 20k which I would've tipped anyway, so it wasn't a big deal.

All in all, you should definitely check this place out if you're in the area and want some tasty food. Just bear in mind that nobody is perfect and things happen.

P.S. I'm attaching photos of the current menu because I'm the type of person who likes to decide what they're getting beforehand. It just saves so much time and enegry if you're able to consider you options for as long as you'd like without getting overly hungry or worrying you're taking too much time to order and everybody is waiting for you. I hope the owners don't mind me showing the menu to the world like this

Had a fantastic meal here. We ate fresh whole fish, clams, oysters and noodles. The food was super fresh and very tasty. The prices were excellent (we paid 870,000VND / £24.36 for two whole fish with rice, one beef noodles, a bowl of clams, 6 grilled oysters, 3 beers and a bottle of wine 😲). We loved the whole experience and we were made to feel very welcome.
We definitely recommend this place and 100% would go back again.
Plus, super friendly dogs 🥰

reviews.text:
Minh’s Kitchen is a gem for anyone who appreciates well-executed comfort food. The egg and garlic fried rice was outstanding — beautifully balanced, with just the right amount of crispiness and depth of flavor. It’s a simple dish, but getting the texture and seasoning this right is not easy, and they absolutely nailed it.
The egg soup was equally satisfying — delicate, silky, and incredibly comforting. A small splash of soy sauce brought everything together perfectly.
Beyond the food, the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, made even more memorable by the three charming resident dogs who seem to be part of the experience.
A place I would happily return to — and one I’d recommend to anyone visiting An Bang.

Một trải nghiệm tồi tệ ; khách nước ngoài vào sau nhưng lên đồ trước khi cùng gọi bugger; đoàn nhà mình vào ăn xong vẫn chưa lên nổi đồ nhưng vẫn đòi thanh toán tiền nói bảo giảm 10% nhưng mình đâu cần ; thái độ phục vụ tệ . A truly disappointing experience.

Our group arrived first and ordered at the same time as another group of foreign customers who came in later. However, their food was served before ours, while we had to wait a long time without receiving our meals.

What disappointed us even more was that the staff asked us to pay the bill before all of our food had even been served. They offered a 10% discount, but that wasn’t the point. We were looking for professional service and basic respect for customers—not a discount to make up for poor service.

The service was unprofessional, disorganized, and the staff’s attitude was disappointing. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves both the service quality and staff training to prevent other customers from having the same experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience at Minh's Kitchen. We are very sorry for the incident during service that caused you dissatisfaction and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.
However, to avoid misunderstandings for other customers, we would like to clarify some information:
Firstly, regarding the burger, it is true that a mistake occurred when the staff WRONGLY BROUGHT THE WRONG DISH TO THE TABLE OF TWO FOREIGN CUSTOMERS, which led you to mistakenly believe that the restaurant prioritized serving foreign customers. In reality, this was entirely a staff error during service, not discrimination. Because the burger had already been consumed by the other table, we COULD NOT RECOVER the dish, so the kitchen had to prepare a new portion for your table, resulting in a longer wait time. Upon discovering the issue, we immediately apologized and promptly addressed the matter.

Secondly, the burger was NOT included in your bill. The restaurant did not charge for this unserved item.

Thirdly, regarding payment, we NEVER requested or forced you to pay before all the food was served. In fact, your family was the one who ACTIVELY requested payment. We explained that the burger was being re-prepared in the kitchen and would be brought out in a few minutes. However, your family insisted on paying. Therefore, we hope everyone understands the context of the situation.

Fourth, recognizing this as a restaurant error, we have PROACTIVELY REDUCED the total bill by 10% as an apology and to compensate for the inconvenience you experienced. This is a voluntary offer from the restaurant and is NOT intended to AVOID RESPONSIBILITY for the mistake that occurred.

Finally, we would like to affirm that Minh's Kitchen DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE BETWEEN VIETNAMESE AND FOREIGN CUSTOMERS. From the moment you arrived, our staff welcomed you, seated you, and served you with the same enthusiasm as all other guests. The order of service depends on the kitchen's food preparation process and unforeseen incidents such as this instance of bringing the wrong dish, and is not based on the customer's nationality.

We always value all feedback and see it as an opportunity to improve the quality of our services. Once again, we sincerely apologize for the mistake that occurred and thank you for taking the time to provide feedback. Thank you for listening.

reviews.text:
The three days I spent at Monkey Homestay were the highlight of my entire trip to Da Nang.

Cham Island is peaceful and unspoiled, making it the perfect place to slow down, relax, and simply enjoy island life. One of the best parts of staying here was the food. Monkey Homestay has, in my opinion, the best chef on the island, using incredibly fresh ingredients. I ordered the crab every day because it was so delicious, the fried rice was amazing, and the fresh orange juice was rich, refreshing, and perfect for the hot weather.

The room was simple but very clean. I especially loved the wooden flooring in the bathroom, and the shower area was spacious and comfortable.

If you’d like to explore the island, you can rent a scooter directly from the homestay. They even fill up the fuel tank for you, which makes everything so convenient.

Breakfast is served downstairs every morning, and it’s one of the best breakfasts you can find on the island. Since the weather gets hot very early in the summer, it’s great not having to go somewhere else just to eat. Waking up and enjoying a delicious breakfast right at the homestay was one of the best decisions we made.

I would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Cham Island.

My family and I had an awesome stay with An and Duyen, the owners of Monkey Homestay and bar. This beautiful family cared for us, feed us and gave us five family stay hospitality. The food was delicious, our boys played with Son.
We will never forget this place and this beautiful family. Thankyou so much for a sensational stay in paradise.
Definitely try the cocktails, fresh Vietnamese black coffee, Banh Mi and avocado and eggs.
Any families planning a trip to Charm Island, off the coast of Hoi An. Make sure you book in with this beautiful family.

reviews.text:
We visited Mr Dung on a Monday night and were pleasantly surprised by how relaxed and welcoming the atmosphere was. The restaurant was not very busy, which made for a comfortable and unhurried dinner. From the moment we walked in, the family-owned vibe was obvious. The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely warm in the way they greeted us.
We were told upfront that only smaller-sized lobsters were available that day. We decided to go ahead and order the local lobster, cooked in garlic butter, and it absolutely did not disappoint. The portions were good value, the meat was succulent and generous, and the garlic butter added just the right amount of richness without overwhelming the natural sweetness of the lobster.

Alongside the lobster, we ordered the morning glory and the white rose. Both were delicious and well-executed. The morning glory had a nice crunch and light seasoning, while the white rose dumplings were delicate, flavorful, and clearly made with care.

Overall, we are really happy we found Mr Dung. It is the kind of place that feels authentic, unpretentious, and focused on good food rather than hype. We will definitely be going back and recommending it to friends looking for a reliable, tasty seafood spot with a friendly, family-run feel.

We ordered the garlic butter lobster, grilled prawns, steamed fish and rice. The steamed fish was the standout dish — fresh and well prepared. The grilled prawns were decent.

Overall, the meal was enjoyable, but I would recommend ordering the fish and skipping the lobster.

We had a fantastic dinner at Mr Dung Seafood Restaurant. This is a genuine family-run place, not a tourist trap at all, with very reasonable prices for the quality offered. The welcome was warm and friendly, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

The service was a bit slow, but honestly it was completely worth the wait — everything is cooked fresh to order, and you can really taste the difference. The food was absolutely delicious, and the lobsters were among the best I’ve ever had.

If you’re looking for authentic seafood in Hoi An, this place is a must-try.
