ownerUpdates.text:
A few simple choices can help the natural flavor of seafood shine at the table:

• Taste the first bite before adding lime, chili, or dipping sauce. A delicate fish or freshly grilled prawn may already be well seasoned.

• Match sides to the cooking style. Steamed seafood pairs nicely with fresh greens and rice, while grilled dishes can stand up to brighter herbs or a tangy dipping sauce.

• Add sauces a little at a time, especially when sharing. Keeping them on the side lets everyone adjust the flavor without overwhelming the dish.

• Enjoy crisp or lightly cooked seafood soon after it arrives, while its texture is at its best.

• If you’re trying an unfamiliar local dish, ask which herbs or condiments traditionally go with it. They can add balance and offer a taste of Hội An’s food culture.

A light touch with seasoning makes it easier to notice the distinct flavors and textures of each seafood dish.

A little planning can help you enjoy a variety of seafood without crowding the table or letting dishes lose their freshness:

• Start with a few dishes for the group, then add more if everyone is still hungry. This is especially useful when ordering seafood with rice and vegetables.

• Choose different cooking methods to bring variety to the meal. A steamed dish offers a gentler flavor, while grilled or stir-fried seafood adds a richer taste.

• Serve shared dishes in smaller portions at a time, keeping the rest covered until needed. This helps maintain their warmth and texture.

• Put dipping sauces and chili on the side so each person can season their food to their liking.

• If you have leftovers, ask for them to be packed promptly and refrigerate them soon after your meal.

Thoughtful ordering makes a shared seafood meal more comfortable, reduces waste, and gives everyone time to enjoy each dish while it’s at its best.

When a whole fish arrives at the table, a few careful steps make it easier to enjoy its flavor and avoid stray bones:

• Start with the flesh along the top side, lifting it away from the backbone in small sections rather than cutting straight through the fish.

• Use your fork to check each bite, especially near the head, belly, and fin areas, where smaller bones may remain.

• Once the top side is finished, lift the backbone gently before eating the flesh underneath. Avoid flipping the fish if it is delicate, as this can mix bones into the meat.

• Keep a small side plate nearby for bones, and take your time—particularly when sharing the dish or eating with children.

• If you are unsure how a whole fish is served, ask about the best way to portion it before you begin.

These simple habits help you enjoy the fish comfortably while keeping the meal relaxed.

Enjoying seafood with friends or family in Hội An? A few thoughtful choices can make a shared meal easier to plan and more enjoyable:

• Check how many dishes are suited to sharing, and choose a mix of seafood, vegetables, and rice rather than ordering several rich dishes at once.

• Ask about portion sizes and preparation before ordering. Grilled, steamed, and stir-fried seafood offer different textures and flavors, so a varied selection can keep the meal interesting.

• If anyone has a food allergy or dietary restriction, mention it before placing the order. Ask about sauces and possible contact with other ingredients, too.

• For children or anyone who prefers milder flavors, keep chili and strong dipping sauces on the side. That lets each person season their own plate.

• Leave a little room between courses. It gives everyone time to enjoy each dish while it is fresh and helps avoid ordering more than the table can comfortably finish.

A balanced order makes it easier for everyone to find something they enjoy.

Choosing seafood that suits your taste can make a meal more enjoyable, especially when you’re exploring unfamiliar dishes in Hội An:

• Ask how a fish or shellfish is prepared before ordering. Steaming tends to keep flavors gentle, while grilling brings a more pronounced, smoky taste.

• Consider texture as well as flavor. Firm fish works well grilled or in a hearty dish; delicate fish is often best with a lighter preparation.

• For a shared meal, estimate portions alongside rice and vegetables. A mix of seafood, greens, and a simple side can make the table feel balanced without ordering more than you can enjoy.

• Check whether a dish contains shellfish, fish sauce, or other ingredients that matter to your preferences.

• Local availability can change with the season, so the seafood selection may vary from day to day.

A few thoughtful questions help you choose dishes that fit your appetite and the way you like to eat.

In Hội An’s warm weather, a few simple habits help keep a seafood meal enjoyable from the first dish to the last:

• Eat hot seafood while it is freshly served. If a dish has been sitting for a while, check with your server before continuing.

• Share small portions at a time rather than leaving the whole meal spread out for long. This is especially helpful when ordering several dishes for a group.

• If you plan to take leftovers away, ask for them to be packed promptly and refrigerate them as soon as possible. Avoid leaving seafood in a warm car or outdoors.

• Reheat leftovers thoroughly before eating, and when in doubt about how long they have been unrefrigerated, it is safer not to keep them.

• Let staff know about allergies before ordering, including concerns about contact between different seafood items.

These small precautions help protect food quality and make dining together more comfortable.

A dipping sauce can complement seafood without overpowering its natural flavor. When enjoying a meal in Hội An, try these simple steps:

• Taste the sauce first before adding lime, chili, or extra seasoning. Fish sauce blends vary in saltiness and sweetness.

• Add strong flavors a little at a time. A small squeeze of lime or a few chili slices can brighten the taste while letting delicate seafood remain the focus.

• Use a small personal dipping bowl when sharing. It keeps the main sauce clean and makes it easy for each person to adjust the flavor.

• Dip lightly rather than soaking each bite. This helps preserve the texture of grilled or steamed seafood.

• Pair bold sauces with plain rice or fresh herbs, which can soften salty, tangy, or spicy notes.

A few thoughtful adjustments make it easier for everyone at the table to enjoy seafood in their own way.

Eating shell-on seafood can be part of the pleasure, but a few small habits make it tidier and more comfortable:

• Use the provided crackers or pick to open shells gently. Applying steady pressure helps avoid sharp fragments and keeps juices from splashing.

• Keep a small plate or bowl nearby for shells, and use a separate hand for shared serving utensils when possible.

• For prawns, remove the shell over your plate rather than above the shared table. If you’re unsure whether the vein has been removed, ask before eating.

• Wipe your hands between bites, especially before reaching for shared rice, herbs, or other dishes.

• Take your time with unfamiliar shellfish. Their shells and textures vary, so a quick question about the best way to eat them can save effort and reduce mess.

These simple table habits make shared seafood meals smoother for everyone.

Planning a seafood meal in Hội An? Balance flavors and portions with a few simple choices:

• If you’re ordering several dishes, begin with lighter flavors—such as steamed seafood or fresh greens—before richer grilled or fried preparations. This helps each dish stand out.

• Pair seafood with plain rice, vegetables, or fresh herbs. These familiar sides can balance salty, spicy, or buttery sauces without masking the seafood’s flavor.

• Think about the whole table when choosing sauces. A tangy or spicy dip can complement mild seafood, while a lighter seasoning may suit naturally rich fish or shellfish.

• For a group, order a variety of textures rather than several dishes prepared the same way. One tender steamed dish, one crisp or grilled option, and a vegetable side can make the meal feel more complete.

• Pace the meal so hot dishes are enjoyed soon after serving, while salads and sides can remain on the table for everyone to share.

A little contrast in flavor and texture makes a seafood meal more satisfying.

Enjoying a whole grilled or steamed fish is easier with a few simple techniques:

• Begin near the backbone, lifting small portions of flesh with your chopsticks or fork rather than cutting straight through the fish.

• Work from the top side toward the center, then carefully separate the backbone to reach the flesh underneath. Take your time around the fins and tail, where small bones may be harder to spot.

• If you’re sharing, use serving utensils to transfer portions to your own bowl before eating. This keeps the shared dish tidy and makes it easier to check for bones.

• For children or anyone who prefers boneless portions, ask about suitable options or request help separating the fish before serving.

These small habits make a whole-fish meal more comfortable and let you savor its texture and flavor at a relaxed pace.

reviews.text:
We came because of the highly rated review and the fact you can actually pick out the seafood you’d want, making it feel fresher. Unfortunately in a region filled with delicious food, and a country known for flavors, this was probably our worst meal in our week long trip along the coast.

We ordered some mantis shrimp, fried squid, some mixed vegetables, and sea grab. The mantis shrimp was the better dish since having it fried at least helped to add some flavors. Everything else was bland and flavorless. The mixed vegetables seemed to have been simply boiled and dumped onto our plates. We had the sea crab which is arguably the smallest crab we have ever seen at a seafood restaurant — no wait staff helped us pick out the crab nor gave us heads up about the type of crab we will be getting. Upon service, we spoke to a wait staff and had it exchanged for a proper crab — it was larger but still came out flavorless.

Environment wise, there is the downstairs and we later learned, an upstairs. It appears that folks who’ve been here before have asked to be taken upstairs upon arrival. Perhaps the food is better up there? Maybe it’s an off day for the chef, but this being our last dinner of the trip, it was quite the downer & made us doubt Google reviews in the area going forward.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Kai Wang!

Thank you for your honest and detailed feedback. We're sorry the food fell short, particularly with the seasoning and your experience choosing the crab. Our team should have provided better guidance before preparing your selection, and we'll address this internally.

We'd also like to clarify that upstairs and downstairs share the same kitchen and menu, so there should never be a difference in food quality between the two areas. We're sorry that your final dinner in Hoi An wasn't the experience you had hoped for.

reviews.text: First thing to love here is the really warm hospitality of the Couple Owner of the restaurant. Goes out of their way to cook our dishes just the way we like it! Very kind, friendly and really nice couple, even gave us free dessert. Food was homecook & delicious. We ordered crabs and they were brought fresh from the sea! Sweetest crab meat we have ever tasted! Prices here are very reasonable too compared to other restaurants in vicinity. Beautiful atmosphere facing the port with sea breeze. 2 thumbs up! Absolutely 5 stars for the great food and lovely personalities!!

The food here is absolutely delicious and clearly made with so much love. We highly recommend the grilled clams with scallion oil and the grilled oysters, but honestly, everything we ordered was incredibly tasty.

The restaurant is run by such a kind and welcoming family, and their hospitality made the whole experience even more special. It truly felt like eating a home-cooked meal. We’ll definitely come back!

There are places you simply never forget. Not just because of the food (which was absolutely incredible), but because of the heart.

I arrived at this restaurant not knowing what to expect, and I left with a huge smile and new friends. The food was so delicious—every bite felt like home, like something made with genuine love. But what truly made this evening unforgettable was the family who runs the place.

The husband sang and played the guitar, the daughters danced around, and the whole atmosphere was alive, joyful, and full of soul. It also happened to be a holiday in my home country, and when I told them—they celebrated with me. They turned on the karaoke machine just for me, joined in the joy, and made sure I didn’t feel alone, even so far from home.

They treated me to drinks on the house, we laughed, we sang, and at some point, I felt like I was part of their family.

And when it was time to leave… that’s when it became truly emotional. They even bought me small gifts, walked me all the way to the boat, and we said goodbye with hugs. I’m also sharing a drawing their daughter made for me—a small keepsake with a big heart.

There are places with good food. And there are places with soul. This is the second kind
I love you
I will come back
Avigail ♥️

reviews.text: I came here twice because the seafood and beach chair location is so good. Worth the trip. If you prefer tranquility over loud music by the beach, you must come here. Their beach chairs are very comfortable with umbrella for 50,000vnd. Everything I hate here was delicious - bbq clams, prawn skewers, and fried crab with tamarind garlic sauce. Coconut was always cold too! I definitely will come back to try the lobster and enjoy the beautiful, quiet ocean views.

Great service and fresh seafoods straight from the tank. Reasonable pricing. It was so good we went 2 days in a row! Glad we went with our gut when the grab drivers kept recommending the one few doors down where they get a commission.

Came for a nice seafood dinner and while the view was beautiful, food was overpriced and mediocre.

I am surprised to read all of these great reviews.

We had the lobster, scallops and papaya salad. It was all just okay. I think they put orange juice on the papaya salad which is just not the vibe I personally like. (I also don’t know why they don’t salt the food here in Vietnam??)

Vendors walk around the restaurant trying to sell you things. It doesn’t bother us, but does take away from the ambiance.

Save your coin, avoid the tourist trap and eat at Long’s Restaurant across the street.

As others have noted, a great dinner, location and fish.

One of the best grilled fish (grouper) that I've had in Vietnam over the last 9 years. Prices are OK (it's Hoi An afterall). Our dinner cost a little over 9M VDN about US $35.

A few notes for those new to Vietnam. While my Vietnamese wife will buy fish at the market or near the sea at the crack of dawn for home cooking; eating out, a live fish is always selected that you can see and select.
Also, after we pick the fish (in this case about 2.3 kg), we ask that the fillet be grilled and the head and tail be put in "hot pot", (though my wife informs me that in this area of Vietnam it's not called hot pot because it comes with rice not noodles).
in any case, it like fish soup and this was one of the best ever fish soups I've had.
We also liked the friendly, helpful owner.

If in the Hoi An area and you want a wonderful dinner, lunch by the beach (they so have tables on the beach also for their customers) , go here, you get great value for your money and I promise you will not be disappointed.
Went to this family owned restaurant on the beach in Hoi An.  Atmosphere is great as it is right on the beach. Seafood is super fresh and tasty.  I would recommend it.

Great super fresh seafood.

The fish tanks were noticeably cleaner than nearby spots, and the lobster and crab were delicious.

Very friendly service from the family (30+ years running the place). We went back twice!

Right on the clean beach, though the seawater was a bit murky here (much cleaner in other parts of Da Nang).

I would Highly recommend it.

P.s more than one driver recommended another restaurant 1 min away called Man. it is more expensive and looked a tourist trap . We did not eat there , so this is our impression, but we were told it pays drivers to bring people there.

This is THE place to visit to eat a proper, fresh sea food. Located by the sea, run for years by the same owner. Service is super nice and kind. You can be sure that everything is fresh because... let's just say you can see it with your own eyes :-).

Everything we tried tasted amazing, I'd recommend taking 3-4 different things for 2 people, so you can enjoy greater variety.

My son and I stayed here all afternoon. Had lunch, then swam, had coffee, then swam, had dinner, then swam a little more. It was a great afternoon.

Everything was delicious, but our favorite was the seafood burrito. The staff are all very friendly. I'm guessing it's a family establishment as the kids are helping work as servers. Everyone speaks English well and it had a great laid back vibe. It is crowded mid-day with tour boats, but gets super chill by 3pm.

We loved this place so much that we basically came here multiple times during our stay in Cham Island and even twice in one day! The food was truly incredible, the beer and coconut cold and the family running this place is so nice and kind.

I fell in love with their little puppy as well, and I would come pet him all the time. One day I started getting some rashes (I completely forgot that I have that from dogs licking me) and I thought that maybe it was the fish we ate. They were so careful and nice to me when I raised the concern but later I realized it was not the food. Anyways, come here for the vibes, for the puppies, to support them, and to try their amazing food!

My favorite Restaurant Beach in Cham Island. The bartender, is name Trung, is so friendly and professional, he’s incredible. They have chairs on the beach and this beach is walking distance from the harbor where all the other restaurants and guest houses are. The food is amazing and the service 5 stars. So it’s the perfect spot to spend the day and watch the sunset.

We spent a whole day there at the beach, enjoying delicious coconut coffees, smoothies and cocktails. The food is exceptionally good, the service is just great and the owner and his family are super nice. The only downside is that we did not find this gem earlier.

Nice vibes. Great ice coffee VND30k and fresh veg spring rolls VND70k. Deck chairs are free for use upon ordering of drinks. We were there about 1pm and it was very crowded. By 2pm, most of the crowd was gone and it was absolute peace. Nice and windy beach esp after 2pm.

The charm of this little beachside bar lies in its excellent bartender, Bino. He is, quite simply, the friendliest and most open-hearted hospitality worker you’ll ever meet. It may take a little time for your cocktail to arrive, but be calm, you're on holiday remember; when it arrives, it is a work of art. I would recommend the mai tai - a heady blend that will make your sunset all the sweeter. The food is great too. We ate here every one of our 5 nights on the island. You won’t regret the decision to make it over the hill to Bai Ong, grab a lounge on the beach and order up a cocktail and a meal.

Do yourself a favor and come here!

As an Indian, I was genuinely curious to try Indian food here in Vietnam, and this place turned out to be a pleasant surprise.
🍛 Food & Taste:
The flavors were quite authentic, especially the [dish name – e.g., butter chicken / paneer tikka]. The gravy had a good balance of spices and didn’t feel overly sweet or toned down too much for tourists, which is often the case abroad. The naan was fresh and well-cooked.

They actually understand what “Indian spicy” means 😄 You can ask for proper spice levels, and they deliver close to home-style taste.

Slightly on the higher side compared to local Vietnamese food, but fair considering it’s international cuisine. Portions are decent for sharing.
🏡 Ambience & Service:
The vibe is cozy and welcoming. Staff is polite and helpful, and service is reasonably quick.
🇮🇳 Authenticity Verdict:
Not exactly like home, but definitely one of the better Indian food experiences outside India.
✅ Overall:
A great option if you're craving Indian food in Vietnam. Would recommend for both Indians and foreigners looking to try authentic Indian cuisine.

Our Chef Prabhakar 👨‍🍳🇮🇳
“I’ve spent the last 15 years honing my skills in my professional career, but my heart stays in my beautiful hometown of Munnar, Kerala. Nothing beats a perfect, authentic South Indian meal to end a busy day.”
That’s exactly what we hope to share with you here at Dhaba 21, 21 Phan Chu Trinh, right in the heart of Hoi An. A place where you can start your day wandering through Hoi An with a good meal, or simply stop by and enjoy comforting, authentic Indian food in a warm, easy setting.
If you’re in Hoi An, come by the kitchen and try it for yourself. We'd be happy to welcome you.
📍 21 Phan Chu Trinh, Hoi An
📞 +84 36 582 6921

reviews.text:
You should definitely visit Dhaba 21 in Hoi An. The food and service are among the best I’ve had here. I walked in right before dinner, and for a little while, I was the only guest in the restaurant. I really appreciate it when appetizers arrive before the mains, and they did.

The samosas were huge, came out hot, and were some of the best I’ve ever had. Each bite was packed with beautiful flavor. For my main, I ordered chicken tikka and garlic cheese naan. The chicken was cooked perfectly, moist and full of flavor, with just the right amount of color. The garlic cheese naan was delicious as well.

I can’t wait to come back before I leave Hoi An. The service was excellent, and I appreciated the owner checking in to ask how the food was. It really shows he cares about his food and his customers. This is a true gem in Hoi An.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for such a thoughtful and glowing review!

We're so glad you enjoyed the hot samosas, moist chicken tikka, and garlic cheese naan. Having our owner check in on guests is just our way of making sure everyone feels right at home, so it means a lot to know you felt that care.

Thank you for calling us a gem in Hoi An—we can't wait to welcome you back for another delicious meal before you leave! Safe travels!

title: The Temple Restaurant & Lounge
ownerDescription: Inspired by Western Europe, our fine dining international fusion restaurant and lounge bar embraces exceptional culinary diversity from around the globe. The flavors of Asia are wonderfully blended with sophisticated French cuisine, simplicity of Italian classics and other European fare.
address: 132 Hùng Vương, Hội An Tây, Đà Nẵng 560000, Vietnam
plusCode: V8J8+2H Hoi An Tay, Da Nang, Vietnam

ownerUpdates.text:
BURRATA SALAD - AN ITALIAN EXPRESSION OF FRESHNESS

Rooted in Italy’s appreciation for quality ingredients, Burrata is prized for its delicate exterior and luxuriously creamy heart, bringing indulgence to even the simplest of compositions.

At The Temple Restaurant & Lounge, its velvety richness meets the gentle sweetness of grilled green apple and rock melon, brightened by juicy cherry tomatoes and peppery arugula. Sun-dried tomatoes lend depth, while pesto, green oil and truffle balsamic dressing weave together a refined interplay of creamy, sweet and tangy notes.

Discover an unexpected side of a timeless Italian ingredient at The Temple Restaurant & Lounge.
-------------------
THE TEMPLE RESTAURANT & LOUNGE
Add: 132 Hung Vuong Street, Block 7, Hoi An Tay Ward, Danang City, Vietnam

GRILLED LOBSTER WITH SALTED EGG & CHEESE SAUCE

The dish begins with a thoughtful balance between the natural sweetness of grilled lobster and a rich, velvety salted egg cheese sauce.

To elevate the experience, The Temple pairs the dish with a refreshing Quảng-style noodle salad, crisp garlic croutons, roasted baby root, and fragrant chive oil. Bringing together familiar local accents with modern culinary refinement, it offers a harmonious composition that is both deeply comforting and elegantly nuanced.

Visit The Temple to discover the flavours of the sea through a contemporary culinary lens with our Grilled Lobster with Salted Egg & Cheese Sauce.
-------------------
Add: 132 Hung Vuong Street, Block 7, Hoi An Tay Ward, Danang City, Vietnam

reviews.text:
We chose The Temple for my birthday lunch, and they turned it into one of the most special dining experiences I have ever had.

From the moment we arrived, our table was beautifully decorated with a personalized birthday message, making me feel incredibly welcome and celebrated.

A very special thank you goes to Quynh, who looked after us throughout the entire meal. She was genuinely one of the sweetest, kindest, and most attentive servers we have ever met. Her warmth, thoughtfulness, and constant care made the experience unforgettable. She anticipated every little detail, checked on us throughout the meal, and truly made us feel like honored guests. She is an absolute gem.

The food was simply outstanding, truly Michelin worthy. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of incredible flavor. Our absolute favorites were the Yellowfin Tuna and the Black Angus Beef. We live in New York City and eat at many excellent restaurants there, but I can honestly say this was the best food we have had. Every single bite was perfect.

Just when we thought the experience could not get any better, the entire restaurant surprised me. The staff came over singing Happy Birthday while bringing out a beautiful cake with my name written on it, together with a delicious local drink. It was such a thoughtful, heartfelt surprise that it genuinely made my day.

The combination of extraordinary food, exceptional service, and the genuine kindness of everyone at The Temple made my birthday unforgettable.

Thank you to the entire team, and especially to Quynh, for creating such beautiful memories. We will be talking about this experience for a long time, and whenever we return to Hoi An, this restaurant will be our very first stop. ❤️🎂✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your incredibly thoughtful and heartfelt review.

It truly means the world to us to know that you chose The Temple Restaurant to celebrate your birthday and that we could be part of such a special occasion. Reading your beautiful words has brought immense joy to our entire team.

We are especially grateful for your generous recognition of Quynh. She is passionate about creating memorable experiences for every guest, and we know she will be deeply touched to learn that her warmth, attentiveness, and genuine care made your celebration so meaningful.

Your compliments about our cuisine are equally humbling. Knowing that our dishes stood out among the many wonderful restaurants you have experienced, especially coming from New York City, is an extraordinary honor for our chefs and the entire culinary team. We will be delighted to share your praise for the Yellowfin Tuna and Black Angus Beef with them.

We are also so pleased that our birthday surprise added another special moment to your celebration. Creating meaningful memories for our guests is at the heart of everything we do, and we are truly honored to have been part of yours.

Thank you once again for your trust, your kind words, and for allowing us to celebrate this special day with you. We are deeply grateful for your recommendation and are truly touched to know that The Temple Restaurant will be your first stop whenever you return to Hoi An.

Until we meet again, we wish you happiness, good health, and many more wonderful birthdays ahead.

With our warmest regards,
The Temple Restaurant Team

reviews.text:
​We had an absolutely amazing dining experience at The Temple Restaurant & Lounge tonight to celebrate a family birthday! Everything from the food to the service and the overall atmosphere was top-tier.
​The service here is excellent. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and gave us fantastic recommendations throughout the evening. They went above and beyond to treat us well and even surprised us by bringing out a beautiful, delicious chocolate birthday cake at the end of our meal, which made the celebration feel so incredibly special.
​The attention to detail regarding dietary preferences was flawless. For the non-vegetarians, they started us off with a complimentary selection of warm bread accompanied by an amazing spread of bacon sauce, a rich truffle-ish sauce, and butter, alongside a refreshing squid ceviche starter. For our main dishes, we ordered the prawn soup, the massive seafood platter, and the lamb racks—everything was perfectly cooked, bursting with flavor, and left us completely full and satisfied!
​They were equally fantastic with our vegetarian family member. They custom-tailored the complimentary bread basket by providing vegetarian-friendly dipping sauces (like a rich tomato base instead of the pork/bacon base) and even prepared a special, dedicated vegetarian version of the complimentary ceviche starter. The vegetarian mains—the velvety pumpkin soup and the handmade mushroom ravioli—were outstanding and executed beautifully.
​With its great atmosphere and highly accommodating, attentive team, this restaurant is definitely a must-visit when you are in Hoi An.

reviews.text:
A restaurant I’d travel 700km just to eat at. TÔK Restaurant in Hội An is one of those places I almost want to gatekeep.

It sits quietly next to open fields, with a space that feels both beautifully designed and a little poetic. They serve lunch and dinner, with a thoughtful wine selection so you can easily spend an entire afternoon without getting bored.

The torch snapper was the highlight: perfectly marinated, grilled just right, with firm, flavorful meat. Paired with satay, pomelo, and green apple, it was unexpectedly balanced and really memorable.

The truffle ravioli was another standout: rich and aromatic, with a thin, delicate skin and a satisfying bite.

The shakshuka leaned a bit on the milder side, but still enjoyable overall.

Best regards,
Lim Dining Room Team

reviews.text:
Had such a lovely final evening here with a travel friend ✨
The food was great — we had pizza and some brilliant wine, and the atmosphere was calm, dark, and cosy. We sat upstairs on the indoor balcony area which made the whole evening feel really relaxed and special 🤍

Everything was very clean, the staff were friendly, and even the little hand towels in the bathroom were a really nice touch.

Such a lovely spot for Italian food, wine, and a chilled evening in Hoi An ✨

Just something helpful to know — tax isn’t included in the menu prices and gets added onto the bill at the end ✨

Wishing you safe travels ahead, and hopefully we’ll see you again someday.

Best regards,
Lim Dining Room Team

reviewContext.Vegetarian options: Good vegetarian options available and plenty of choice.
reviewContext.Kid-friendliness: A lovely quiet and calm spot to relax after a busy family day out in Hoi An. The atmosphere felt peaceful and comfortable, perfect for slowing down in the evening ✨
reviewContext.Wheelchair accessibility: There are 2x steps leading into the restaurant and upstairs seating area, so it may be difficult for wheelchair access.

reviews.text:
Good food! I tried gnocchi for the first time and it was the best thing ever! I also had the Parma ham pizza, which was delicious!

Little disappointed when we asked for a choco lava cake which they said would take 20 minutes we confirmed the time was fine. We decided we would have more wine, 45 mins rolls around and the waitress didn’t put through the dessert. The staff were apologetics and offered us a discount. Overall the food and quality was delicious.. way better than any Italian I’ve had in the UK!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Yas,

Thank you for visiting Lim Dining Room and taking the time to share your experience with us. Gnocchi is indeed a great dish and we are happy you enjoyed it as much as we do.

At the same time, we’re sorry to learn about the delay with the chocolate lava cake during your visit - our team confirmed that this was a case of a missed order and while we’re glad our team was able to try to make it up to you, this is certainly not the level of attentiveness we aim to provide our guests.

We truly appreciate your kind words about our food and hope to welcome you back again the next time you are in Hoi An.

Best Regards,
Lim Dining Room Team

reviews.text:
I don’t often review, and I wasn’t asked to by staff either.

This place is outstanding, incredibly good food and a beautiful atmosphere they’ve created.

We’ve come back for seconds, the first time enjoying a white pasta, a nduja pizza and the flank steak with few glasses of red.

10/10, no notes. Thank you very much.

reviews.text: I made this my morning coffee spot after spending 3 morning looking for the perfect place to sit and write and read with my coffee. I wasn’t even planning on having breakfast but their smoked salmon toast was exactly what I needed each morning. I literally skipped the free breakfast at the hotel to come here. Then I came with my whole family and all 4 of my kids ate everything on their plate for the first time since coming to Vietnam. I would give it 6 stars for that if I could. The staff were amazing, you feel like you are in a warm home environment. Loved it! Coming back tomorrow morning!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It truly made our day to see the lovely photos you shared with us. Nothing brings us more joy than knowing you had such a wonderful time at our café, enjoyed the food, and especially that your children loved it too.

There's a little secret you may not know. At the end of the day, when we're cleaning up and see empty plates because every bite has been enjoyed, it always brings a smile to our faces. It's one of the simplest, yet most meaningful, moments of happiness in our daily work.

We sincerely hope to welcome you and your beautiful family back again someday. Having the opportunity to serve wonderful guests like you is truly an honor for us.

Your family is absolutely beautiful. We wish you all happiness, good health, and good luck wherever your journey takes you. We'll be looking forward to seeing you again.

reviews.text:

Every dish was beautifully presented, incredibly flavorful and served in very generous portions. We ordered four different main courses and every single one was outstanding.

The atmosphere is warm and cozy and the staff are genuinely welcoming and attentive.

Highly recommended. We will definitely come back.

1000% recommendation

reviews.text:
We visited for breakfast on July 20 as a group of four adults and two children. We ordered fresh juices, coffee, desserts, and the Berry Energy Bowl, and everything was delicious and beautifully prepared.

Both the adults and the children thoroughly enjoyed the meal. The restaurant offers a spacious and comfortable seating area, creating a relaxed atmosphere for families. It was a wonderful way to start our day, and we would gladly recommend it to anyone looking for a great breakfast experience.
☕️🫐🍓🥥🍍🍉🍋🍞

Stopped by Moments while exploring Hoi An Old Town. It’s a very popular spot and there was already a queue of people waiting to take photos with the famous “From Hoi An with love!” sign.

The funniest part was watching the photo-taking process. Every lady seemed determined to get the perfect shot and easily took 50 photos or more. Nobody seemed too concerned about the queue behind them. 😂

We ordered egg coffee and peach punch.

That said, the atmosphere is nice and it’s a great place to take a break from the heat and people-watch. If you’re hoping for that signature photo, try to come early and be prepared to wait your turn.

Aesthetic & popular Brunch/Breakfast place.

Try to sit upstairs if you want a nice view of the street and blossom. There is also a balcony.

I highly recommend the Coconut Coffee, one of the best ones I have had in Hoi An.
Breakfast was good quality and tasted great.

Try to visit early as the place gets quite busy.
On the pricier side but you are paying for a nice location, view and European food.

A pleasant cafe offering a relaxed setting and a well-executed, uncomplicated menu. The salmon toast and the vegetable toast with hummus were both thoughtfully prepared-fresh, balanced, and satisfying without being overly heavy.

The salt cream coffee was equally enjoyable, delivering a smooth, slightly savoury richness that complements the underlying brew.

While the overall experience was positive, the indoor seating did feel noticeably warm despite the fans, likely a reflection of the season. That aside, it remains a charming spot for a casual bite and a good cup of coffee in Hoi An.

Loved the wooden decor and a captivating chandelier to bring a touch of glamour into this cozy cafe. 🙂

I enjoyed my Matcha Latte Coffee Float very much. It felt like having dessert in a glass. 😋
Sitting by the window with a view of the street outside was very chill. 😎

Really nice place. Good atmosphere inside. We ate on the second floor, there are many wide open windows with natural light. We ordered passion fruit cheesecake and orange juice which were ok, egg coffee and matcha latte which were tasty. Service was good. Overall nice experience.

reviews.text: We went there to relax and have some local coffee. It has seating outside but since it was very hot we took seats on first floor. The floor has beautiful wooden ceiling and a chandelier which adds to the charm. We tried coconut coffee, salt coffee, latte, macaroon, tiramisu and fries. Everything was good and service was fast. It has nice insta worthy spots and nice view of the street from the windows. We had a nice time there.

They are expensive, slow as molasses—they completely forgot my order— and when I got my cold brew lychee coffee, there was hardly any coffee in it. It was nearly all ice! Rip off!!
Come here for the photos but get your caffeine fix elsewhere.

reviews.text:
After walking around Hoi An Ancient Town for hours, I was sooo hungry and was so happy to find this halal restaurant!

Everything we ordered was delicious. The mutton biryani was full of flavor, the Chicken 65 was crispy and tasty, and the garlic naan was on the more crispy side if compared to malaysia one. But the real star of the meal was the Samosa Chaat, it's seriously a MUST TRY! So flavorful and absolutely worth ordering. loveee 🤍

The service was friendly and attentive, the seating area was comfortable, and the washroom was clean, which made the overall experience even better.

If you're looking for good halal food in Hoi An, I definitely recommend giving this place a try. I would happily come back!

Finally found a halal restaurant in Hoi An! 🥹❤️

We arrived at Hoi An Ancient Town and were struggling to find halal food. Luckily, we found Spice Route Halal! We were so hungry and thirsty by the time we arrived 😂

The staff service was really good, and the food was delicious! It was such a relief to finally find a good halal place after walking around Hoi An. Highly recommended for Muslim travellers looking for halal food! 🌙✨

We visited a lot of indian restaurant in Hoi An and saw their menu. Some were very expensive and a few didn't even had had good taste. This restaurant had superb taste and wasn't even expensive. This has had great value for money meal and taste was also awesome. The service guy was a young boy from Uttarakhand, sweet and courteous. The lady owner was also there at the restaurant, she was was very hospitable. This place is highly recommended in Hoi An for tasty and value for money meal. Serves true Indian meals.

We had a lovely meal at this restaurant. We ordered butter paneer and a tikka masala along with a few sides, and everything was full of flavour and really well prepared. The standout for me was Samosas, they were absolutely incredible. The service was also excellent, really attentive without being overbearing. They took the time to ask about our preferred spice levels and tailored the dishes, which made the experience feel really personal. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We’re really glad you enjoyed the butter paneer, tikka masala, and especially the samosas—great to hear they stood out 😊

Happy our team could personalize the spice levels and make your experience special. We take pride in serving flavorful, authentic food with attentive service.

Appreciate the recommendation and look forward to welcoming you again at Spice Route soon!

reviews.text: Really delicious halal food! Everything we ordered was tasty, and the portions were good too. The staff were really friendly and the service was great. Definitely worth trying if youre looking for good halal food around here!

The staff here so friendly, he even recommend us the best food. And the food is so delicious, tasteful and we got the best service from them! Recommended 👍🏻 The garlic cheese naan with green sauce soo gewd

Best food I’ve eaten in the 2 weeks of being in Vietnam, was quick, hearty and authentic 100/10!! Came in at 10:30 when the place closes at 11, allowed us to order a table full and the food is out of this world!

Had a wonderful dining experience at Spice Root Restaurant! We ordered the Samosa Chaat, Kathi Roll, Kadhai Chicken, and Roti, and every dish was absolutely delicious. The standout item was definitely the Samosa Chaat—it was one of the best we’ve ever had and is a must-try for anyone visiting.

A special mention to the reception staff member from Uttarakhand, India, who recommended the Samosa Chaat. He was extremely attentive, welcoming, and courteous throughout our visit. His excellent service and warm hospitality made our experience even more enjoyable.

Great food, excellent service, and a welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic and flavorful Indian cuisine!

reviews.text: Beautiful place with a lovely view! ❤️ The staff were friendly and the service was great.  It is very comfortable place to rest and wait for the sunset 🌅The location is also very convenient, just a short walk from the boat pier where you can enjoy the lantern boat rides. A perfect spot to relax, enjoy a nice coffee, and soak in the charm of Hội An. Highly recommended! ☕🏮✨

What a wonderful place for a drink! Dat was awesomely welcoming, made us super cute but most importantly very tasty drinks. The salted coffee was the best I’ve had in Vietnam, and had a beautiful design on it. Not as crowded with Instagrammers as Faifo, and it made it a lot more enjoyable. We had the balcony to ourselves, and the scent of honeysuckle while we sipped on our drinks while people watching in the street below just made the experience absolutely perfect! I highly recommend it!

We tried the salted coffee and coconut coffee, and both were amazing! The flavors were rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced. What impressed us even more was the presentation, the drinks looked so beautiful that we almost felt guilty taking the first sip and disturbing the lovely design on top.

The attendant was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Delicious coffee, wonderful service, and attention to detail that truly stands out. Highly recommended!

If you're visiting Hoi An, make sure to stop by and try their coffee. You won't regret it! ☕✨🥥

We came here late in the evening for a coffee, such a cozy place and excellent coffee. They have a great rooftop terrace which overlooks the old town, perfect scenery and a nice spot to get your caffeine fix while enjoying the great views! ☕✨

Traveled to Hoi An and was craving a classic Vietnamese egg coffee! ☕️ I checked Google for the best spots and found this gem just a 10-minute walk away from my location. The staff were super welcoming, and the egg coffee was absolutely amazing, beautiful design too- the perfect cool down from the Hoi An heat! ☀️🇻🇳

Dat was our waiter and he was great with excellent service and conversation! We were recommended by our hotel to go here while in Hoi An so we went for a coffee at sunset and then decided to have two cocktails afterwards. The photos speak for themselves if you want a nice, relaxing atmosphere to wait to do the lanterns. Also the playlist was excellent.

My wife and I had a little bit of time to kill before an appointment, so we decided to stop here for a quick coffee. We felt like the coffee was taking a bit of time to arrive, so we joked about how they must be making intricate artwork with the foam. To our surprise and delight, the artwork was absolutely stunning and nothing like anything we had seen before! Or, and the coffees tasted just as amazing. Huge kudos to these guys, they have a beautiful cafe with great views, and even better coffee. I highly recommend stopping by if you can
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to visit Me and share your experience. We're so happy that you had a great time at our café. Hope to welcome you back soon!

reviews.text:
I came here on a rainy evening after finding the restaurant on Google Maps and seeing the great ratings. I guess it was low season in Hoi An, as it wasn’t too busy, which I actually liked. The warm lanterns made the place feel cosy and relaxed.

I ordered the Black Angus striploin and it was cooked perfectly. The vegetables and mashed potatoes were great too, and both were included in the price. The staff were very friendly and helpful.

Really enjoyed my evening here and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good steak. Oh, and they also serve pizza and burgers, so I’ll try those next time I’m back!

Amazing steaks. Juicy, fresh great taste. One of the best steaks I've had in over 20 years. Price was reasonable.  Only thing was when we got there doors were open and ac wasn't  on. They turned  it on, but place is fairly  large with high ceilings so small ac didn't cool it down while we were there. It was 97 degrees and ended  up with a headache.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Christopher,

Thank you so much for your kind words about our steaks. We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed the taste, freshness, and value.

We’re also very sorry about the air-conditioning issue during your visit. The restaurant is usually not crowded at lunchtime, so we often open without turning on the air conditioning beforehand. We will rectify this issue to provide a better experience for everyone. Thank you for your sincere feedback, and we hope to welcome you again in the future.
Ti

reviews.text:
I went to this restaurant because of the raving reviews and because it’s close to where I’m staying, being in need of a good steak every now and then. Unfortunately it wasn’t what I hoped for. I ordered a flat iron steak, medium, but got it medium rare. I didn’t send it back to the kitchen, because that would only make it worse, because it was also already cut with the grain, which made it very chewy and stringy.
I did tell the staff about it when I they saw my plate, because I left all the raw pieces on it, but it made no difference. A gesture of trying to make it better, by that I mean maybe offering a drink or anything of that kind, would’ve been nice. Work in hospitality myself, so I know how these things can be.
My honest feedback: the difference between medium rare and medium is a very important one, and if the steak leaves the kitchen already cut, it should be cut correctly, against the grain; the slicing perpendicular to the muscle fibers. This shortens the fibers, making each bite more tender and easier to chew.
Loved the veggies though ;)

UPDATED:
The owner invited me to give his restaurant another chance, and I did.
I must say: the steak was perfectly medium, the veggies just as good as before and the service and atmosphere good.
Thank you Ti for your reaction and your invitation and the time you took to change my experience.
Will definitely come back while in Hoi An.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Hoed
I truly appreciate you taking the time to write such helpful feedback. It was a very negative experience for you at the restaurant (from unsatisfactory food to poor service). I will discuss this with our chef to minimize the chances of this happening again (frankly, they did a great job before, selling many steaks and receiving very positive reviews and satisfaction. I think your steak was the second time in three months that we haven't done as well as it should have, so the chef didn't perform well this time). Regarding the service, it was a major disappointment. I think the young new employee who served you, although I knew from the start her English wasn't very good, still gave her a chance to improve (I will dedicate more time to training her; she's a good girl, but her communication skills weren't up to par, which is crucial in a service position). I hope you'll still be in Hoi An, and I'd like to treat you to a steak or any other dish from the menu as a thank you for your honest feedback and an apology for the recent unpleasant experience. I truly look forward to seeing you.
The owner: Ti

The bolognaise pasta was so good we ordered it again and again, and also the black angos steak was so amazing, well cooked, comes with great mashed potatoes on the side and such a tasty sauce! We loved this place so much and the staff was so sweet and kind. 3 nights in a row and we genuinely enjoyed eating here!
A must visit restaurant!!!!!

We hope to welcome you back again next time you visit Hoi An!
Ti

The breakfast offered a good selection of food, not an overwhelming variety, but more than enough to enjoy and choose from each morning. Everything was well prepared and satisfying.

What made the experience even better was the warm and attentive hospitality from the restaurant staff. Their friendly service made every morning feel welcoming and enjoyable.

Thank you for giving us such a great start to each day! 😊
The place was very cozy. the staff are very nice and accomodating. The food was fantastic. It was worth it and recommended.🥰🥰🥰

My stay in HOI An...
Nice stay and service. Breakfast also good... Worth coming for an experience. Walking over the ancient town is 5 mind away.. Thanks for the Hospitality. Tq

reviews.text:
La Table Hoi An is, without a doubt, the best restaurant in Hoi An. The quality of the food was exceptional, and the entire experience felt very refined and thoughtfully curated.

We opted for the set menu with wine pairing, and the team were incredibly accommodating. As we don’t drink Prosecco, they immediately offered a French white wine alternative without any hesitation, which we really appreciated.

The dishes were outstanding — the foie gras was absolutely delicious, and my husband’s blue crab dish was equally impressive. We both had the steak for the main, which was cooked perfectly.

A small but notable detail — this was probably the only restaurant we visited in Vietnam (outside of Four Seasons or other five-star resorts) where we were thoughtfully asked whether we preferred still or sparkling water, which really reflects the level of service.

They also added a very sweet touch to acknowledge that we were on our honeymoon, making the evening even more special.

Highly recommend — an exceptional dining experience from start to finish.

Curious about french cuisine here in Hoi an.

Service and atmosphere is good. The starter has frozen cucumber juice with it which is interesting, but the flavour does not blend well with the jelly/ salad.

The main course fish has a unfresh texture, I would describe as mushy? I think it’s not about the cooking but the fish quality itself.

Pho dessert is very interesting, pho taste was recreated. I appreciate the creativity, but I don’t think it is delicious…

To summarise, I like the staff and the concept of this restaurant. But the food is a bit disappointing esp given the price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear C L, thank you for taking the time to write a very detailed review, we do appreciate your feedback and we are glad that you enjoyed the overall experience despite some lower points.

we take the feedback from our guests very seriously and we thank you for your honesty.

We will be pleased to welcome you again and offer you a free drink for your next visit.

Our best regards,
Team La Table

reviews.text: Look at the photos: it says all. Fantastic food cooked to perfection and served with pride, professionalism and attention to detail using the finest ingredients. Creative flavors and textures that compliment rather then compete.  Staff were attentive and professional and provided excellent service in perfect surroundings. Highly recommend, will definitely go again.

we are very happy to read your kind words, and we would like to thank you very much for this beautiful review and pictures that accompany it.

You exactly catch the essence of what is making La Table special for our guests and we can't thank you enough to share your experience with the world!

We look very much forward to welcome you again at La Table !!!

reviews.text: La Table Hoi An was a perfect experience. My wife and I came to visit Hoi An for the first time as a celebration for our 6th anniversary. As the only French meal we booked for the long weekend it absolutely did not disappoint. We were greeted warmly by Chef Pierre and his team, the food was delicious, the wine delightful, the decor cozy and comfortable. Would absolutely recommend La Table to everyone and we can’t wait to be back with our family in the future.

​I recently had one of the finest French dining experiences at La Table Hoi An, and it exceeded every expectation. From the moment you step in, the ambience sets a warm, sophisticated tone. Every element—the exquisite food, impeccable service, and a carefully curated wine and beverage list—was absolutely world-class.
​A special highlight of the evening was meeting Chef Pierre Emmanuel, who personally takes the time to step out of the kitchen and connect with guests during the meal. That personal touch elevates the experience from a simple dinner to something truly memorable.
​An unforgettable culinary gem. I cannot wait to return!

I had an amazing experience at this French restaurant in Vietnam. The food was absolutely delicious-every dish was thoughtfully prepared, and you can really tell the chef is highly skilled. The flavors were refined, well-balanced, and beautifully presented.
The service was just as impressive. The staff were attentive, friendly, and made the whole dining experience feel warm and welcoming.
What surprised me the most was the value for money. For this level of quality, the pricing is incredibly reasonable.
I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great French dining experience.

La Table is a great blend of French cuisine with local Vietnamese flavours and ingredients. The food was absolutely delicious - we had the spring menu: the homage to tomatoes starter, the duck (might I add, perfectly cooked), and for dessert the sweet Pho. I loved every single dish, the service was impeccable, and overall had a great time. On top of that, they accommodated my dairy allergy (which can be a challenge in French cuisine) and still managed to make some super tasty and beautiful dishes. Highly recommend :)

We dined at La Table Hoi An French Restaurant with high expectations, given its reputation as one of the top restaurants in Hoi An.

On the positive side, the service was good and attentive. The meat dish with foie gras was enjoyable, and the complimentary wine from the chef was a nice touch that added to the experience.

However, there were some disappointing elements. The crab starter with apple lacked flavor—the apple was served frozen, with little aroma or taste, and the dish overall was missing acidity and balance.

Overall, while there are some strong points, the experience did not fully meet expectations for a restaurant of this level.

The only small gripe would be that the croissant was extremely dry and stodgy, we didn’t finish it.

Hoi An Roastery Coffee House, right in the midst of the old Town is a chill place to be at, especially on a Sunday afternoon.

We had 2 Coconut coffees, an Ameicano, a cappuccino, an egg coffee and a delicious banana cake to go with.

reviews.text:
Absolutely blew me away. I’ve had good coffee all over the world, but these guys are operating on another level.

I ordered the egg coffee first and… wow. It’s rich, silky, almost dessert-like without being heavy. Perfect balance of sweetness and that deep Vietnamese coffee punch. Easily the best egg coffee I’ve had in Vietnam.

Their pour-over was just as impressive clean, aromatic, and full of character. You can tell they’re roasting quality beans and actually care about the craft.

But the real standout was the service from Thanh Hà. Genuine warmth, great recommendations, and the kind of hospitality that makes you feel like you’ve been coming here for years.

If you’re in Hoi An and love coffee, this place is non-negotiable. Go for the egg coffee, stay for the pour-over, and enjoy some of the best service in town.

We tried the Hoi An specialties here and, unfortunately, it was the worst we’ve had so far. The egg coffee was impossible to drink — the egg yolk aftertaste was very strong.
To be fair, the waitress did warn us about the strong egg flavor, and we appreciate that. Still, we’ve had egg coffee in many other places and didn’t expect it to taste like this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Oksana Barder,

Thank you for the review. We’re disappointed to hear that we provided your least favorite experience with Hoi An specialties so far. We aim for authenticity, but we recognize that taste is subjective—especially with something as unique as egg coffee! Your feedback regarding the aftertaste is very helpful for our team. We hope you enjoyed the rest of your time exploring our beautiful town.

reviews.text:
The Vietnamese food at this restaurant was one of the highlights of my trip and easily exceeded all of my expectations. From the moment the dishes arrived at the table, everything looked incredibly fresh, colorful, and carefully prepared. The vibrant herbs, perfectly cooked chicken, fragrant yellow rice, and crisp vegetables created a meal that was both visually appealing and packed with flavor. Every ingredient tasted fresh, and it was clear that great care had gone into preparing each dish. The balance of flavors was outstanding, with the freshness of the herbs complementing the savory chicken and the aromatic rice perfectly. Every bite offered something new, making the meal exciting from start to finish.

One of the things I appreciated most was how authentic everything tasted. Instead of overwhelming the food with heavy sauces or spices, the natural flavors of the ingredients were allowed to shine. The herbs added a refreshing taste, while the chicken was tender, juicy, and seasoned just right. The rice was fluffy, fragrant, and had a subtle richness that paired wonderfully with the rest of the meal. It was the kind of food that felt both comforting and satisfying without being overly heavy.

The service also made the experience even better. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout the meal. They made sure everything arrived quickly, answered any questions with a smile, and created a relaxed atmosphere that made dining enjoyable. Even though the restaurant was busy, the food came out promptly, showing how well organized the kitchen and staff were.

Another thing that stood out was the incredible value for money. Everything was reasonably priced, making it easy to enjoy a delicious, high-quality meal without spending a fortune. The generous portion sizes meant there was plenty of food, and considering the freshness of the ingredients and the overall quality, the prices felt more than fair. It’s rare to find a restaurant that combines authentic flavors, generous servings, and affordable prices so successfully.

The atmosphere of the restaurant added to the overall experience as well. It felt warm, clean, and inviting, making it a comfortable place to relax and enjoy a meal. Whether visiting with family or friends, it creates the perfect environment for sharing traditional Vietnamese dishes and experiencing the local culture through food.

Overall, this restaurant delivered an exceptional dining experience from beginning to end. The fresh ingredients, authentic flavors, excellent service, generous portions, welcoming atmosphere, and affordable prices all combined to create a memorable meal. It is the kind of place that leaves a lasting impression and makes you want to return again before your trip is over. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Vietnam who wants to experience delicious local cuisine at an excellent price. It perfectly showcases why Vietnamese food is loved around the world, and it was undoubtedly one of the best meals I have had during my visit.

We are also delighted that our friendly team, quick service, generous portions, and cozy atmosphere helped make your experience even more memorable. Creating a welcoming space where guests can relax and enjoy authentic local food with family and friends is exactly what we strive for every day.

reviews.text:
I only came here because I didn’t want to wait in the long line next door. The menus looked fairly similar, and at first things seemed promising. I was greeted warmly, seated quickly, and the food I received initially was good.

Unfortunately, everything changed when my drink arrived.

Before it was served to me, I witnessed four employees take turns drinking from my drink using the same straw that was then left in the beverage they handed to me. They laughed and snickered about it before bringing it to my table. I was shocked and honestly couldn’t believe what I had just seen.

When I brought this to their attention and returned the drink, they didn’t even remove it from my bill. I had to argue with staff to have the charge taken off for a drink that their own employees had consumed before serving to a customer.

Will not return. Exercise caution eating here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We are truly shocked and deeply sorry that this situation made you feel uncomfortable, lose trust, and even have to argue about the bill. This was a serious mistake on our side, and we will immediately review the incident with all staff involved, reinforce proper hygiene standards, and improve our service procedures to ensure this never happens again.

We understand that an apology cannot change your experience, but we sincerely appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention so we have the opportunity to reflect and improve. We are truly sorry for not providing the experience you deserved, and your feedback motivates us to work harder every day as we strive to become one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in Hoi An.

reviews.text:
Excellent experience from start to finish! The food is absolutely top-notch — fresh, flavorful, and generously served. Every dish we tried was full of taste.
The welcome was warm and genuine; the staff made us feel at home right away. Service was attentive without being intrusive, and the decor is simply beautiful — cozy, stylish, and perfect for both a family meal and a night out with friends.
The location is very easy to find, with convenient access and no hassle getting there. The place is spotlessly clean, the atmosphere is relaxed, and the prices are more than fair for the quality you get.
Highly recommended — we'll definitely be back!

The food was phenomenal, proper authentic indian taste. On top of that they have halal food viz a plus point for anyone traveling to Hoi An.

I just want to callout Sagars service. He took care of us nicely. At one time, there was us (indians), middle eastern couple as well as an Israeli couple. So varying pallates and varying dishes were served and sagar gave everyone a proper recommendation.

So overall I would say, if you're in Hoi An please visit Baba's Kitchen
5/5 ⭐

We order chicken biryani and it was really good.. flavorful and aromatic. They even gave us complimentary dessert after the meal! The service was excellent and very welcoming. I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for halal Indian food in Hoi An.

Authentic Indian food with excellent service. The staff were extremely polite, attentive, and helpful throughout our visit we were impressed by how quickly the food was served fresh, hot, and within just 10 minutes.
We tried the chicken biryani and butter chicken for lunch, both of which were absolutely delicious. We enjoyed it so much that we returned for dinner and had pulao and kadhai chicken, which were equally amazing. The complimentary rice pudding was a lovely touch. Overall, every dish we tried was fantastic definitely a must-visit for Indian food lovers

I came here five years ago, and it was some of the best Indian food I can remember. This time, though, the experience was more mixed. Some dishes were outstanding, while others were fairly plain.

We had the Northern vegetarian thali, a rava dosa, vermicelli dal, chicken biryani, naan, and lassi. The star of the show was definitely the rava dosa. It was light and flaky, with wonderful flavor, and the accompanying chutneys were excellent—especially the coconut chutney.

The thali had some good curries, but the rice was pretty boring, which made the overall dish disappointing. The vermicelli dal sounded particularly exciting and unique on the menu, but when it arrived, it was a stodgy, bland lump. I’d definitely avoid that one. The biryani was solid but nothing special, and the naan could have been puffier and flakier.

I’d definitely come back for more rava dosa, but I’d probably skip most of the other dishes.

Insane food! Lovely staff! We had samosas, mutton biriyani and paneer butter masala. The dishes complimented each other so well. We were also given an assortment of incredible sauces: atchar, mango chutney, yoghurt dressing and pickled onion. AND a complimentary dessert. Highly recommend!

My wife and I had a wonderful dining experience at Baba’s Kitchen in Hoi An. From the moment we walked in, we felt genuinely welcomed.
​The Food:
We ordered two servings of the Chicken Biryani, and they were absolutely delicious—perfectly seasoned and flavorful. They also provided complimentary water, which was a nice, thoughtful touch.
​The Service:
The owner and the staff are incredibly friendly and attentive. They even took the time to check on us during our meal to ask how we liked the food, showing they truly care about their guests' experience.
​Extra Hospitality:
What truly touched us was their kindness in allowing us to perform our Asr prayers on the second floor. As travelers, finding a place that is so accommodating and respectful of our needs means a lot.
​The Verdict:
The location is great, the prices are very reasonable, and the atmosphere is welcoming. If you are in Hoi An and looking for delicious food served by wonderful people, I highly recommend this spot.
​Thank you, Baba’s Kitchen

The food was superb. The food came out quick and it was delicious. Everything was flavorful and the meat is tender. The staff are very attentive and kind, they helped us with everything even with wiping the high chair clean with alcohol. I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.text:
Food was decent for the price. Service is a bit slow. Staff are quite hospitable.
They run out of ingredients for some of the dishes, so if you want to ensure access to their full menu it's better to go early in the day.

Fried rice was a bit bland to taste.
Spring rolls were nice.
Coffee was a bit sweet even after requesting for no sugar.

We came here twice and had their Fresh Spring rolls, Seafood fried rice and Cho Lao (Hoi An Speciality)! Must try.

The Fresh spring rolls were fresh with a delicious spicy dipping sauce. The prawns were generous and the spring rolls were good sizes.

Cho Lao is a Hoi An Speciality which has slices of sauteed beef with Udon like noodles and salad which you had to mix well and eat. The sauce coated the noodles nicely and the beef was tender and delicious.

Seafood fried rice was ok, the wok hei was great however the rice was quite gard and the seafood too little .

Overall the food was really delicious which is why we came back twice. However the waiting time for food is slightly long. We waited for 20-30mins for our food.

Thank you again for your support and understanding. We hope to welcome you back for another delicious meal at our best restaurant in Hoi An old town. 🌟

reviews.text:
Set a few mins walk away from the Old Town, this place should be on your must-visit list in Hoi An. I believe they’re recognised by the Michelin Guide or at least the one in Da Nang is. Regardless, the menu is the same. The food is also halal which makes it easy for Muslim travellers.

I came here twice and had the fried beef spring rolls and fried noodle salad soup each time - both times it was delicious and I wish I had time to eat a third round. Watermelon juice is refreshing and not too sweet.

I was served each time by two young girls who might be sisters, not sure. I didn’t manage to get their names but if the owner sees this, please give them a raise! They were friendly, accommodating and took the time to use google translate whenever we didn’t understand each other.

If I had to eat at only one place in Hoi An, this would be it!

reviews.text:
A little family-owned chicken rice shop tucked away in an alley, away from the busy old town center. There are so many chicken rice shops around town, but I’m so glad I found this one near my hotel!

I ordered the chicken salad chicken 🥗 (I was debating between the chicken rice and salad, but decided I wanted more veggies) and it was SO flavorful! All the textures came together beautifully, and the seasoning was really well balanced. The portion of chicken was generous, and the meat was incredibly tender and juicy.

The shop was clean and the price was very affordable. The owner was also very friendly and welcoming. I absolutely loved this little local spot and would definitely come back. Highly recommend!

We were craving chicken rice but didn’t want to deal with the crowds in Old Town, so we chose 561/2 Com Ga Hội An since it’s conveniently close to our hotel and tucked away in a small alley.
It’s a small, family-run spot, and the food was surprisingly delicious—very much like a comforting homemade meal. We ordered chicken rice and shredded chicken salad. The owner was incredibly friendly and welcoming, even recommending the Hoi An specialty cao lầu (thick, udon-like noodles), which turned out to be just as tasty.
Prices are very affordable—a small plate of chicken rice is only $35,000 VND. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place for a casual, authentic meal

Pros: Friendly and attentive service, and the atmosphere was fairly pleasant.
Cons: The chicken tasted average, the rice was a bit dry and lacked cohesion, and the mixed chicken dish was overly spicy, which overpowered the other flavors.

This was my first time in Hoi An and I had a wonderful experience, not only because of the food but also because of the friendliness and kindness of the restaurant owners. The Cao Lau noodles here were especially delicious, even though it was my first time trying them.

The chicken was perfectly tender and the cau lau was excellent. What really sets this place apart is the family team — son, dad, and grandpa — all working together with great energy and attentive service. Highly recommend!

What a find !  Ice cold beer in Vietnam .Just off the busy main street. Wonderful local specialties. We loved the chicken salad and Cao Lau. Husband impressed with Beer on Ice out the Esky. Clean fast and friendly. Will be back Thanks
Local eatery, worth a visit their chicken rice is delicious 😋,  very authentic and super cheap. The owner puts such care into every serving, it's a treat to watch and eat

Very delicious com ga. Light, flavourful and easy. Had some closer to the old town centre that was good but the broth was cold and too  oily. The broth was lovely and not too salty. Very kind family taught us how to eat it as well. Thank you so much!

reviews.text:
This café-cum-bakery is a bread enthusiast’s dream in Hoi An. We came early enough to enjoy a freshly baked baguette, and it was absolutely worth it - the fresh breads are definitely the way to go.

The coffee selection is decent, and I was particularly impressed that they managed to make my partner’s cappuccino properly hot. He’s European, so his idea of “hot” is burning hot, whereas many places in Vietnam tend to serve it a bit lukewarm.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Jessie,

Reading this made me smile, especially the part about the baguette. There’s nothing better than catching them right when they come out of the oven, so I’m really glad you experienced them that way.

And I had to laugh a little about the cappuccino. We do try our best to get it properly hot when guests ask for it that way, so I’m happy your partner approved.

Thank you for stopping by and sharing such kind words. It truly means a lot.

Em's Bakery Team ☕🥖

reviews.text:

I returned this morning and bought a croissant that was lighter than a cloud. The exterior was very slightly sweet...but then we are in Vietnam!

My husband enjoyed his hot chocolate.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for such a thoughtful review.

We’re really glad you stopped by, even right before closing, and that you came back again the next day. That truly means a lot to us.

Happy to hear you enjoyed the croissant and that the hot chocolate was a hit as well.

Hope we’ll see you again next time you’re around.

Em's Bakery Team

reviews.text:
We were wandering around the Old Town and stumbled upon this bakery. The pastries feel very French-inspired, so of course we had to try a few. We ordered the orange citrus, strawberry, and passion fruit puff, and all three were delicious.

What I really appreciated is that none of the pastries were overly sweet, which is a big compliment. The orange one was my favorite—the slight bitterness from the chocolate mousse paired beautifully with the citrus flavor. All of the pastries were also visually stunning and definitely eye-catching.

Service was relatively fast. Prices may be considered high by local standards, but at around USD4 per pastry, it felt like a good value for us. The seating inside was comfortable, making it a nice spot to sit, relax, and people-watch.

We didn’t try any drinks since we already had sparkling water with us, but overall, this is a great place to take a break from walking around the Old Town and escape the crowds and persistent vendors for a bit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear S Young,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review. We’re really happy you enjoyed both the flavors and the balance, especially the lighter sweetness. It’s also lovely to hear the space felt like a calm pause from the busy streets outside. We hope you’ll stop by again next time you’re wandering around the Old Town.

Em’s Bakery Team

reviewContext.Wheelchair accessibility: Unsure as I didn't see any ramps.

reviews.text:
Late in the evening we realized we were hungry, but not enough for a full dinner, so we went out looking for some baked food and ended up in this place. When we saw the pizzas, we immediately liked the size — not too small and not too big, just perfect.

We ordered four different flavors, and each one was delicious and truly matched its name. I’m not an expert in Italian cuisine, but to me it felt like real Italian pizza, with bright, interesting toppings and great flavor combinations. The Four Cheese pizza was our favorite.

Because it was already late in the evening, we were offered a 50% discount, which was a very pleasant bonus to an already tasty meal. Definitely a great find for a late-night bite.

‐---‐---‐-‐---
In search of sweet adventures, the colorful mini cakes caught our attention, and we decided to try one of each. Everyone had a different favorite, but the green one was liked by all of us.

While the desserts were great, I can’t say the same about the coffee. The coconut coffee was simply awful, and I was very disappointed. I don’t understand how the flavor could be ruined so badly. The egg coffee and hot salted coffee were okay.

A nice, relaxing place to enjoy a drink and wonderful deserts, pastries and pizza slices  also looked great although we did not then, just a cake. Expensive by Vietnamese standards but the quality of the ingredients are outstanding.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello GeePee66,

Thank you for such a thoughtful review.

We’re glad you had a relaxing time with us and enjoyed the cake. You’re right, we do put a lot of care into the ingredients we use, so it means a lot that you noticed the quality behind it.

Hope we’ll have the chance to welcome you back again, maybe for one of those pastries or pizza slices next time.

Em's Bakery Team

title: Thom's Sourdough Bakery & Coffee - Tan Thanh beach

On the ground floor, you will find our signature handcrafted sourdough, pastries, and a deli shop stocked with local ingredients perfect for a beachside picnic. The second floor offers a quiet, air-conditioned space designed for work and focus, with plenty of room to settle in. Whether you are grabbing a healthy loaf to go or spending the afternoon with us, we offer a welcoming atmosphere rooted in the craft of authentic sourdough.
