reviews.text: We had the best day! Lu went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. Can't recommend this trip enough - highlights were the kind & knowledgeable guides, the Jeep, incredible lunch, exploring country roads & the water fall visit. Couldn't stop smiling all day. Also gave us a great dinner recommendation when we arrived in Hue. Thanks friends - hope to return to the area one day to do it all again!

We had the best day with Cong and Mosquito on the hai van pass jeep trip. Everything from start to finish was perfect and very well organised - the seafood lunch is DELICIOUS and on such a beautiful beach. We listened to some great beats in the jeep ride over and stopped at some beautiful spots for photos. The waterfall swim was a great escape from the heat and we liked walking around the local market in the morning. We also learnt lots along the way about the restoration of the jeeps and the history of the area. A highlight of our trip around Vietnam - thanks so much!

My friend and I had absolutely the best time yesterday on the Hai Van pass Jeep tour!!! Cong is an amazing guide, I loved his ethos and ideas behind restoring these old army Jeeps (he speaks excellent english). While we were swimming we saw him taking his time to uplift rubbish he could see left behind in the waterfall. He took such good care if us and wS truly a professional. I can't express how much fun it was to be in the Jeep, the open air, tropical weather, amazing views, totally amazing! Then all inclusive was our amazing seafood lunch on the beach. Everything was perfect and I honestly can't recommend the experience more. Everyone should go enjoy it!

Across the Hai Van Pass in a Vintage Army Jeep
We traveled from Hué to Hoi An in a more than seventy year old American army jeep, driving across the spectacular Hai Van Pass. A stunning route full of history, winding roads and sweeping views.
Along the way we made several great stops, including a visit to a local market and a refreshing swim at the Elephant Springs. Around midday we enjoyed lunch at a beautifully located spot overlooking the sea: the perfect moment to take it all in.
All in all, a wonderful experience and highly recommended. Do book in advance, as the number of jeeps still in operation is limited.
Cees van de Par

We had a great time with Cong going between Hue and Hoi An. Cong is an awesome guide with great taste in music (also a good drummer), and is passionate about his Jeep! On our trip we got to stop at a local market, swim in a beautiful waterfall and see the sights of Lang Co beach and the Hai Van pass. Unfortunately due to new regulations the jeeps cannot go into Da Nang so we took a car to see the Marble Mountains and transfer to our hotel

Amazing day with Cong and the team! Picked us up directly from our hotel in Hue. We stopped off at the local markets and a waterfall before heading to lunch on the most amazing beach!
We then headed over the Hai Van pass which had amazing views. Then if you thought it was over we headed to Marble Mountains. Such a fantastic day out. Thank you Cong

Had an amazing time with Cong Jeep Adventure! The entire experience was unforgettable and such a fun way to explore. Our tour guide, Cong, was awesome, super informative, friendly, and made the whole trip even better with his energy and knowledge. You can really tell he cares about giving everyone a great experience. We had such a good time and would absolutely do this again. Highly recommend if you’re visiting the area!

Lu was a fantastic driver and guide, who took many great amazing photos and videos throughout the trip. His english is very good and it was well worth the money. And the lunch is free when you book through the website!

AFTERNOON TEA ON THE PERFUME RIVER: A FAVOURITE JOURNEY OF THE SUMMER

This past summer, Afternoon Tea was one of the most loved and shared experiences at Moon River Cruises. The photos and videos captured along the way tell their own story of what makes an afternoon on the Perfume River so special.

The 90-minute journey takes place during the golden hour, when the sunlight begins to soften. It is a time to slow down over a thoughtfully prepared tea and pastry set, while listening to stories of Huế shared throughout the journey. Beautiful enough to capture in photographs, yet meaningful enough to leave you with stories and memories of the ancient capital.

As Huế moves into its rainy season, Afternoon Tea takes on a different charm. Light drizzles bring a quieter, more contemplative beauty to the Perfume River, while inside Moon River Cruises’ panoramic glass cabin, you can still enjoy your tea and take in the scenery in comfort.

HIBISCUS COOKIE – A NEW TASTE OF HUE FOR AFTERNOON TEA

Inspired by the flavours of Hue, Moon River Cruises introduces a new addition to its Afternoon Tea selection: a delicate cookie filled with locally made hibiscus jam.

Grown mainly in Phong Đien and Phong Thai, near the ancient village of Phuoc Tich, hibiscus brings a distinctive colour and gently tart sweetness from the Huế countryside. At Moon River Cruises, the petals are carefully made into a smooth jam and tucked inside a crisp, blossom-shaped cookie.

Each bite brings together a light, buttery crunch and the delicate sweet-tart notes of hibiscus. Enjoy it with a sip of Herbal tea, whose gentle aroma balances the sweetness and leaves a refined finish.

7 FAQs About the Hue Breakfast Cruise on the Perfume River

Planning to enjoy a Hue Breakfast Cruise? Here are the answers to the questions we receive most often at Moon River Cruises.

1. Is Bun Bo Hue the only breakfast option?
Not at all. In addition to our signature Hue Beef Noodle Soup with Crab Cake, Hue Noodle Soup with Pork & Crab Cake, guests can choose from Braised beef stew with A Luoi banana flour bread

2. Where are the best photo spots?
The outdoor bow lounge offers beautiful views of Nguyen Hoang Bridge and Truong Tien Bridge, while the panoramic windows inside the cabin create stunning photo opportunities throughout the cruise.

3. Does the shared cruise require me to book 10 tickets?
No. Simply send us your preferred date and group size, and we'll recommend the most suitable departure.

4. Can I choose my table?
Tables are assigned based on party size, and every table is located beside panoramic windows overlooking the Perfume River.

5. What drinks are included?
Enjoy unlimited refills of Hue Salt Coffee, Vietnamese drip coffee, and Royal Tea throughout the journey.

6. Is parking available?
Yes. Complimentary parking for vehicles from 4 to 45 seats is available right in front of the pier.

7. How early should I book?
Please reserve your Breakfast Cruise  at least 12 hours before departure.

Have more questions? Contact Moon River Cruises and let us help you enjoy an unforgettable breakfast on the Perfume River.

reviews.text: Amazing cooking class the best we’ve done on our travels. We made three classic Vietnamese dishes; Bún Bò Huê, Bánh Bèo and Banana flower salad. All three were delicious and I feel confident enough to make myself now especially and we got to keep a small recipe booklet. The whole family were loverly while welcoming us into their home to show us their cuisine, you can feel that they are extremely passionate about their cooking and culture. As it’s low season is two were the only ones in the class which was also great as we got to go at our own pace without feeling rushed. If you’re in Hue and enjoying the cuisine definitely stop in at Madame Tran’s for a class

We had a fun time at this cooking class. The couple who runs it are so warm and thoughtful — you can really feel that it’s a family-run business, and we were very happy to support local. Being welcomed into their home made the whole experience feel intimate and wholesome.

The menu was excellent and very well planned. It’s a great way to spend a morning or afternoon in Hue. Walked away so satisfied

If you’ve done cooking classes in other countries before (we've done similar experience in Korea in Thailand), or keen to make everything yourself, you might find this one a bit less hands-on or interactive in comparison l, simply cus of the limited space and cooking stations. — but it’s still a special experience because of the people and the atmosphere.

Overall, highly recommend!!! fun for anyone and especially if you are a foodie or a home cook

100% recommended experience! Do the class with the market tour, it made our experience much more complete. Tony showed us a variety of local products and fruits around the market, explaining their use and flavour. Such a different experience walking around a market knowing what things are and how to look for quality products.
After that you go straight to the class where you meet Tran with a big smile. She was the perfect teacher, explaining every step clearly and with a great English. The food was incredibly delicious, one of the best foods we've tried soo far. Both of them were soo approachable and knowledgeble.

Thank you soo much Tony and Tran for teaching us about your beautiful culture through delicious food!

Seriously! 5/5 🌟!!
My son and I have been eating around Hue and he asked if we can find a cooking class for his favorite Hue dishes. Our concierge recommended Madam Tran’s class.
The class was done in her cute outside kitchen patio. We went in the middle of summer but her cooling unit kept us comfortable. She had all the ingredients prepped, introduced, mise en place…very clean kitchen. Both her husband, Tony and Thuy (Madam Tran) speak a bit of English so it made it easy for me. My Vietnamese is not that great! And the Hue dialect/accent throws me off.
Right from the start, we noticed everything is made from scratch, whole/fresh ingredients. She only uses packaged goods when the ingredient list is simple. Just her methods, secrets were worth the class! Hue style is much more savory and spicy (adjustable) than what I’ve learned growing up.
Three hours later…we had a full meal to taste our new skill and efforts. My son (15yo) took his first bite and he came out of his socks! If you have kids, when they love something…it brings joy to your heart. It was that moment for me. He said it was the best meal he’s had in VN EVER! And we’ve traveled from North to South. That meal was magical, home cooking certainly has a special place. I loved every bite!
What did we cook? My son requested; bánh beo, bánh xèo (khoai), bún thịt nướng, and nem lui.
They are a lovely couple, it was like we were invited to a friend’s home to have dinner for the evening. To that, I am stuffed and happy!

We had a lovely experience tonight learning to cook Vietnamese cuisine with Madam Tran. She is very personable and fun, and shared her knowledge about the various dishes, ingredients and cooking techniques. She also adapted the menu, making it vegan for us. We helped to cook 3 dishes which were all very tasty. Her husband also took lots of photos for our memories.

Would love to get a bit more hands on with the food but understand can be tricky in a group setting. We had an amazing time nonetheless and would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful cooking class. Our hosts were so welcoming and kind! Everything was perfectly organized and really interesting.
The menu was also really good and we were so happy to learn more about the Vietnamese cooking.

Thanks again for this experience 😊

This was a highlight of our family holiday in Vietnam.  The classes are in a (beautiful) Vietnamese home and run as a family business.  Tony and Tui (Madam Tran) speak excellent English. We went as a family of 6 and had a wonderful time.  Communicating with Tony via WhatsApp in advance was very clear and easy.  He met us and took us to  the market, giving us a guided tour, which our sons weren't sure about in advance and then totally loved, as made the market accessible and fun.  We then travelled to their home, where Tui explained everything so clearly, the cookery is interactive and the food we created was delicious.  Everything was relaxed, fun, they are kind and excellent hosts.  If you're looking for a cooking course in Hue, I would certainly recommend this one, we are so glad we chose it.

I had such a fantastic time taking this Vietnamese cooking class! The experience started with a fun trip to the local market to pick out fresh, high-quality ingredients, which made the whole process feel very authentic.
The class itself was incredibly educational, and I want to send a huge thank you to the head chef (boss😉)for sharing all of her expertise. It was such a joy to learn from you!
Most importantly, the class was just a lot of fun from start to finish. A special shout-out to the sous-chef, who is an absolute legend and kept us laughing the entire time! Thank you both for the great memories and the delicious food. Highly recommended!

answers.answer: Theo truyền thuyết thì trước khi chùa được xây, chúa Tiên Nguyễn Hoàng nghe nói có bà già mặc áo đỏ tiên tri trước việc xây chùa, nên mới đặt tên là Thiên Mụ (Bà Trời)

(Translated by Google) From what I've researched, I've found the following:
Based on legend and the Chinese characters inscribed on various documents, it's clear that the element "Thiên" in the name Thiên Mụ means "Heaven."

In 1862, during the reign of Emperor Tự Đức, fearing that the word "Thiên" would offend Heaven, the Emperor changed the name from "Thiên Mụ" to "Linh Mụ" (or "Sacred Midwife") to "Linh Mụ" (or "Sacred Midwife").

This taboo only lasted from the year Nhâm Tuất (1862) to the year Kỷ Tỵ (1869). After that, people freely used both names: Thiên Mụ Pagoda and Linh Mụ Pagoda.

(Original)
    Theo tìm hiểu thì mình có thấy như thế này: 
Dựa theo huyền thoại, đồng thời căn cứ hình dạng Hán tự từng ghi trên bao tài liệu cấu tạo bằng nhiều chất liệu, đủ khẳng định rằng trong tên Thiên Mụ, ngữ tố "Thiên" có nghĩa là "Trời".

Năm 1862, dưới thời vua Tự Đức, để cầu mong có con nối dõi, nhà vua sợ chữ "Thiên" phạm đến Trời nên cho đổi từ "Thiên Mụ" thành "Linh Mụ" (hay "Bà mụ linh thiêng").

Vấn đề kiêng cữ như đã nêu chỉ diễn tiến từ năm Nhâm Tuất (1862) cho tới năm Kỷ Tỵ (1869). Sau đó, người dân thoải mái gọi hai tên: chùa Thiên Mụ và chùa Linh Mụ.

reviews.text:
A profoundly serene and historically rich spiritual sanctuary.

A peaceful, deeply meaningful pagoda that is great for experiencing living history, remarkable bonsai art, and a profound sense of tranquility. Note: It is a free, active religious site, so modest dress and respectful behavior are required. Best for travelers interested in culture, history, and finding a moment of peace amidst a busy itinerary.

Personal Details to Remember: The awe-inspiring ancient bonsai trees (some over 500 years old), the moving tribute to a self-sacrificing monk, the powerful sense of serenity in the gardens, the legendary prophecy behind its name ("Heavenly Lady"), and the intriguing modern marriage myth.

This pagoda offers an unforgettable and layered experience, combining natural beauty, deep history, and spiritual significance in one of Vietnam's most important religious sites.

So beautiful, so peaceful. This pagoda rests up above the river with a lovely view point from the hill and has tranquil gardens to stroll through. Take the time to watch the koi and check out the really cool bonsai garden. There is a path in the very back where you can see the extensive graveyard behind the wall, the family plots were very interesting and beautiful to see. Thank you for being open to the public and sharing your sacred grounds.

Great place to visit with very special layout, architecture, and the thickness of Buddhist culture in the old imperial city of Hue, Vietnam. The color theme of the pagoda and the landscape is so much standout. And the view down to the Huong river from the pagoda as well as the up-view are stunning. I walked up to the pagoda early on a hot summer day, taking the walking path along the river. And all the photos were taken in my surprising wow... The color theme is amazingly... It is the royal color... for sure...

Thien Mu Pagoda sits right on the Perfume River, and the setting alone makes the trip worth it — the seven-tier tower is the postcard shot, but the grounds behind it are the real reason to stay a while. It's an active monastery, so keep voices low and dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered). The gardens are genuinely quiet, even with tour buses pulling in through the morning. Walk past the main hall to the cemetery at the rear — it's easy to miss but worth the extra ten minutes. Don't skip the blue Austin car parked on site either; it belonged to Thích Quảng Đức and has real historical weight once you know the story. Steps and uneven paths throughout, so not ideal if mobility is a concern. Best visited early morning before the tour groups arrive, entry is free. Small parking fee of 2000 VND

Absolutely Beautiful. The whole place is in Tip Top Condition, Clean and so Peaceful. All pieces, buildings, monuments which start looking old, aged are being carefully restored to their original Conditions. Actually seen the Man working on a couple of Monuments. There's a Center Court full of well crafted and taken care off Bonsai Trees which add extra beauty to the place. First I expected a single Pagoda there, but once you go up the Stairs you find the most Peaceful and Beautiful Park with many Historical Buildings. Do visit this place if you in Hue, you will enjoy it.

It's free to visit. It can get crowded. Go there during the sunset as you can enjoy the river views. There are places for food n drinks to sit by the river and enjoy the ambience. It's totally worth it.

reviews.text: Excellent view, would be nice if there had been more information about the bunker though. Interesting to see and good coffee places nearby!

The Hill (Bunker) in Hue is a hidden and unusual historical spot that combines Vietnam War history with beautiful natural scenery. Located on a quiet hill surrounded by trees, the site contains old military bunkers and offers peaceful views over the Perfume River and the surrounding landscape.

The biggest highlight is the atmosphere. Unlike the famous royal tombs and crowded tourist attractions in Hue, this place feels more raw and untouched. Walking around the old bunkers, sitting under the trees, and enjoying the view gives a feeling of stepping into a forgotten part of history.

The viewpoint is especially nice around sunset, when the river and countryside create a very calm and scenic atmosphere. It is also a good place for photography and for travelers who enjoy hidden places away from the usual tourist routes.

However, don’t expect a large museum or a fully developed attraction. The main value is the combination of history, nature, and the quiet feeling of the location. Some parts may feel simple and the site is more interesting for people who enjoy exploring rather than looking for many activities.

A great hidden gem in Hue for history lovers, photographers, couples, and anyone who wants to experience a more peaceful and different side of the city. Especially worth visiting together with Vong Canh Hill or nearby attractions.

The beach is mostly untouched and peaceful, with a few small seaside huts and local restaurants along the shore. Some areas of the sand are clean and soft, while others have bits of litter here and there. The air is fresh and cool, making it a pleasant escape from the city.

One unique experience was sitting on the rocks near the wave breakers—large concrete blocks designed to stop the tide. Watching the waves crash and foam against them was thrilling. I even spotted small sea bugs hiding underneath, which startled me a little (though they’re harmless and more afraid of people than we are of them).

Overall, it’s a place worth visiting if you enjoy raw nature with a hint of adventure.

Thuận An Beach, located just a short drive from the historic city of Huế, is a hidden gem along Vietnam’s central coast. Unlike the busier beaches further south, it offers a tranquil escape with soft golden sands stretching along the shoreline and gentle waves lapping at the shore. The beach is ideal for early morning strolls, sunrise photography, or simply soaking in the peaceful coastal atmosphere.

The surrounding area features local fishing villages, giving visitors a glimpse into the authentic daily life of Vietnamese coastal communities. Seafood here is fresh and plentiful, with small beachside eateries serving simple yet delicious dishes. The atmosphere remains relaxed even during weekends, making it a great spot for photographers seeking natural light, reflections in the water, and unobstructed horizon shots.

For travelers, Thuận An Beach is easily accessible by motorbike, taxi, or private car from Huế city center, and parking is straightforward. Facilities are modest but sufficient, including local stalls for refreshments and shaded areas to rest. The beach is also safe for swimming, with lifeguards present in certain sections during peak season.

Photographers will appreciate the wide-open spaces, scenic dunes, and occasional fishing boats that create compelling foregrounds. Sunrise and sunset provide excellent lighting conditions for capturing the serene beauty of the area, while the nearby lagoon adds variety to landscape compositions.

Overall, Thuận An Beach is a peaceful and photogenic coastal retreat that offers both natural beauty and cultural authenticity. It’s perfect for those looking to escape the crowds and enjoy a calm, scenic Vietnamese beach experience.

This beach is a serene coastal destination in Thua Thien Hue Province, roughly 15 kilometers east of Hue city center. Known as the "muse of Hue," it is uniquely situated where the Perfume River flows into the Tam Giang Lagoon and out to the East Sea.

reviews.text: We had a great morning with Nina. If you have the time, take a cooking class in the morning and don't miss out on the market tour. Nina explained how things work there and showed us all the different vegetables, fruit, candy etc. It was super interesting and Nina was a great guide. After that, we took a short walk to her restaurant for the cooking class. Again she took her time to explain every step in detail and so we easily managed to prepare four delicious dishes together. The spring rolls we made were the best we had on our whole trip to Vietnam and the Hué style pancake is a bomb! We even took food with us for a picknick later that day. We booked only one day in advance and could also shift time starting according to our needs. Thank you for the great class, Nina! (P.s.: Btw, Nina, we got the grater at the market on the next day at the same stand we bought the knife together on our tour ;)

We were thrilled to find Nina's Cooking class as we wanted to be able to replicate Vietnamese food at home. Nina took us to the market where she explained veges and we tasted fruit that we'd seen in our travels but didn't know how to eat it or didn't have the courage to try. We went to Nina's restaurant "Ba Tam" and had a great morning preparing and cooking a 4 course meal and Nina has sent us the recipes. We highly recommend this experience. By the way do not eat breakfast because you will be cooking a large feast. Thank you Nina and thank you to your lovely mother and staff.

Book this cooking class immediately! One of the best ones I have done. Nina is so kind and teaches you about the local market and how to cook various dishes. The food we cooked under her guidance was superb so make sure you bring an empty stomach and big appetite! The Banh Khoai and Bun Cha was delicious. It was lots of fun chatting with Nina whilst cooking and she helped us with some Vietnamese phrases too. 10/10 would recommend. 🥰

We booked the class at the last minute the night before, Nina was adorable and agreed to take us the next day.
She took us through the market, made us discover plenty of fruits and veggies.
The class was great, we had a great time, and the food was delicious!
We highly recommend!

We had an absolutely fantastic experience at this cooking class. The day started by going to the local market. We were able to try lots of new foods and the market itself was an amazing experience. We then went back to start our cooking . The class took place on a beautiful balcony, we were provided with refreshments and were able to help prepare all the ingredients for the cooking class with Nina and her colleague. Nina and her colleague were so kind and we really enjoyed spending the afternoon learning how to cook many Vietnamese dishes. At the end of the cooking class we ate on the balcony. We had so much food and Nina was so kind to box the leftovers up for us as we were taking a night bus. If you are in Hue I would 100% recommend this cooking class. It was one of our favourite things we did in Vietnam.

Nina was one of the most wonderful persons I met on my trip to Vietnam. She responded quickly to my request to arrange a lesson for the next day by doing everything she could to arrange it even though she had no other requests. In the end the lesson could not be arranged, but she still invited me to her restaurant (where I had a great meal). Despite a lot of work, she took the time to be with me and tell me about her cooking classes by which she perfects her recipes by mixing different culinary traditions. Everything she says and does conveys her enormous passion for cooking. I think anyone who wants to take an authentic cooking class should consider Nina's one.

Nina's cooking class is a must do experience. We organized it quite last minute but although she is very busy, she was very accommodating and arranged the class for the following morning.

We first went for a tour around the local market where she showed us many different types of fruits, vegetables and other foods. We also tried a delicious sweet bean dessert. We then walked to her restaurant to start the class.

First we were offered a refreshing drink of our choice - tea, fruit juice, smoothie etc, and cold water. The class was on the lovely balcony outdoors. We prepared 4 dishes - spring rolls, crispy Hue pancakes, fried aubergine with sauce, and chicken curry. It was very hands on and Nina talked us through each step.

The food was delicious and we learned a lot, I love this class because it was all things that would be easy to make at home regardless which country you are from. We then ate what we cooked - it was a huge spread!! We were so full, Nina kindly boxed up the rest of the food to take home.

She also brought us a big variety of fruits that we had seen at the market to try, including soursop, coc, mangostein, Longan, rambutan which were all delicious! And even some of these to take home too, along with spices and rice papers.

She also shared a lot with us about Vietnese culture and made us laugh! She is a lovely person and we couldn't recommend this class more highly. We wish you all the best and good luck with your business Nina.

Nina's cooking class was simply amazing! My expectations were exceeded by Nina's enthusiasm and love of her local food and city. I loved how Nina lets the customer choose what food off her menu they want to cook, and shares her passion in the kitchen while guiding us through each meal. With a trip to the market and an explanation about the different foods and way of doing things, Nina goes above and beyond for her fellow foodies. I will be returning to Nina's Cafe in the future and doing another cooking class. Do yourself a favor and go to Huể and say G'day to Nina, her family and friends and let them take you on an unforgettable foodies experience.

reviews.text: Some of the antiques in the citadel were displayed in this museum. Your could get a sneak peak of the life of royal family. It's a good place for who's interested in Vietnamese history, and a good place to visit when raining.

Must-visit for history lovers. The museum preserves a huge collection of royal artifacts in a stunning palace setting. It's clean, well-preserved, and offers a deep dive into Hue's imperial past. Since it's included in the main ticket, there's no reason to miss it. It's much more chill than the Forbidden City, allowing you to actually look at the details without being pushed by crowds.

peaceful here. nice gardens and some cool artefacts to see, although bear in mind they're mostly from 19th/20th c and all the Áo were replicas. if you walk around past the toilets there's a cool exhibition about one of the emperors and his family after his exile during the French occupation. 50,000 dong pp.

The place itself is excellent and rich in Vietnamese culture and history. It’s definitely worth visiting to explore the beauty of the ancient kingdom and its heritage.
However, be very careful when you arrive, do not rent a rickshaw. We made that mistake and had a very disappointing experience. The drivers charged us 375,000 VND for one hour. Before renting, they showed us pictures of four places, but in reality, they only took us to two within that time. We followed our car driver’s suggestion, which unfortunately turned out to be the wrong decision.

In fact, the main palace is just a short walk from the entrance, and the entry ticket is only 200,000 VND. If you skip the rickshaw, you can save that extra money. Instead, the rickshaw drivers took us to a museum (50,000 VND per person) and even to irrelevant stops like a goldsmith shop, which wasted a lot of our time in the hot weather.
Because of this, we didn’t have enough time to enter the palace, which was the main reason for our visit. It honestly felt like a scam.
My advice: skip the rickshaw and walk directly to the palace.

The museum provides additional insight into the life of the king and the royal family. It covers what they went through, the impact they had on the city of Hue, and the king’s life in exile in France. There is also information about his daughter and his artwork.

The museum is not very large, but it is enough to spend one or two hours if you take your time. The entrance fee of 50,000 VND is very affordable.

Since the palace is nearby, it makes sense to visit it afterward.

Museum has a lot of interesting well preserved artefacts from Hue royals. Well put together and worth the visit. Adds more context nicely to the experience before or after visiting the citadel. We went a day before the visit to citadel as the citadel itself has plenty to see for a whole full day.

The museum is dedicated to preserving and showcasing artifacts from the Nguyen Dynasty (1802-1945), Vietnam's last feudal dynasty. It holds a collection of nearly 10,000 antiquities that offer a glimpse into the daily life, rituals, and artistic talents of the royal court.

Fake Alcohol- Excercise with caution!

Please be extremely careful if you choose to visit this establishment. Consider this a warning based on my experience.

I visited with friends and we ordered an Absolut vodka package, as it is typically our preferred drink. The drinks were brought to our table, and the server immediately opened the bottle and poured it into our glasses, mixing it with Coke for everyone except me, as I prefer mine over ice.

Upon taking my first sip, I experienced an intense burning sensation at the back of my throat that lasted for about a minute, followed by a sharp, unpleasant bitterness. Having consumed vodka on many occasions, I am confident in saying that what was served did not taste authentic.

Based on this experience, I strongly advise others to be cautious.

At the end, the barman asked if I wanted another drink. I clearly said no, just water.

Helio Night Market is a fantastic choice for a family evening in Da Nang.

Both adults and kids will find something to love here. The market is clean, beautifully organized, and full of energy, with colorful lights, lively music, exciting fair-style games, and an incredible variety of delicious street food.

Children can enjoy the fun rides and games while adults relax, explore the food stalls, and soak up the vibrant atmosphere. Whether you’re looking for local specialties or international treats, there’s something for every taste. I loved wandering through the bustling stalls, trying different dishes. Helio is a fun place to spend an evening and experience Da Nang’s youthful, energetic spirit.

It’s the perfect place to laugh, eat, play, and create wonderful memories together. If you’re traveling with family, Helio Night Market is definitely a destination you shouldn’t miss.

A fantastic night market where you can enjoy not only a wide variety of food stalls but also live performances. It was great to grab some diverse food and enjoy the music performances on the stage. The location is also right near Lotte Mart, making it perfect to combine shopping with a night market visit.

Helio Night Market (Chợ đêm Helio) is a fantastic spot for a genuine local experience in Da Nang, perfectly blending great street food with lively entertainment. It is absolutely the perfect place to kick off the weekend!

French fries that btw aren’t really great. It’s like the really soft and yet chewy ones that’s just aren’t cooked very well, and tastes like it’s made from powder and not real potatoes.
Caesars salad however was with crips and tender chicken breast. I was clearly freshly cooked. Just stay away from the bread that comes with it. It’s standard industrial baguette with no taste or texture.
Service is very good. Not too much waiting for a waiter and they do a good job, very kind and sweet young people.
Ambience is nice. Music is a bit loud to my taste but that’s on me. Lovely view and airy surroundings even on this very hot July day.
The lemonade with orange and cinnamon is like lovely and a thirst quencher.
All in all an average, mixed bag food wise.
Service, staff and ambience is nice.
Pricey? Yeah.
A bit beyond 1 million vnd for three courses for two people made me wish the food was better.
I’ve had far better meals in Vietnam for far less money.

We're sorry that the food didn't quite meet your expectations. We appreciate your honest feedback, and we'll share it with our kitchen team as we continue working to improve.

We hope you'll give us another chance to welcome you back and provide a meal that matches the service you received.

Nguyen Le Huy
Vice General Manager

The restaurant is ideally located along the beachfront, offering a spacious yet cozy atmosphere. The staff were attentive, friendly, and quick to respond.

I had read similar comments in previous reviews about table arrangements on the second floor, but in my case, they kindly seated me at a table on the first floor with a lovely sea view . That completely put my mind at ease, and any concerns about possible preferential treatment quickly faded away.

I particularly enjoyed the Catch Of The Day and Spaghetti Oceana (the Salad was decent, though nothing to write home about), all paired nicely with a refreshing glass of Esco Lager Beer.

One small downside: I had almost finished my dish by the time my husband’s meal arrived. As a couple dining together, it would have been much better if both dishes had been served at the same time. A slight adjustment in timing would make the experience even more seamless.

Overall, the prices are reasonable for such a prime location, professional service, and quality food—especially with a live band playing throughout the evening, which added a lovely touch to the whole experience.

reviews.text:
We had a really enjoyable experience at Paradise Beach Club. The place has a lovely, relaxed beachside atmosphere, making it a great spot to sit back, enjoy the surroundings and have a good meal without feeling rushed.

We ordered the Fish and Chips, and they were absolutely delicious. The fish was nicely cooked with a crispy coating, while the chips were equally enjoyable. It was simple comfort food, but done really well, and we genuinely enjoyed every bite.

The Bacon Spaghetti Carbonara was definitely the highlight of our meal. What I really liked was how generous they were with the bacon. The pasta was full of proper bacon strips, giving every bite a delicious smoky and savoury flavour. The Carbonara itself was creamy, rich and comforting, and honestly tasted exactly like it should. It was one of those dishes that you keep going back to because it is just so satisfying.

Overall, Paradise Beach Club is a great place for a relaxed meal by the beach. We loved the combination of good food, a beautiful setting and a laid-back atmosphere. Both dishes were excellent, but the Bacon Spaghetti Carbonara was definitely the one that stood out for us. I would happily visit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Amarnath, what a thoughtful review — thank you for taking the time. Our fish and chips are a house favourite so we're glad the crispy coating lived up to it, and we'll happily pass your words about the carbonara to the kitchen. Being generous with the bacon is a deliberate choice, so it's rewarding to hear someone notice. Not feeling rushed is exactly the pace we want here too. We'd love to welcome you back any time.

reviews.text:
I almost don’t want to post this because I’d rather keep this place a secret 😂🌴🍹

Paradise Beach Bar is one of those spots in Da Nang that instantly feels like vacation mode. Amazing beachfront views, relaxed atmosphere, cold drinks, and plenty of places to sit and enjoy the ocean. The whole place has that laid-back tropical vibe that’s perfect for an afternoon drink or staying through sunset.

The 3-for-2 happy hour deal makes it even better. 🍹🍹🍹 Great value, beautiful location, and a fun atmosphere without feeling overly fancy or touristy.

If you’re in Da Nang and looking for a beach bar where you can actually relax, enjoy a drink, and stare at the ocean for way longer than you planned… save this place. 🌊🔥

This is one of my favorite beach bars in Da Nang.

The view is absolutely stunning, especially in the late afternoon when you can enjoy a panoramic view of the beautiful coastline. The bar offers both a beachfront area on the sand and an upper seating area, each providing a unique atmosphere and great views of the sea.

Whether you're looking for a spot to watch the sunset, have a drink with friends, or simply enjoy the beach scenery, this place is definitely worth a visit.

Highly recommended! 🍻🌊☀️

reviews.text:
🌅🍹 ROOFTOP DA NANG – TWO VIBES, ONE FANTASTIC VENUE! 🎧💃

If you’re looking for a chilled-out rooftop bar with beautiful sea views, great drinks and a relaxed atmosphere, this place is for you.

During the day and early evening, it’s the perfect spot to unwind, catch up with friends and enjoy a few cocktails while taking in the view. The drinks are excellent, and my tip is to make the most of Happy Hour from 4–6 PM! 🍸

One of my favourite things? The music is at just the right volume. You can actually hold a conversation without having to shout over the speakers — Add friendly staff and a lovely sea breeze, and you have the perfect recipe for a relaxing afternoon.

🌅 But then sundown arrives, and the whole vibe transforms!

As daylight fades, the chilled rooftop atmosphere gives way to a livelier, high-energy party scene. The DJs take centre stage, the music turns up, and the venue becomes a place to dance the night away! 🎶🔥💃

From sunset cocktails and easy conversation to DJ beats and dancing until late — Rooftop Da Nang delivers the best of both worlds.

A beautiful setting, great drinks and two completely different experiences under one roof. Whether you're after a relaxed sundowner or a full-on night out, this place deserves a spot on your Da Nang list.

#RooftopDaNang #DaNangNightlife #HappyHour #SunsetDrinks #DJLife #VietnamNightlife #DaNangHiddenGems

The bar can be a little difficult to find if it is your first time visiting, as the sign is not very noticeable. You need to take the outdoor stairs up to the third floor, where the bar is located.

The decoration has a nice seaside theme, with wooden boards, rustic wooden barrel-style tables, and fabric panels hanging from the ceiling that gently move with the breeze, giving the place a relaxed coastal feeling. The view is definitely one of the highlights. You can enjoy the sea, especially around sunset, when the atmosphere becomes really chill and scenic.

The bar was quite lively and crowded when I visited, so it had a fun and energetic atmosphere rather than being a quiet place. I came during Happy Hour, when cocktails were 90,000 VND per glass, which I thought was a very reasonable price.

I ordered a Whiskey Sour and a Tequila Sunrise. The Whiskey Sour was refreshing, with a pleasant balance between the whiskey, citrusy sourness, and a slight sweetness. The Tequila Sunrise was smoother and fruitier, with a sweet orange flavor and a refreshing finish. Both were easy to enjoy without being too strong.

The drinks came out quickly, and the service was efficient. Overall, a fun spot for drinks, sea views, and a relaxed sunset with friends.

An extremely chill bar with music at just the right volume—you can actually have a conversation without having to shout, which is a solid 5-star plus.

The drinks are great—definitely come during happy hour from 4–6 PM. Beautiful sea view. A perfect spot to relax and hang out with friends. Friendly staff.

reviews.text: We stumbled across this restaurant by chance and are so incredibly glad we stayed to eat! Everything was absolutely delicious. Their menu has a fantastic variety, offering everything from fresh seafood and fried finger foods to steak and pastas. We ordered the chicken pasta and the creamy steak mushroom pasta, and both were outstanding! Beyond the food, the staff and service were wonderful. They were so friendly, helpful, and genuinely went out of their way to make sure we understood the menu, constantly checking in to see if we needed anything else. To top it all off, the river view is beautiful! Honestly, this might be the absolute best place in the city to view the Dragon Bridge! Highly recommend!

reviews.text:
This is my honest review given after being request by staff:

I came here on a weekend for a solo meal (without a reservation) after being told that were no free tables at the other restaurant/bar on the other floors, so I could watch the Dragon Bridge show - a great scenic view that avoids the crowds from the main road.

Fortunately, I did not need to wait long to be seated or for my orders to come. They play western pop music and love songs (English lyrics) out loud on big speakers. The menu given digitally on a touchscreen tablet rather than in print.

I ordered the seafood spring rolls and a lobster in Cajun style (spicy) as recommended by one of the servers; it was a locally-sourced spiny lobster species, quoted 600g (medium-sized apparently), pricing being by per 100g of weight, and it comes with sliced banh mi style bread. I'm not an expert on fine dining or eating seafood but the spring rolls were tiny compared to traditional cha gio/nem ran. The lobster was somewhat underwhelming because it seemed like not all its flesh was served on my plate. I also ordered a bottle of water and a tiger beer (330ml can) as well as a shisha pipe (apple, blueberry, mint flavour) which was massive to my surprise (reminded me of massive glass pipe for a special kind of 'herb').

Anyway, if you are coming here for a special occasion like a date or with family/friends, then it's good as there is definitely a romantic vibe. The servers are friendly especially Minh Tuan and Nhu Huyen; both guys endeavoured to accommodate me as a 'viet kieu' man with less-than-fluent Vietnamese - they provided an overall positive friendly service even though we needed to communicate via Google translate.

The food itself tastes good but it let down by its actual portion size. If you are sensitive to seafood and spiciness, take caution as you may feel unwell afterwards or in the folllowing morning. The prices are quite high too for what it is, so be warned. Essentially, you are paying for an unobstructed view of the Dragon Bridge, with nice vibes, unique location and picture-esque atmosphere. If you want to save money and feel like you're getting your money's worth, then order cheaper/fewer items as you'll save a lot more because the fancy luxuries come at a premium price.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We regret that some aspects of the meal did not meet your expectations.

We take all feedback seriously and strive to improve the quality of our food and service. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again with a more fulfilling experience in the future.

reviews.text:
On May 22, 2026, I celebrated my birthday at a fine dining restaurant with my spouse and cousin. The food was just average, but the rooftop view was stunning, overlooking the entire Dragon Bridge and the river at sunset with perfect weather. One of the female staff members kindly helped us take photos, and she was genuinely nice and professional.

After dinner, I asked the staff to store my birthday cake in the fridge so it wouldn’t melt. Unfortunately, when we requested the cake to be served for dessert, it came out covered in ants. Clearly, the staff had failed to refrigerate it. When I pointed this out, one staff member looked flustered and couldn’t resolve the issue, so they called the shift manager. Shockingly, the manager ignored us until we insisted on his attention, and even then, he offered no solution, just played around as if it wasn’t serious.
We left the restaurant feeling extremely disappointed and angry. The lack of professionalism was unacceptable: staff had no name tags, making accountability impossible, and the team clearly lacked proper training in F&B service and hospitality. HR urgently needs to improve staff training and management standards.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We are truly sorry about the incident involving your cake and understand that this must have been upsetting and unacceptable to you.
We also apologize for our unprofessional handling of the situation. We take your feedback seriously and will review it thoroughly with our entire team.
At the same time, we greatly appreciate your compliments to the staff who assisted with your photoshoot, and we are delighted that a part of your evening left a positive impression.
Once again, we sincerely apologize for any disappointment caused and thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback.

My first time experiencing karaoke and I loved it so much 😭❤️ Just because we saw a review video, we drove all the way here even though we lived quite far away =))) And I have to say, we weren't disappointed!

💰 Very cheap: I even took a picture of the menu! We went during the morning hours, only 29k/hour + room fee, so good value!

🏠 The room is clean, beautiful, and comfortable: There's a fan, a long sofa, and a small table. Especially, there's a shelf with:

Wet wipes

Rattles
Glitter cheering pom-poms ✨

Phone stand/holder for recording videos 🎥

🔌 There are power outlets in the room, so you can charge your phone while singing, which I really appreciate because recording videos while singing drains the battery quickly =)))

🔔 The bell near the door is for calling staff when needed, quite convenient, no need to run outside to find one.

🎤 The sound is amazing!!! This is what I liked most. Singing is great, the sound is clear and stable. The song selection system is also easy to use, you can find songs quickly, and it's not difficult to operate.

📺 The TV is a good size, not too big and not too small, so you can watch comfortably from any seat.

Overall, even though the place is quite far from where I live, my first experience was great, so I will definitely come back ❤️
Anyone looking for a place to sing at a reasonable price, with clean and beautiful rooms and lots of video recording equipment should give it a try 😆🎤

They also offer photobook shooting, I think it's 50k. You can bring your own equipment inside to sing.

I forgot to take pictures of the outside space ✨ but you'll see when you get there.

reviews.text:
Vấn Cocktail Bar has a stylish, cosy interior with comfortable air conditioning and spotless facilities, including exceptionally clean restrooms, but the drinks and overall counter experience fell short.

Sitting at the counter, the hospitality felt quite distant. The bartenders and manager speak very limited English, making it tricky to discuss drink preferences or ask for recommendations. It felt as though eye contact was avoided until we actively flagged someone down, while local guests received much more attentive service.

The menu concepts look promising on paper, but the drinks lacked the complexity and strength expected at this price tier:

* Cacao: Described as one of their stronger options, but it tasted fairly mild and sweet. Decent enough, though nothing truly standout.
* Hoa Mạch: Ordered in search of a spirit forward cocktail. You get a subtle hint of the buckwheat, but the drink overall lacks body, depth, and spirit punch.
* Tomyum: Easy enough to drink and reasonably balanced, but quite standard.
* Canh Chua & Phở: Overpowered by intense chilli heat and spices. It hits you with immediate spice, but completely misses the rich, savoury, brothy depth you expect from a phở-inspired cocktail.

A major part of the craft speakeasy appeal is the bar theatre, seeing the bottles, watching the ratios, and observing how your drink is crafted. Here, most of the visible effort went into endlessly hand shaving ice, while the actual cocktail mixing happened out of sight and the drinks simply appeared. For a premium cocktail lounge in Da Nang, the execution across drink flavours and counter hospitality leaves noticeable room for improvement.

Dear Mr/ Mrs/ Ms Geffchilli,

Thank you very much for taking time to share such a detailed review with us. We truly appreciate your compliments on our interior, atmosphere, and facilities.

However, we're deeply sorry to hear that your experience at the counter and our cocktail selections did not meet your expectations. Your specific feedback about drink and service is invaluable, we will review this with our bar team to ensure a more engaging and quality experiences for all guests. English skill is one of the things that we're trying really hard day by day to improve in order to connect better with our beloved customers.

Hope we can have another chance to make a better impression 🤍

reviews.text:
A true hidden gem tucked away in a small alley. The moment we walked in, we were impressed by the unique atmosphere. We visited on a Friday night, and the bar wasn't too crowded, making it the perfect spot for a cozy and relaxed evening.

The staff were friendly and took the time to explain the drinks and recommend drinks based on our preferences. The cocktail menu was so interesting that we wanted to try everything. We ended up ordering 5 drinks, and my favorites were Canh Chua & Phở and Hội An Cổ Trấn.

Can't wait to come back and try more of the menu!

As full-time travelers behind our Sunsets & Speakeasies YouTube channel, we’re always on the hunt for cocktail bars that offer something genuinely unique. Vặn Cocktail Bar instantly earned a place among our favorites in Da Nang. From the moody lighting and sophisticated design to the carefully curated music, everything about the space feels intentional. It’s the kind of cocktail bar you settle into for the evening rather than just stopping by for one drink.

Open for around three years, Vặn is home to an exceptionally talented team of mixologists who have created one of the most creative signature menus we’ve come across in Southeast Asia. Each cocktail draws inspiration from a different Southeast Asian country, blending regional flavors into drinks that are as visually stunning as they are delicious. Every cocktail arrived looking like a miniature work of art.

The staff were incredibly knowledgeable, taking the time to explain the inspiration and ingredients behind each drink while providing attentive service throughout the evening. It’s clear they’re passionate about their craft.

We love finding bars that tell a story through their menu, and Vặn does exactly that. As the evening went on, the atmosphere became even more vibrant, and it’s easy to see why the venue fills up after 10 p.m. We visited on a Saturday, when the live DJ added another layer of energy without taking away from the intimate, upscale vibe.

One quick tip: bring cash, as the bar is currently cash only.

If you appreciate exceptional cocktails, talented mixologists, and beautifully designed spaces, Vặn Cocktail Bar is an absolute must-visit in Da Nang. Between the artistic drinks, outstanding service, and unforgettable atmosphere, it’s a bar we’ll happily return to every time we’re back in the city.

Five stars without hesitation. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 🍸✨🎶

Go for the Canh Chua & Pho and Hoi An Co Tran.

Bungalow Beach Bar is the perfect place to relax and unwind after exploring Hoi An. Located just steps from the beach, it has a laid-back, tropical vibe that’s ideal for spending a lazy afternoon or watching the sunset.

What I really loved was the combination of a swimming pool, a pool table, comfortable seating, and a chilled-out atmosphere. Whether you want to enjoy a drink, take a dip in the pool, or simply hang out with friends, this place has it all.

The staff were welcoming, the ambiance was relaxed, and it felt like one of those hidden gems where time slows down. If you’re around An Bang Beach and looking for a place to kick back, Bungalow Beach Bar is definitely worth a visit.

We've visited An Bang Beach 3 times in the past 2 years and THIS is the place to be. The best bar with the best staff who are friendly and remember your order, even after it's been months since we visited. Huge selection of craft beers on tap, wines, happy hour, a swimming pool and pool table in excellent condition. There's live music, open mic nights, pool comps, karaoke. Food serviced from the Lighthouse restaurant next door is amazing too. A chilled bar with a great vibe, and great community of regulars. This bar is the reason we keep returning to An Bang and we will be back again.

We came here many times during our 4 day stay. Great choice of craft beers at reasonable prices, amazingly friendly and fun staff. Pool competition on Wednesday's and an open mic on Thursday's. Highly recommended.

A trip through Latin America (and beyond) that would leave a carbon footprint big enough to decimate an entire mangrove swamp. A concoction of tropical cumbias, rancheras, valses, and folk music from places as distant and warm as Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, Argentina, Paraguay, Brazil, and Cuba.
Some tunes work like a snake charmer for the hips, others are contagiously whiny, most are cocktail-inducing, and a few special ones manage to do it all at once.
Pocalipse, a staple at Mezcal and an enthusiastic adopter of sounds from a place three continents removed, will also bring in some of his own repertoire, complete with face-melting vocals and piano.
The incredible vocalist, Ana, will accompany with captivating sounds from her latin background...and shaking various objects.

title: Saime introverts - Fusion cocktail & dining
ownerDescription:
We're introverts who built this space believing that the best conversations happen when you feel completely at ease. No loud crowds, no pretense, just smooth tunes, comforting fusion bites, signature cocktails inspired by our childhood memories & Vietnamese cuisine.

There are quiet nights when we only welcome one or two guests. But as long as you leave with a smile, a warm heart, and a great memory, we know we’re on the right path. We won’t give up.

If you’re looking for a peaceful hideaway, a cozy corner at Saime is waiting for you.

ownerUpdates.text:
🍔 OUR TOP BESTSELLER: THE SAIME HOUSE BEEF BURGER

While our kitchen is deeply rooted in Vietnamese flavors, our chefs bring the exact same obsessive care and experimentation to our Western comfort classics!

To create the ultimate juiciest burger, our beef patties are seasoned with finely chopped onions, onion powder, and breadcrumbs to lock in every drop of moisture. We pan-sear the patty, oven-bake it with a touch of real butter for rich tenderness, and give it a final pan-sear for that smoky, caramelized outer crust.

Layered with crispy grilled bacon, a sunny-side-up egg capped with melted cheese, and our signature trio burger sauce (mayo, ketchup, mustard), it’s a flavor explosion in every bite!

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🍅 A REFRESHING TWIST: CLARIFIED BLOODY MARY

Think Bloody Mary is too heavy or intense? Our Modern Cocktail version will completely change your mind!

We take this famous savory cocktail and refine it using milk clarification to create a crystal-clear, surprisingly smooth drink. We combine juicy tomato with charred bell pepper, a vibrant kick of Tabasco, and fragrant roasted black pepper. The result is light, crisp, subtly spicy, and incredibly easy to enjoy.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🌾 THE ULTIMATE STREET SNACK: CRUNCHY SAIGON RICE CRACKERS

Inspired by the bustling street corners of Saigon, our Cơm Cháy brings authentic local flavors straight to your table. We fry golden rice crackers until super crispy, then brush them with house pate, fragrant scallion oil, and a sweet-and-savory fish sauce reduction.

The final touch? A generous layer of our house-made Taiwanese-style pork floss infused with a hint of cinnamon. It’s crunchy, savory, sweet, and unbelievably addictive!

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🥥 CLASSIC REIMAGINED: CLARIFIED PIÑA COLADA

Beside our signature cocktails, Saime invites you to explore our Modern Cocktail series - fresh, creative takes on world classics!

Through a precise milk-clarification technique, we elevate the iconic Piña Colada into a silky, crystal-clear drink. It retains all the creamy coconut fragrance and vibrant sweet-and-sour pineapple notes, but with a lighter, smoother texture that makes it effortlessly refreshing to sip.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🌽 A NEW TWIST ON STREET FOOD: CORN WONTONS

When designing our snack menu, our founder remembered her favorite schoolyard treat: sautéed corn (bắp xào). Instead of traditional spring rolls, we experimented with wrapping sweet sautéed corn and scallions inside delicate wonton skins, fried to a gorgeous golden crunch.

Today, it’s our

🍉 SUMMER REFRESHMENT: THE RUBY SPLASH COCKTAIL

Created directly from requests by our lovely female guests looking for a fresh, fruit-forward cocktail, the Ruby Splash is pure sunshine in a glass!

We shake premium Gin and Triple Sec with freshly pressed watermelon juice, a splash of zesty lime, and fragrant garden spearmint leaves (húng lủi). It’s vibrant, naturally sweet, deeply hydrating, and effortlessly easy to sip.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

🍚 CHILDHOOD MEMORIES: SAIGON STICKY RICE

For generations of Vietnamese students, a warm box of Xôi Mặn was the ultimate morning fuel before class. We wanted to recreate this nostalgic Saigon staple in a cozy, modern space, where you can slow down and savor every bite without rushing off to school or work.

Every plate features fluffy glutinous rice layered with our creamy house-made pate, aromatic scallion oil, sweet-and-savory caramelized radish with dried shrimp, and house-made cinnamon pork floss. We top it off with Chinese-style char siu pork, fresh cilantro, and house pickles.

🗓️ Open daily from 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays).
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

💋 SWEET STREET NOSTALGIA: THE BLOW KISS COCKTAIL

Inspired by two quintessential Vietnamese street drinks: salted plum kumquat tea (trà tắc xí muội) and fresh strawberry tea (trà dâu), our bartenders crafted a drink as sweet and memorable as a blow kiss!

We layer our house-made strawberry cordial with tangy, savory salted kumquat jam, then shake it over vodka and Vietnamese black tea. The result is a gorgeous ruby-red cocktail with a delicate fruity sweetness, a hint of salt, and a subtle tea tannin finish.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

TRADITION REIMAGINED: LUNAR NEW YEAR IN A BITE

In Vietnamese homes, Thịt Kho Măng (braised pork with bamboo shoots) is the ultimate Tết comfort dish, traditionally shared over steaming bowls of white rice. At Saime, we wanted to share this cherished memory with our guests in a fresh, bite-sized way.

After many kitchen trials, we found the perfect match: soft, pillow-steamed mantou buns stuffed with tender, melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly and crunchy bamboo shoots. It’s savory, rich, and full of nostalgic warmth.

📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An
Open from 3pm to 11pm

🥃 VIETNAM’S ICON REIMAGINED: THE PHỞ COCKTAIL

Pho is a symbol of Vietnamese culinary heritage, and our mixologists set out to translate those deep, soul-warming spices into a craft cocktail.

We simmer a rich Pho reduction infused with black cardamom, cinnamon, star anise, and dried bay leaves. Shaken with Gin, Triple Sec, and fresh saw-tooth coriander (ngò gai), it delivers the unmistakable, aromatic essence of authentic Pho.

🏷️ HAPPY HOUR DEAL: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE on cocktails from 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM daily!
📍 Saime Kitchen & Bar - 144 Lý Thái Tổ, Hoi An

reviews.text:
Saime Kitchen Bar was an absolute highlight of our experience. Everything was incredibly delicious - truly beyond expectations. The service was outstanding: attentive, warm, and genuinely thoughtful.

The space itself is spotless, beautifully designed, and so aesthetic - every detail feels carefully curated. One of the sweetest touches was when they even turned on a movie on the projector for us, which made the whole evening feel extra cozy and special.

We ordered a salad, pasta, and a burger - and finished every single bite. It was just that good. Honestly, one of the best dining experiences we’ve had! Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Saime Kitchen & Bar is such a vibe. The energy here is the moment you walk in vibrant, lively, everything you want on a night out in Hoi An. And the food? Absolutely bomb. 🤯 The braised pork mantou is a must-order (seriously, get two rounds), the sticky rice is comfort food done right, and the rice crackers are the perfect crunchy snack to kick things off. Not to mention a very comforting dessert to end the night ! 😌😚
Their cocktails deserve a shoutout too - creative, interesting flavor combos you won't find just anywhere ✨. Bonus points for the nightly movie screenings, which make this the perfect spot for a relaxed, intimate date night with something extra to talk about. 🤫
Honestly, this is going straight on my "must-return" list every time I'm in Hoi An. Highly recommend 🩵

This karaoke experience was not as enjoyable as expected, especially since we came to celebrate a birthday.

Upon entering the room, there was a strong and unpleasant mothball smell, making everyone feel uncomfortable. The selection of new songs was also limited, and the karaoke machine was quite laggy, making song selection slow and inconvenient.

Even more disappointing was the lack of prompt and enthusiastic support from the staff when we called for assistance; we had to fend for ourselves, even though this was a service we paid for.

Going to karaoke to celebrate a birthday should have been a fun evening, but the experience here left the whole group disappointed. The quality of service and the experience we received were truly not commensurate with our expectations.

Điều thất vọng hơn là khi chúng tôi gọi nhân viên để hỗ trợ thì không nhận được sự hỗ trợ nhiệt tình và nhanh chóng, khách phải tự xoay xở trong khi đây là dịch vụ mà mình đã bỏ tiền để sử dụng.

Đi hát karaoke để tổ chức sinh nhật, đáng lẽ phải là một buổi tối vui vẻ, nhưng trải nghiệm ở đây lại khiến cả nhóm mất hứng, chất lượng dịch vụ và trải nghiệm nhận lại thực sự không tương xứng.

reviews.text: Beautiful place with a lovely view! ❤️ The staff were friendly and the service was great.  It is very comfortable place to rest and wait for the sunset 🌅The location is also very convenient, just a short walk from the boat pier where you can enjoy the lantern boat rides. A perfect spot to relax, enjoy a nice coffee, and soak in the charm of Hội An. Highly recommended! ☕🏮✨

What a wonderful place for a drink! Dat was awesomely welcoming, made us super cute but most importantly very tasty drinks. The salted coffee was the best I’ve had in Vietnam, and had a beautiful design on it. Not as crowded with Instagrammers as Faifo, and it made it a lot more enjoyable. We had the balcony to ourselves, and the scent of honeysuckle while we sipped on our drinks while people watching in the street below just made the experience absolutely perfect! I highly recommend it!

We tried the salted coffee and coconut coffee, and both were amazing! The flavors were rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced. What impressed us even more was the presentation, the drinks looked so beautiful that we almost felt guilty taking the first sip and disturbing the lovely design on top.

The attendant was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Delicious coffee, wonderful service, and attention to detail that truly stands out. Highly recommended!

If you're visiting Hoi An, make sure to stop by and try their coffee. You won't regret it! ☕✨🥥

We came here late in the evening for a coffee, such a cozy place and excellent coffee. They have a great rooftop terrace which overlooks the old town, perfect scenery and a nice spot to get your caffeine fix while enjoying the great views! ☕✨

Dat was our waiter and he was great with excellent service and conversation! reviews.text: I absolutely loved visiting Hue Walking Street. The area was a series of streets closed off to the usual traffic. In place, market stalls were set up along side the regular restaurants and souvenir shops. I was very lucky as I didn't realise it was only open on the weekend. I found the atmosphere to be very exciting and vibrant. Unlike some other walking streets I visited, this had a wholesome, family friendly appeal but also catered to wider audiences with bars and drinking venues. There was a lot to eat and drink amongst the streets and it was all relatively inexpensive. Souvenirs were also great value too. I would highly recommend coming to visit.

When you are looking for food and fun.  Check out Hue walking street on a Saturday or Sunday night.  Streets are closed on these nights from 6pm.  It becomes alive with loud music and people.  Lots of restaurants, shops, massages, mini marts, pharmacy and more.  Kids playing soccer (football) and badminton in the streets were a  highlight.  So much fun and energy.

Hue Walking Street is such a fun and lively place to visit. The atmosphere is super vibrant, especially in the evening. There are many bars and restaurants on higher floors where you can enjoy drinks or food while overlooking the walking street below, and all at very reasonable prices.

You’ll find everything here: street performances, hotels, restaurants, bars, shops, pharmacies, pool table bars… it really has it all.

The energy continues late into the night (or early morning!), making it a great place to hang out, explore, and soak up the local vibe.

Definitely worth a visit when you’re in Hue!

We happened to be there because of a restaurant we wanted to dine in. Was pleasantly surprised that the whole area was closed to vehicles. It was indeed interesting as there are lots of eateries and pubs with seats outside. The weather in February is cool so dining and drinking outdoors is very pleasant. Love the atmosphere.

Although the experience and atmosphere is not the same as in Hoi An, it’s good to also have these motorbike- and car-free walking streets in Hue. That way you can stroll safely through these streets and explore the nice restaurants and souvenir shops / vendors. Mind you though that there is also quite some noise and loud music coming from different bars.

Must visit this place if you’re in Hue.

reviews.text: If you are looking for the escape of noice and rush of Hue this is the perfect place. Thuận An Beach, located just a short drive from the historic city of Huế, is a hidden gem along Vietnam’s central coast. Unlike the busier beaches further south, it offers a tranquil escape with soft golden sands stretching along the shoreline and gentle waves lapping at the shore. The beach is ideal for early morning strolls, sunrise photography, or simply soaking in the peaceful coastal atmosphere.

The surrounding area features local fishing villages, giving visitors a glimpse into the authentic daily life of Vietnamese coastal communities. Seafood here is fresh and plentiful, with small beachside eateries serving simple yet delicious dishes. The atmosphere remains relaxed even during weekends, making it a great spot for photographers seeking natural light, reflections in the water, and unobstructed horizon shots.

For travelers, Thuận An Beach is easily accessible by motorbike, taxi, or private car from Huế city center, and parking is straightforward. Facilities are modest but sufficient, including local stalls for refreshments and shaded areas to rest. The beach is also safe for swimming, with lifeguards present in certain sections during peak season.

Photographers will appreciate the wide-open spaces, scenic dunes, and occasional fishing boats that create compelling foregrounds. Sunrise and sunset provide excellent lighting conditions for capturing the serene beauty of the area, while the nearby lagoon adds variety to landscape compositions.

Overall, Thuận An Beach is a peaceful and photogenic coastal retreat that offers both natural beauty and cultural authenticity. It’s perfect for those looking to escape the crowds and enjoy a calm, scenic Vietnamese beach experience.

Don't let the negative reviews fool you! I found this beach to be incredibly serene and clean. The water was surprisingly clear, and I didn't encounter any trash at all. Maybe it depends on the season, but it was perfect when I was there.

This beach is a serene coastal destination in Thua Thien Hue Province, roughly 15 kilometers east of Hue city center. Known as the "muse of Hue," it is uniquely situated where the Perfume River flows into the Tam Giang Lagoon and out to the East Sea.

reviews.text:
I don't wish to sound too negative, as we had a nice relaxing time, to a point.

The place is marketed as a 'beach club' and in our experience a beach club has comfortable loungers around a pool, sun shade, music and of course food and drinks.
The first thing that shocked us when we arrived.... zero sun shade....There is not a single umbrella or sunshade anywhere around the pool and coming from Australia where skin cancer is common, we were forced to sit in the direct sunshine.
We paid the entrance fee 150k VND per person and if you want to use the pool, you must pay another 100k VND.... Sorry, but at a beach club anywhere in the world, this is ridiculous, you are going there for the pool and ambiance, why is there an extra fee (abelit very cheap) to use the pool?

I do not have an issue paying an entrance fee, especially when you get 100% back in food and beverage, but as I detailed above, no sunshade, extra fee to cool off in the pool, no music.... I just feel it wasn't good enough for a 5 stars review.

Great beach bar in town. A gateway for you who wants to close by the beach, enjoy your drink and swim. The beach is quiet clear and clean, it is private area therefore it is super chill. There is also a pool.
The entrance fee was 150k/person (it was Tet holiday so price is up, I think could be cheaper) then you will use that coupon to buy your drink and pay top up if you order sth over your coupon. I think it is win win for everyone. Cant ask for more, the service is also great, very friendly and attentive

reviews.text:
A place that shimmered with promise—
but asked too much at the door.
150,000 dong just to step inside,
another 100,000 to touch the water—
even the pool kept its distance.
And water, that simplest of freedoms,
was not yours to carry in.
Inside, the prices told their own story—
not for the wanderer, but the passing gaze.
120,000 dong for a moment in a glass,
gone as quickly as it came.
Some places welcome you in—
others simply take.
This one, I’d leave behind.

We ended up here when the bar we tried to get to didn't seem to exist anymore. We had seen this place on the map but weren't sure if we could use it without being guests of the hotel. The staff were perfectly happy with this (we approached from the beach side). It was beautiful, very tranquil and quiet. reviews.text:
A fantastic Japanese-style cocktail bar with the level of precision and craftsmanship you would expect. From the mixologists in elegant two- and three-piece suits to the exacting way both classics and signatures are prepared and served, everything feels deliberate and refined.

My wife ordered a simple Amaretto Sour, which was anything but simple — made with fresh egg whites and house-made bitters, it was incredibly creamy and perfectly balanced. I had the Ikigai: coffee-infused gin topped with matcha foam. Truly exceptional and unlike anything I’ve had before.

The only disappointment was that foreign credit cards were not accepted, which limited us to one round as we were short on cash. That aside, these are the best cocktails I’ve had in Vietnam so far, without question.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Otto, for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review. We’re truly happy to know that you and your wife enjoyed the cocktails, the service, and the attention to detail — that’s exactly the spirit we aim to bring to every guest.

We’d just like to clarify one small detail: the bitters used in the Amaretto Sour are not house-made. We simply transfer them into small dropper bottles to ensure easier handling and precise dosing during service.

We also appreciate your note regarding payment, and it’s something we’re taking seriously as we work to improve the overall experience.

We hope to welcome you back again soon — and next time, please let us know, we’d be more than happy to prepare a few more special drinks for you. Wishing you a wonderful time in Vietnam.
#cocktail #bestcocktail #hue #chill #date #cocktailbar #japanesestyle

I came here alone after a long day, and I’m really glad I got to meet Xiao Liang and Kris, the bartenders. They were both incredibly friendly and chatty, and I had such a great time talking with them.

The vibe here is great. I loved the cocktails and the music, and the whole place felt relaxed and cozy. It wasn’t too loud, which made it easy to sit back and enjoy the evening.

I also had the chance to chat with the owner, who introduced me to a Chinese jasmine tequila called General. I had never heard of it before, but it tasted really good.

The owner even gave me a sample of a smoked Scotch whisky mixed with oolong tea. It tasted so fresh and perfectly balanced not too strong and not overly smoky. Such a unique and delicious combination.

I had a really good time here and would highly recommend this place, especially if you’re looking for a cozy bar with great drinks, music, and friendly people.

Thừa Thiên Huế is a beautiful place full of history, culture, and a peaceful atmosphere. The city has a unique charm with its ancient architecture, especially the Imperial City, temples, and traditional Vietnamese landscapes.

What I liked most is that Huế feels much calmer and more authentic compared to bigger tourist cities. A great place for travelers who want to experience a different side of Vietnam — less rushed, more cultural, and full of character.

reviews.text:
If you are looking for a charming spot to unwind and enjoy a delightful atmosphere, Le Cercle Sportif Bar in Hue is a must-visit. Nestled alongside the picturesque Perfume River, this bar offers stunning views that enhance the overall experience.

On a warm day, the gentle breeze blowing through the area adds a refreshing touch, making it an ideal place to relax. The happy hour specials are fantastic, providing a perfect opportunity to sip on creative cocktails while soaking in the scenery.

The food options are equally enticing, offering a variety of delicious bites that complement the vibrant atmosphere. Whether you're there for a casual meet-up with friends or a quick stop to recharge, Le Cercle Sportif Bar is the perfect getaway. Don't miss the chance to enjoy this hidden gem, it is abplace that captures the essence of leisure by the river.

Lovely rooftop cocktail bar. The location is amazing, looking out over the river. And the cocktails are fantastic. I got their variation on a Negroni, made with Vietnamese medicinal wine & it was delicious. Highly recommended!

Came here for drinks and got served by Mo. She has such a beautiful personality! She smiled and welcomed us as soon as we stepped foot in the bar. Mo & the staff here went above and beyond to accommodate our preference. Plus, they made delicious cocktails! Thanks again Mo for giving us a great experience!
Fantastic place to watch the sun go down. Easy access and a great location on the river. Good cocktails between $6-9 AUD.

Nestled on the Huong river, Rooftopbar offers breathtaking panoramic views — especially magical at sunset or under the evening lights. The decor is stylish and modern, creating a relaxed yet upscale atmosphere ideal for both date nights and social gatherings.

The cocktail menu is creative and well-executed, with both classics and house specials made with care. Their small plates are also thoughtfully curated, with fresh ingredients and a gourmet touch. The staff are friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about the experience they provide.

a must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy great drinks, sophisticated vibes, and one of the best views in town. Highly recommended for locals and tourists alike.
